title: Project Controls Specialist
description:
About Us

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

The Project Controls Specialist is an experienced individual contributor responsible for leading the day-to-day execution, analysis, and integrity of Project Controls on assigned projects. Working under the direction of the Project Controls Director, the role integrates cost, schedule, forecasting, risk, change management, energy performance, progress measurement, and reporting information to support informed decision-making and successful project outcomes.

This is a hands-on role embedded within the project team. The Project Controls Specialist independently leads Project Controls execution on assigned small-to-medium projects or defined scopes within larger, more complex projects. The position owns established Project Controls processes, identifies emerging issues, evaluates project performance, develops recommendations, and drives follow-through on corrective actions. The role collaborates with the Project Controls Director when project complexity, risk, or business impact requires additional technical leadership.

The Project Controls Specialist is expected to serve as the primary Project Controls resource for assigned projects and demonstrate ownership, commercial awareness, sound judgment, effective communication, and the ability to influence project outcomes while consistently applying enterprise Project Controls standards and methodologies.

Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

Project Leadership, Team Integration, and Project Setup

  • Serves as the primary Project Controls resource and an active member of assigned project teams, providing timely, objective information that supports financial, schedule, and execution decisions.
  • Works with Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Pre-Construction, Finance, and Project Controls personnel to align project information and execution priorities.
  • Leads Project Controls setup and mobilization for assigned projects, including work breakdown structures, coding structures, baseline controls, responsibility assignments, reporting cadence, and execution requirements.
  • Independently identifies emerging performance issues, evaluates root causes, develops recommendations, and escalates material risks or decisions to project leadership and the Project Controls Director.
  • Builds effective working relationships with subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders while representing the Company professionally.

Cost Management, Financial Performance, and Forecasting

  • Leads cost management for assigned projects, including budget maintenance, commitment tracking, accruals, productivity analysis, cash flow, cost trending, variance analysis, and Estimate-at-Completion development.
  • Leads preparation and analysis of assigned project forecasts and reforecasts, validating assumptions and communicating risks, opportunities, variances, and performance drivers.
  • Analyzes actual and forecast results to identify variances and trends and communicates findings to project controls and project leadership.
  • Works with Project Management, Finance, and Operations to reconcile source data and support alignment between project controls and financial reporting.
  • Maintains accurate, timely, and traceable cost and forecast information in accordance with enterprise standards.

Schedule Management

  • Develops, maintains, updates, and analyzes assigned project schedules, including logic, critical path, milestones, progress, resource requirements, and forecast completion dates.
  • Leads schedule status collection and validation and performs critical path, variance, milestone, and trend analysis to identify threats to project delivery.
  • Develops look-ahead schedules, schedule views, and narratives to support project execution.
  • Maintains schedule issue logs and follows up with responsible stakeholders on open items and key dates.

Risk Management

  • Facilitates identification, assessment, documentation, and monitoring of project cost, schedule, resource, and execution risks and opportunities.
  • Maintains risk and opportunity register information, including exposure, ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and potential impacts.
  • Performs appropriate risk analysis, monitors mitigation and contingency actions, and communicates material changes in project exposure.

Change Management

  • Administers the change management process for assigned projects, ensuring trends, scope changes, claims, and potential impacts are identified, evaluated, documented, tracked, and reflected in cost, schedule, and forecast information.
  • Develops or coordinates change estimates, pricing support, schedule impact analyses, back charges, and related documentation.
  • Maintains accurate change logs and provides visibility into the status of pending, approved, rejected, and realized changes.

Energy Management

  • Incorporates energy production, savings, performance commitments, and related economics into applicable Project Controls processes for assigned projects.
  • Collects and analyzes performance information and assists project and technical leaders in identifying variances and corrective actions.

Planning & Project Setup

  • Leads or coordinates Project Controls elements of execution planning and project startup with Pre-Construction, Estimating, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Project Management.
  • Develops the baseline schedule, work breakdown structure, preliminary time-phased spend, controls procedures, and Project Controls content within the Project Execution Plan.
  • Supports proposals, constructability planning, feasibility studies, and project close-out data collection as assigned.

Interface with Operational Finance

  • Coordinates with Operations Finance and Project Accounting on revenue recognition, margin, billing, cash, reforecasting, accruals, and month-end alignment between Project Controls information and the financial ledger.
  • Investigates discrepancies and drives timely resolution of differences among project forecasts, operational expectations, and financial reporting.
  • Provides project leadership and the Project Controls Director with clear information and recommendations regarding material financial trends, risks, and opportunities.

Reporting & Performance Analytics

  • Develops, analyzes, and presents accurate and timely Project Controls reports, dashboards, KPIs, cost curves, progress information, and management analyses for assigned projects.
  • Performs trend, variance, productivity, and performance analysis and recommends actions to address unfavorable performance or protect emerging opportunities.
  • Prepares project controls information for weekly, monthly, quarterly, client, and internal project reviews.
  • Ensures reporting is traceable to source data and aligned with established definitions, standards, and cadence.

Team Leadership, Culture and Talent Development

  • Provides technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to project controls associates, schedulers, cost engineers, and analysts as assigned.

title: HR Policy Analyst (Lead/Senior) Performance Management and Organisational Design
description:
The Public Service Division (PSD), a Centre of Government agency, shapes people and organisation strategies across Singapore's Public Service. As the steward of Public Service-wide HR policies, PSD is reimagining how performance is recognised, organisations are designed and managers lead — building an agile, future-ready people system for an AI-enabled, competency-based and multi-generational workforce.

Performance management and organisation design are two sides of the same coin. High-performing organisations are built not only through how work is organised, but also through how people are recognised, developed and enabled to perform. In this role, you will design HR policies, people systems and organisational structures that enable the Public Service to deliver for Singapore today and into the future.

Join a team shaping the future of Singapore’s largest employer — with more than 150,000 public officers — and the people systems and policies that enable it to deliver for Singapore. If you are excited by solving complex workforce challenges and reimagining HR policy, operations and technology to deliver lasting impact at scale, we would love to hear from you.

What You Will Do

You will be part of a high-performing team responsible for shaping Public Service-wide performance management and organisational design policies that strengthen both individual performance and organisational effectiveness.

Shape the Future of Performance Management

  • Lead the review, design and continuous evolution of Public Service-wide performance management frameworks, including appraisal, ranking and promotion.
  • Design policy, operational and digital solutions that keep performance management simple, effective and future-ready, supporting competency-based careers, diverse career pathways and a future-ready workforce.
  • Reimagine the employee and supervisor experience across the appraisal and development journey, strengthening manager capability, performance conversations and employee growth.
  • Partner across HR policy domains to build a coherent, integrated workforce policy ecosystem.

Design High-Performing and Future-Ready Organisations

  • Partner agencies to design organisation structures, job evaluation and workforce models that strengthen organisational effectiveness and build future-ready capabilities, aligned with strategic workforce plans.
  • Develop organisation structure review guidelines and processes which are agile and fit-for-purpose.
  • Design and enable diverse career roles and pathways across generalist, leadership and specialist tracks, empowering officers with different aspirations to grow and contribute meaningfully across the Public Service.
  • Integrate organisation design and performance management policies to ensure organisation structures, jobs and people systems reinforce one another and drive organisational performance.

Drive Evidence-Based Policy Across Government

  • Work with HR practitioners, data specialists and technology teams to develop HR data products, digital capabilities and analytics that improve policy design, implementation and user experience.
  • Use workforce, organisational and performance data to generate insights, evaluate policy effectiveness and inform strategic workforce decisions.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Ministries, Statutory Boards and the HR community to co-create scalable workforce solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning policy, operations, data and technology to deliver Public Service HR transformation.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

This role offers the opportunity to solve some of the Public Service's most strategic workforce challenges while working with senior leaders across Government to design the policies, people systems and organisational foundations that enable more than 150,000 public officers to perform at their best. Your work will help build a high-performing, future-ready Public Service for Singapore.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Position Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for ensuring that output and uptime performance meet the demands of the customer. The role is the head of the Engineering department — manufacturing and reliability engineering, maintenance, and facilities and utilities — and leads a department of approximately 60 employees across multiple shifts. The role is accountable for equipment availability across processing, filling, packaging, material handling, and supporting infrastructure, and for the safe and compliant condition of those assets.

The key performance metrics are OEE and output, downtime and PM compliance, operational risk, successful commercialization, and cost reduction. The Director builds and owns the department budget — capital, expenses, salary, headcount, and cost-reduction targets — sets the KPIs for the department and for each line, and manages, develops, and structures the team against them.

Responsibilities and Essential Duties

  • Deliver the production uptime and output required to meet the customer schedule. Own equipment availability and OEE, make demonstrated rates and downtime visible daily, and drive the actions that close the gap to target.
  • Eliminate the largest causes of downtime: own top-loss analysis, root cause, and permanent corrective action for line stoppages, repeat failures, and changeover losses, managing the department to MTTR, MTBF, and repeat work-order performance.
  • Drive accountability for the preventive maintenance program — PM scheduling and completion, past-due PM reporting and disposition, spare-part and change-part control, and the monthly critical equipment review. Approve equipment criticality classifications.
  • Ensure facilities and utility system uptime — HVAC, purified water, compressed air, boiler, chilled water, CIP, and containment systems — including the contingency plan when a utility failure threatens production through a robust team and program.
  • Develop and execute equipment, utility, and facility qualification, change control, and decommissioning — review and approve protocols and reports or develop the team and process to do so.
  • Own Continuous Improvement, investigating Engineering-related NOEs and developing CAPAs end to end for any company challenge: investigation, root cause, corrective action, and verified effectiveness.
  • Own the Engineering safety program alongside the Safety Manager and Safety Committee — machine guarding, energy control (LOTOTO), hot work, guard-bypass permits, and contractor and construction controls.
  • Build and manage the Engineering budget — capital, expense, salary, headcount, and cost-reduction targets — and justify capital requests with cost, payback, and risk. Drive accountability in targets and costs.
  • Structure and staff the Engineering team to the work: clear reporting lines, the right leader-to-technician ratio, shift coverage that matches the production schedule, and a hiring plan that keeps critical positions filled.
  • Develop the team deliberately: defined skill levels and advancement criteria for mechanics and engineers, cross-training measured against the equipment list, training completion tracked, and a visible path from one level to the next so that people know how they progress.
  • Manage performance through KPIs at the department, line, and individual level. Hold a regular review cadence, coach where the gap is capability, address it directly where the gap is effort, and document both.
  • Support new product and line introductions with the Manufacturing Engineers, Project Services, and R&I — line trials, change parts, tooling, scale-up, and validation — to meet the on-time, in full (OTIF) requirements of the customer.
  • Represent Engineering with customers and the executive team: present performance, root cause, and recovery plans, and identify the investments that raise OEE, reduce conversion cost, and support new business.
  • Rank Engineering initiatives by impact on safety, OEE, and cost, and cascade the top priorities into department, line, and individual-level metrics to manage performance.
  • Support other company priorities as assigned.

Technical Skills Required

  • Hands-on knowledge of the equipment type used at BMSC — high-speed filling, packaging, and processing lines, plus utilities and facility systems — with a demonstrated ability to raise line output through speed, changeover, and reliability improvement.
  • Manages through OKRs or KPIs: develops the department scorecard, makes line and shift performance visible daily, and drives accountability from the department down to the individual.
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement at scale — Lean, root-cause analysis, error-proofing, and reliability/PM programs — with measurable results in OEE, downtime, labor efficiency, and cost.
  • Budget capability: builds a department budget (capital, expense, salary, headcount) from the ground up, manages to it, and justifies capital with cost, payback, and risk.
  • Leads through others. Structures the department, sets clear expectations, grows leaders underneath, addresses performance issues directly, and restructures the team when it is not built for the work.
  • Builds technical talent: skill-level definitions, training and cross-training programs, and career paths that develop and retain skilled trades and engineers in a competitive labor market.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP, FDA, ISO, EPA, and OSHA requirements as they apply to equipment qualification, validation, change control, documentation, and process safety.
  • Fluency with CMMS, production-monitoring and OEE systems, and reporting tools, using the data to direct the work rather than to report on it after the fact.
  • Credible in front of customers and the executive team: presents performance, root cause, and recovery plans clearly, and commits only to actions the department can deliver.

Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field, with 10+ years of progressive engineering, maintenance, or reliability experience in manufacturing — personal care, cosmetics, OTC, food, or comparable regulated consumer products preferred.
  • Prior experience leading a team of engineers or maintenance department, having already directed a large team through managers and supervisors.
  • Experience leading multi-level technical organizations of 30+ employees across multiple shifts, including managers, supervisors, skilled trades, and technicians
  • Experience owning a department budget and capital plan, including headcount, expense, capital justification, and delivered cost reduction.
  • Demonstrated record of improving uptime and OEE at plant scale, with results the candidate can quantify.
  • Experience building and restructuring a technical team — leveling, hiring, performance management, cross-training, and career development of skilled trades and engineers, with a record of retaining them.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Wethersfield, Connecticut.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Wethersfield area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Wethersfield requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Project Coordinator, Deployment
description:
About the role

The Project Coordinator provides project administration, coordination, and operational support to the Deployment team throughout the project lifecycle, helping ensure projects remain organized, on schedule, and positioned for successful execution of high-profile, large-format advertising infrastructure projects.


As the organizational hub of the project team, they help connect internal departments, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project managers by maintaining accurate project information, coordinating documentation, tracking progress, and supporting day-to-day project operations. This role is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who enjoys solving problems, managing details, and contributing to the successful delivery of complex construction projects.


What you'll do

  • Support project managers throughout the project lifecycle, from project initiation through construction and closeout.
  • Maintain project schedules and milestone tracking.
  • Coordinate project meetings, document meeting minutes, and distribute follow-up items.
  • Prepare recurring project status reports and maintain reporting dashboards.
  • Assist with the preparation, coordination, and administration of contracts, purchase orders, change orders, and other project documentation.
  • Support project budget tracking, cost reporting, and forecasting activities.
  • Process project invoices and support invoice approvals.
  • Coordinate design review meetings and track engineering and design deliverables.
  • Track procurement activities, fabrication schedules, and material deliveries.
  • Coordinate project communications among Development, Design, Operations, Finance, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
  • Assist with scheduling site visits and supporting construction activities.
  • Maintain project punch lists and track completion of outstanding items.
  • Maintain project information within Salesforce and other project management systems.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of project management processes, templates, and documentation standards
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the Deployment team as needed.


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Business, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience supporting construction, engineering, architecture, development, or project management teams.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar project management and tracking systems.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% to project sites throughout the United States.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting commercial construction, infrastructure, engineering, development, or specialty construction projects.
  • Familiarity with construction drawings, permitting, procurement, and contract administration.
  • Experience with budgeting, invoice processing, purchase orders, and project financial tracking.
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, including consultants, contractors, and vendors.
  • Exposure to digital signage, LED technology, structural steel, electrical systems, or out-of-home advertising is a plus.

Success in This Role

· Bring exceptional organization and attention to detail to every project.

· Build strong working relationships across cross-functional teams and external partners.

· Communicate proactively and consistently follow through on commitments.

· Keep project information organized, accurate, and accessible.

· Thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple active projects.

· Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn.

· Contribute to a collaborative team culture focused on delivering complex, high-quality projects.

Career Development

The Project Coordinator role provides broad exposure to every phase of delivering large-format advertising infrastructure projects—from engineering and permitting through procurement, construction, and project closeout. Team members develop a strong foundation in project coordination, construction administration, project controls, and cross-functional collaboration while working alongside experienced Project Managers on some of the industry's most visible media installations.

As experience and responsibilities grow, this position offers a defined pathway to advancement into Project Manager and Senior Project Manager roles within the Deployment team.

title: QA Engineer (Mid-Senior)
description:
Softeta is a software engineering partner for finance, energy, industrial, and other high-stakes sectors. We specialise in building and modernising backend-heavy, integration-critical systems where speed, accuracy, and reliability are non-negotiable. With 100+ AI and custom software experts across engineering hubs in Lithuania and Poland, we embed ourselves directly into client operations — delivering custom software, automation, and AI where they drive the most value. Clients such as SEB, NordVPN, and CarVertical trust us with systems that serve millions of users globally.

We are looking for a Mid or Senior QA Engineer with a strong focus on UI/UX and frontend testing. You will take ownership of quality, ensuring that our web applications are intuitive, visually consistent, and reliable across browsers and devices, with user journeys that work seamlessly from end to end.

What you'll do

  • Review requirements and designs to identify functional and usability gaps early;
  • Perform manual functional, regression, and exploratory testing, focusing on frontend behaviour and UI/UX;
  • Validate layouts, navigation, and interactions across browsers, screen sizes, and devices;
  • Test end-to-end user journeys and edge cases, maintaining test cases prioritised by risk and user impact;
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product stakeholders to investigate defects and improve usability.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of QA experience, primarily in manual testing of web applications;
  • Experience testing UI/UX, responsive interfaces, and cross-browser compatibility;
  • Strong test design skills and the ability to independently plan and prioritise testing;
  • Familiarity with browser developer tools and API testing tools such as Postman or Swagger;
  • Experience with accessibility or frontend performance testing;
  • Basic knowledge of databases and SQL;
  • Analytical thinking and attention to details.

Benefits

  • Diverse and technically challenging projects;
  • Training budget for professional and personal growth;
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model;
  • Flexible schedule and Agile/SCRUM environment;
  • Technical equipment that you can choose from;
  • Salary range - from 3500 EUR to 5000 EUR monthly before taxes.

title: 1 Linia Wsparcia IT (Junior)
description:
Dla naszego klienta – firmy IT z ponad 15-letnim doświadczeniem na rynku, specjalizującej się w projektowaniu, audytowaniu, usprawnianiu, integracji oraz zabezpieczeniach sieci i systemów – poszukujemy osób do zespołu I linii wsparcia IT.

Nasz klient wspiera organizacje w budowaniu przewagi konkurencyjnej poprzez transformację cyfrową oraz zapewnienie bezpiecznych i niezawodnych systemów i rozwiązań IT.

Szukamy osób, które mają już swoje pierwsze doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta, najlepiej w dziale helpdesk, i chciałyby rozwijać się w branży IT pod skrzydłami doświadczonych mentorów.

Czego możesz oczekiwać?

  • wynagrodzenia w przedziale 5500–8000 PLN brutto w oparciu o umowę o pracę,
  • prywatnej opieki w Luxmed,
  • dofinansowania do karty FitProfit,
  • pracy w zespole, który realizuje swoje zadania z energią i pasją, nie zapominając przy tym o tworzeniu zgranego teamu z niebanalnym poczuciem humoru,
  • możliwości rozwoju poprzez wsparcie i mentoring ze strony koordynatora zespołu oraz innych doświadczonych współpracowników, szkolenia wewnętrzne i zewnętrzne oraz coraz ambitniejsze i bardziej złożone zadania,
  • przyjaznej, nieformalnej atmosfery wśród ludzi, którzy się lubią i chętnie spędzają razem czas również po pracy 🙂
  • cenisz sobie uczciwość i transparentność (potrafisz szczerze i otwarcie komunikować się, przyjmować i dawać feedback, mówić otwarcie o trudnych tematach, nie boisz się zadawać pytań lub przyznać, że czegoś nie wiesz),
  • chętnie wychodzisz z inicjatywą (bierzesz odpowiedzialność za powierzone zadania, zawsze starasz się znaleźć najlepsze rozwiązanie dla danego problemu, poszukujesz odpowiedzi w różnych źródłach, jesteś samodzielna/-y i potrafisz myśleć nieszablonowo),
  • jesteś profesjonalna/-y (nie spóźniasz się, dotrzymujesz terminów i obietnic, jesteś zorientowana/-y na klienta i jego potrzeby oraz masz wysoką kulturę osobistą),
  • uważasz, że partnerstwo i współpraca są kluczem do sukcesu (wspierasz innych i dzielisz się wiedzą, jesteś pozytywnie nastawiona/-y do swojej pracy, otoczenia i obowiązku, potrafisz grać do wspólnej bramki, szanujesz innych),
  • nieustanny rozwój jest dla Ciebie bardzo ważny (chętnie zdobywasz nową wiedzę, podnosisz swoje kwalifikacje oraz szukasz i przyswajasz nowe informacje),

oraz:

  • masz minimum 6 miesięcy doświadczenia na stanowisku pracownika Helpdesk IT lub pokrewnym, związanym z obsługą klienta i rozwiązywaniem jego problemów ze sprzętem IT oraz oprogramowaniem użytkowym,
  • znasz budowę komputera w zakresie jego serwisu i modernizacji,
  • masz znajomość budowy sieci LAN, WAN, WLAN,
  • znasz Windows 8/8.1/10/11, MS Office oraz platformę Microsoft 365 na poziomie umożliwiającym diagnostykę,
  • potrafisz czytać dokumentację techniczną po angielsku,
  • znasz język angielski komunikatywnie w mowie i piśmie (większość klientów jest z Polski, jednak obsługiwani są również klienci zagraniczni),
  • posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B i praktykę w prowadzeniu pojazdu,
  • jesteś otwarta/-y na wyjazdy służbowe,
  • lubisz kontakt z ludźmi (telefoniczny, mailowy oraz osobisty),
  • potrafisz przeanalizować problem i zadać właściwe pytania,
  • dobrze radzisz sobie z presją czasu, stresem i ustalaniem priorytetów,
  • jesteś elastyczna/-y, potrafisz odnaleźć się w różnych sytuacjach i w komunikacji z różnymi osobami,

… to szukamy właśnie Ciebie!


Mile widziane, ale niekonieczne

  • doświadczenie z systemem operacyjnym Linux,
  • znajomość Windows Server i Active Directory,
  • doświadczenie w obsłudze MacOS,
  • umiejętność konfiguracji urządzeń sieciowych, w tym routerów i switchy oraz zarządzania VLAN-ami,
  • znajomość urządzeń mobilnych,
  • znajomość rozwiązań antywirusowych i firewalli.

title: Remote | FreeCAD Expert — $40–$80/hour
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for experienced CAD professionals with strong expertise in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, industrial design, and multi-part assembly analysis to contribute to an advanced AI training project focused on engineering design interpretation.

Selected professionals will analyse complex CAD assemblies provided in native FreeCAD format and develop technically precise, objective question-and-answer content grounded in real engineering data. The work requires strong understanding of geometry, assembly relationships, technical drawings, and engineering function, with an emphasis on creating assessment-ready content that can be verified directly against the source designs.

Key Responsibilities

CAD Assembly Analysis

  • Review complex multi-part CAD assemblies and interpret their geometry, component relationships, and engineering function
  • Analyse native FreeCAD files and associated technical design information
  • Identify important features, interfaces, and dependencies between assembly components
  • Apply mechanical engineering principles when interpreting design intent and assembly behaviour
  • Evaluate technical details with a high degree of precision and consistency

Technical Question Development

  • Author objective, precise, and non-guessable questions based on provided CAD assemblies
  • Develop several technically meaningful questions per assembly
  • Ensure each question requires application of domain expertise rather than surface-level observation
  • Structure questions so that each has an exact and verifiable answer
  • Maintain strong alignment between technical prompts and the underlying assembly data

Answer Authoring & Technical Validation

  • Produce clear, accurate, and well-supported answers to each technical question
  • Verify that answers are directly grounded in the source CAD files and engineering information
  • Review geometry, component relationships, and technical drawings to confirm correctness
  • Identify and document ambiguity before finalising conclusions
  • Maintain high standards for technical accuracy, consistency, and assessment readiness

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Collaborate asynchronously through written and verbal communication
  • Clarify requirements and respond to feedback throughout the authoring process
  • Document technical insights, uncertainties, and ambiguities encountered during analysis
  • Contribute to iterative improvement of question sets and project workflows
  • Communicate complex engineering concepts clearly and concisely

Ideal Profile

  • Extensive background in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, industrial design, or a closely related discipline
  • Strong foundational knowledge of CAD principles and engineering design interpretation
  • Significant experience working with multi-part assemblies
  • Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and technical design intent
  • Familiarity with FreeCAD or comparable CAD platforms
  • Direct FreeCAD experience is advantageous but not mandatory
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to author detailed technical questions, training content, or assessment material
  • Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to objective, high-quality technical work
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a remote environment
  • Professional profile consistent with expert-level engineering or consulting work

Engagement Details

  • Part-time independent contractor engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Compensation: $40–$80/hour
  • Work will involve FreeCAD assembly analysis, engineering drawing interpretation, technical question authoring, answer development, and documentation
  • Strong experience with complex mechanical assemblies and technical design interpretation is important for this engagement
  • Direct FreeCAD experience is beneficial but not mandatory
  • Project scope, workload, timing, and duration may evolve depending on project requirements
  • Work must be completed without using confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, institution, or other third party

About the Platform

This opportunity is available through 24-MAG LLC. We connect experienced professionals with remote consulting opportunities across technical, evaluation, and project-based workstreams.

description:

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Collegeville, Pennsylvania.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Collegeville area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Collegeville requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Distribution Designer
description:

EPE is seeking an experienced Distribution Designer or Design Engineer to support ongoing projects for Utilities. The ideal candidate has strong experience with utility standards and workflows, including the use of PoleForeman, Autodesk Utility Design (AUD), INFOR EFD, and ArcFM.This individual will be responsible for preparing detailed design packages for overhead and underground electric distribution systems, collaborating with remote team members, and interfacing with utility contacts as needed.

    • Produce designs using Autodesk Utility Design (AUD) and ArcFM, incorporating GIS data and field notes.

    • Navigate INFOR EFD for work management and tracking.

    • Apply NESC, NEC, and utility criteria for clearance, conductor selection, and construction unit application.

  • Project Support & Documentation

    • Create material lists, construction notes, and supporting documentation for work order packages.

    • Coordinate with cross-functional utility teams (e.g., forestry, operations, construction).

    • Review and QA/QC design deliverables to ensure accuracy and constructability.

    • Provide cost estimates and design metrics as required.

  • Field & Client Interface

    • Communicate with client representatives, municipalities, and stakeholders in a professional, responsive manner.

    • Ensure compliance with safety procedures and proper use of PPE during site visits.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • 3+ years of electric distribution design experience.
  • Proficiency with PoleForeman, AUD, ArcFM, and INFOR EFD.
  • Strong understanding of overhead and underground electric distribution design and construction practices.
  • Experience with GIS-based design tools (e.g., ESRI ArcGIS) and utility work management systems.
  • Knowledge of applicable codes (NESC, NEC) and utility-specific standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Design Engineer) or technical degree/certificate (Designer) preferred.

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Location: Candidates based in Pennsylvania area are strongly preferred

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

EPE does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited third-party resumes forwarded by recruiters to EPE via our career page or to any of our managers or employees will be considered public information, may be treated as a direct application from the person identified in the resume, and will not be eligible for placement fee payment to the agency. title: Mohs Histotechnician
description:
Overview

We’re hiring a Mohs Histotechnician to join North Atlanta Dermatology in Duluth, GA. This role supports the Mohs surgeon by preparing high-quality frozen tissue sections for microscopic examination while maintaining efficient laboratory workflow, equipment, and compliance standards.

Schedule: Monday - Thursday | 6:45 AM - 4:30/5:00 PM

North Atlanta Dermatology, part of Anne Arundel Dermatology, specializes in Mohs micrographic surgery and is committed to providing high-quality surgical dermatology care in a patient-focused environment.

Founded 50+ years ago with a mission to provide the highest quality and full spectrum of medical, surgical, and esthetic skin care services to each and every one of its patients, Anne Arundel Dermatology has assembled the finest group of dermatologists in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern states. With 300+ clinicians and 110+ locations in 7 states, we’re thriving, growing, and looking to add talented individuals to our team!

Why join Anne Arundel Dermatology?

At Anne Arundel Dermatology we give exceptional care - to our patients and to each other. We are committed to continual training and education for our physicians and staff. We are on top of the latest developments in dermatology including ongoing research, emerging treatments, new medications and prevention methods. You can find more than just a job with Anne Arundel Dermatology. We believe in providing our new associates with intensive hands-on training and long-term career growth opportunities from within.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare frozen tissue sections for microscopic examination using a cryostat.
  • Gross, embed, cut, stain, and process tissue specimens for Mohs surgery.
  • Maintain efficient specimen workflow and prioritize multiple cases based on clinical needs.
  • Care for, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment, instruments, and accessories.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, stocked, and properly inventoried laboratory environment.
  • Follow applicable CLIA, OSHA, infection control, and laboratory safety standards.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory documentation and quality-control records.
  • Support timely turnaround of Mohs specimens while maintaining quality and safety standards.
  • Collaborate closely with Mohs surgeons and laboratory staff to support efficient surgical workflow.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Laboratory Manager or management.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1 year of recent experience preparing frozen sections, including grossing, embedding, and cutting tissue for Mohs cases preferred.
  • Experience working with cryostats and processing Mohs specimens strongly preferred.
  • Independently cut and process 10 Mohs cases with a 20-minute turnaround time.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a high-volume laboratory environment without compromising safety or specimen quality.
  • Ability to triage and prioritize multiple specimens received simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Collaborative, dependable, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a laboratory and surgical team.
  • Strong organization and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to adapt to varying specimen sizes and workflow demands.
  • Knowledge of CLIA, OSHA, and laboratory safety standards preferred.

Licensure/Certifications/Education

Education & Experience:

  • HT(ASCP) certification required with commensurate experience.
  • Associate degree in laboratory science or medical laboratory technology from an accredited institution.
  • Alternatively, completion of at least 60 semester hours of science coursework from an accredited institution may be considered.

Physical Requirements:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods of time
  • Moderate amount of talking, bending, twisting, reaching, and balancing.

title: Sr Manager Quality Assurance
description:
Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. is a global leader in the production, distribution, and marketing of fresh, value-added, and shelf-stable fruits and vegetables under our Fresh and Foods divisions. Our diverse product portfolio proudly bears the Del Monte® brand and also includes prepared fruits and vegetables, juices, beverages, snacks, and desserts—available in over 80 countries worldwide. With operations spanning more than 35 countries, we’ve proudly been nourishing families for over 135 years.


Our company is committed to maintaining a safe and productive work environment. As a drug free workplace, all candidates selected for hire in our operations, warehouse, quality assurance, transportation and production roles must complete and pass a pre-employment drug test.

Benefits We Offer Include:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Employer‑paid life & disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 7 Company Paid Holidays
  • 24/7 Telemedicine & Employee Assistance Program

Purpose of Position:


Del Monte Foods is the Foods Division of Fresh Del Monte, a global grower, producer and marketer of fresh, value-added, and shelf-stable produce. Del Monte Foods has a powerful portfolio of brands, including the iconic Del Monte®, Contadina® and S&W®. We are currently seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Manager. The Senior Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for providing leadership, oversight, support, and coordination of food safety, quality assurance and technical activities for the Plover facility and the Rochelle, IL distribution center. This role supports full compliance with company policies and procedures, food safety modernization requirements, regulatory standards, customer requirements, and internal quality systems.

The Senior Quality Assurance Manager serves as a key member of the plant leadership team and works closely with operations, maintenance, sanitation, warehousing, customer service, supply chain, and corporate quality teams to support food safety, quality systems, sanitation, audits, product disposition, traceability, training, and continuous improvement efforts. This position reports to the Senior Director of Food Safety and Quality.


Accountabilities:

Food Safety & Quality Systems

  • Lead quality assurance and safety programs for the Plover facility and Rochelle Distribution Center.
  • Coordinate implementation of company quality standards, food safety programs, and technical services requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with local, state, federal, customer, and company food safety and quality requirements.
  • Oversee HACCP, FSMA, GMP, sanitation, allergen, food defense, traceability, and recall programs.
  • Manage product hold, disposition, corrective action, root cause investigation, and complaint resolution processes.
  • Review and approve quality procedures, specifications, forms, records, and work instructions.
  • Lead plant quality system reviews and monitor progress against quality objectives and action plans.
  • Facilitate internal audits, customer audits, regulatory inspections, and third-party audits including BRCGS, SQF, AIB, and customer-specific standards.
  • Coordinate mock recalls, traceability exercises, annual quality reviews, and audit readiness activities.
  • Monitor non-conformances, quality alerts, food safety incidents, and corrective action follow-up.
  • Review label copy, packaging graphics, and specification documentation for accuracy and compliance.
  • Support supplier quality, co-pack quality, private label requirements, and vendor compliance activities.
  • Partner with operations teams on product launches, process changes, commissioning activities, and new equipment validation.
  • Maintain current product specifications, grading standards, quality metrics, and documentation systems.
  • Coordinate and supervise warehouse staffing levels to support operational requirements and budget targets.

Leadership and Supervision

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high‑performing FSQ team, ensuring strong technical capability, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Provide clear direction and daily leadership to FSQ supervisors, specialists, and technicians to ensure consistent execution of food safety and quality programs across all shifts.
  • Build a proactive, ownership‑driven culture by empowering teams to identify risks, escalate issues early, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Partner closely with Operations, Sanitation, Maintenance, and Supply Chain leaders to align priorities, resolve issues, and strengthen cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Oversee staffing, training, and competency development to ensure the FSQ team is audit‑ready, compliant, and capable of supporting a fast‑paced manufacturing environment.
  • Model strong leadership behaviors—communication, integrity, decision‑making, and calm under pressure—while fostering a safe, inclusive, and high‑trust work environment.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance

  • Drive continuous improvement efforts related to food safety, product quality, sanitation, audit readiness, and customer satisfaction.
  • Identify trends, analyze data, and develop action plans to reduce complaints, defects, holds, and non-conformances.
  • Support implementation of Del Monte Production Systems (DMPS) and other lean manufacturing initiatives.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and communicate results to plant leadership.
  • Participate in plant startup, commissioning, capital project, and process improvement activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations, industry trends, audit standards, and emerging quality risks.
  • Support training programs related to GMPs, HACCP, food safety, sanitation, quality systems, and regulatory compliance.
  • safe operation of powered industrial equipment and warehouse machinery.

Minimum Skills Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Sciences or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of GMPs, HACCP, FSMA, GFSI, BRCGS, SQF, AIB, sanitation, allergen control, traceability, and food defense programs.
  • PCQI certification required or ability to obtain.
  • Strong understanding of food manufacturing quality systems, audits, regulatory compliance, and customer requirements.
  • Ability to lead, coach, motivate, and develop employees in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with all levels of employees, leadership, customers, vendors, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills with the ability to identify trends, solve problems, and drive corrective actions.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with SAP, specification systems, traceability systems, and quality management software.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English effectively.

Preferred:

  • 7-10 years of quality assurance experience in a food manufacturing environment.
  • Better Process Control School certification preferred.
  • Previous leadership experience within quality assurance, food safety, or regulatory functions.
  • Experience supporting distribution centers, warehousing, and finished goods quality programs.
  • Experience with product disposition, complaint management, audit leadership, supplier quality, and specification systems.
  • Familiarity with co-pack operations, private label programs, and customer-specific quality requirements.
  • Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and cross-functional project leadership.

***Please note: This position does not qualify for relocation expenses. ***

description:
Overview

SimVentions is 100% employee-owned and recognized as a Top Virginia Employer for Interns!

Are you ready to take your passion for technology to the next level? Our immersive internship experience is designed to provide aspiring tech enthusiasts like you with the opportunity to dive headfirst into the world of innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving.

Join our team as an Engineering Intern – Systems and Test:

Support systems engineering and test activities across the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system integration, test planning, execution, and documentation. Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate system performance, identify issues, and support verification and validation.

Each year SimVentions invites a select number of students to join us for our immersive 11-week paid internship program where you will experience our outstanding company culture while gaining valuable experience that you can implement into your post graduate professional career.

Eligibility:

SimVentions offers internship opportunities across a variety of technical disciplines, including systems engineering, software engineering, modeling & simulation, and cybersecurity engineering. Priority consideration will be given to returning interns and students pursuing degrees that align with our core technical areas. Students pursuing degrees in other fields may be considered on a case-by-case basis.

All applicants must have completed their Freshman year of college and not yet graduated by the beginning of the summer internship period (i.e., must be a rising sophomore, junior, or senior). Deadlines:All resumes with attached cover letters must be received no later than December 31, 2026. Any resumes received after this time will not be considered. Notification: All candidates will be notified of their selection status no later than March 2027.

Clearance

A Clearance is not required for our internship program but all candidates must be eligible to obtain a clearance.

Requirements

  • Completed Freshman year of college by the start of the internship (must be a rising sophomore, junior, or senior).
  • Enrolled in a relevant degree program such as systems engineering, software engineering, cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in technology, innovation, and problem-solving.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Proficient in basic programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++ (depending on your field of interest).
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive, eager-to-learn attitude with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Previous experience or coursework in systems engineering, software development, or cybersecurity is a plus.

Responsibilities

Engineering Intern – Systems and Test

Support systems engineering and test activities across the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system integration, test planning, execution, and documentation. Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate system performance, identify issues, and support verification and validation.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals to contribute to real-world engineering, software, and cybersecurity projects.
  • Participate in hands-on development, testing, and troubleshooting tasks within your assigned team.
  • Assist with the creation, implementation, and validation of engineering models, simulations, or software applications.
  • Contribute to the documentation of technical processes and findings.
  • Participate in team meetings, provide updates, and receive mentorship from senior engineers and project managers.
  • Learn and apply cutting-edge technologies and best practices in systems engineering, software development, and cybersecurity.
  • Conduct research and assist with the development of solutions to current technical challenges.
  • Engage in various learning and networking activities, such as training sessions, workshops, and company-sponsored events.

Compensation

The projected compensation range for this position is $18.00 - $22.00/Hour (USD).

Why Work for SimVentions?

  • Hands-on Experience: Gain practical, real-world experience working on impactful projects alongside industry experts
  • Mentorship: Receive guidance and mentorship from seasoned professionals who are invested in your growth and success
  • Networking: Connect with like-minded peers and expand your professional network through networking events and social activities
  • Career Development: Access to training sessions, workshops, and resources to enhance your skills and prepare you for a successful career in technology
  • Impactful Work: Make a difference by contributing to projects that are revolutionizing industries and shaping the future of technology

title: Cultivation Agent
description:
Cultivation Agents are not only the caretakers of beautiful budding plants but help keep the plants healthy and on schedule as they get closer to harvest. How? By working closely with the Cultivation Manager and regularly inspecting plants for any kinds of disease, deficiencies, insets, mold, etc.
  • Expected to work all scheduled work days, during scheduled hours and report to work on time.
  • Assist with plant management, including but not limited to fertilization, insect and disease monitoring, sanitation, and overall plant growth, health, and appearance in the grow rooms.
  • Monitor and maintain quality control measures in accordance with State and local laws.
  • At the direction of management, clone, trim, prune, top and train plants.
  • Maintain a clean and safe working environment within the facility and production areas.
  • Follow company policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Keep Cultivation Managers informed of any system discrepancies.
  • Inspect plants for diseases, deficiencies, insects, and mold, and report concerns to management for remediation.
  • Follow plant schedules to keep an accurate forecast of plant and production needs.
  • Catalog, track, and organize plants from clone-to-harvest using the track and trace system.
    • Sterilize cultivation equipment and tools, including light reflectors, containers, and ventilation equipment.
  • Update grow logs with nutrient and/or substance application to any plants within the facility.
  • Support additional cultivation and harvest teams as needed to meet facility production goals.
  • Ability to follow instruction and perform repetitive tasks.
  • Minimum of 1 year working experience, preferably in a warehouse, production, or manufacturing setting. (Cultivation is a plus)
  • Basic knowledge of plant structure and horticulture preferred.
  • Have a positive attitude and work well with others in a team.
  • Curious and willing to learn how to operate and maintain facility equipment in a safe manner.
  • Must be comfortable with heights, soil and water, and narrow spaces.
  • Able to safely climb, squat, bend, twist, kneel and stand for at least 8 hours per day, and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be 21 years of age or older, and able to successfully register with the state’s cannabis commission as an agent.
  • Must comply with all laws, regulations, and policies associated with the industry.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Paid Time Off

  • Life Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
