title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Field, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Field area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Field requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Invoicing Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

The Invoicing Specialist is responsible for accurate and timely customer invoicing related to managed service agreements, recurring contracts, and service ticket activity. This role works primarily in ConnectWise and NetSuite, ensuring all billable services are properly captured, invoiced, and aligned with customer terms. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, process-driven, and experienced in a high-volume MSP billing environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Agreement & Recurring Billing

· Generate and process monthly recurring invoices for managed service agreements in ConnectWise

· Ensure billing aligns with contract terms, pricing schedules, and service bundles

· Maintain accurate agreement billing setups, including additions, removals, and renewals

Service Ticket Invoicing

· Review service tickets for completeness, accuracy, and billable status

· Invoice time, materials, and project-related services based on approved ticket activity

· Partner with service delivery teams to resolve billing discrepancies or missing documentation

System & Invoice Management

· Sync invoicing activity between ConnectWise and NetSuite to ensure proper financial posting

· Maintain clean billing data and ensure invoices are coded correctly to customers and services

· Support invoice delivery workflows and respond to customer billing inquiries

Sales Order & Project Billing

· Take point on the transition from Sales to Operations by creating Sales Orders and structural Billing Agreements.

· Execute monthly billing for all active projects, managing the complexities of both Fixed Fee milestones and Time & Materials (T&M) projects.

· Generate and process all sales orders & project invoices daily.

Credit Memo Processing

· Credit Requests: Working with CSM & approvers to identify & process credits

· Identify Route Cause: fix any underlying cause, if applicable, in customer agreements

· Credit Memo Reporting: Maintain the credit memo database & produce monthly report

Process Improvement & Controls

· Assist in improving invoicing accuracy, cycle times, and standard billing procedures

· Support month-end close activities related to invoicing and deferred revenue

· Ensure compliance with internal controls and documentation standards

Skills & Competencies

· High-volume invoicing accuracy

· Strong organizational and communication skills

· Comfortable working cross-functionally with operations and finance

· Proficiency in Excel and billing analytics

Qualifications:

Technical Skills

• 2+ years of hands-on invoicing or billing experience, preferably in a service company environment

• Experience working with accounting or billing software Connectwise

• Familiarity with MSP or recurring revenue billing environments preferred

• Basic understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition

• Account reconciliation experience a plus

• Microsoft Office proficiency — Excel, Word, Teams

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred (or equivalent experience)

Additional Skills:

• Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy

• Ability to follow and consistently adhere to documented SOPs

• Meets deadlines, especially during month-end close

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Customer-first mindset when handling billing inquiries

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize effectively

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team

Benefits:

· Competitive salary

· Comprehensive health benefits

· Unlimited paid time off

· Opportunities for professional growth and development

· Collaborative and supportive team environment

title: Assistant Manager - Cybersecurity Threat Management
description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and strategic Manager - Cybersecurity Threat Management to lead our threat management initiatives. In this leadership role, you will be responsible for overseeing the detection, analysis, and mitigation of cybersecurity threats to safeguard the organization's critical information assets and infrastructure.

You will drive the development and execution of advanced threat intelligence programs and incident response strategies, collaborating with various teams to ensure a proactive and effective security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the cybersecurity threat management program, including threat intelligence collection, analysis, and dissemination.
  • Oversee incident detection and response activities, ensuring timely and effective handling of security incidents.
  • Develop and implement advanced threat hunting and mitigation strategies tailored to organizational risks and needs.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enhance threat intelligence sharing and coordination.
  • Manage and mentor the cybersecurity threat management team, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing.
  • Prepare and present threat intelligence reports and risk assessments to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Stay abreast of emerging threats, tactics, and technologies, integrating new knowledge into threat management processes.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant cybersecurity standards, policies, and regulations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity threat management, incident response, or related fields.
  • Deep understanding of threat intelligence frameworks, security operations, and incident response methodologies.
  • Proven leadership and team management experience.
  • Familiarity with advanced threat detection tools and technologies.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Threat Intelligence Analyst (CTIA), or GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) are highly desirable.

Benefits

Comprehensive benefits package

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer / Bern, Switzerland

Location: Bern, Switzerland / hybrid

Employment Type: Permanent

Start Date: ASAP (up to 3 months notice considered)

Native or fluent German (Swiss German preferred) is mandatory

We are currently seeking an experienced Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to join a leading technology and cloud services organisation based in Bern, Switzerland.

The successful candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure environments. This is an excellent opportunity for a senior-level engineer who is passionate about cloud technologies, automation, and DevOps best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, testing, and deployment processes
  • Ensure high availability, security, performance, and scalability of cloud environments
  • Support both cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure solutions
  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows environments
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions
  • Apply DevOps best practices related to automation, version control, and continuous improvement
  • Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making
  • Support incident management, root-cause analysis, and service optimisation
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and documentation

Required Experience

  • Proven experience as a Senior DevOps Engineer or Azure DevOps Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure
  • Extensive experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet or similar technologies
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Solid Linux and/or Windows Server administration skills
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar)
  • Experience with Git and version control best practices
  • Good understanding of cloud security, networking, and governance
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and deployment issues
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

Desirable Skills

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-900, DevOps Engineer Expert)
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS)
  • Knowledge of secret management and configuration management practices
  • Experience working within enterprise-scale or regulated environments
  • Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proactive and self-motivated approach
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical solutions
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Collaborative mindset and experience working within agile environments

Please note: Applicants must be eligible to work in Switzerland and possess fluent/native-level German language skills to be considered for this position.

title: Operations Team Lead
location: GRC Outlet Recyc Transp, Austin, TX, US
description:
The Operations Team Lead supports daily execution of Distribution Center operations by serving as a working lead and subject-matter expert across outlet, warehouse, and dock functions. This role provides on-the-floor guidance, training support, and task coordination during assigned shifts while reinforcing safety, standard operating procedures, and productivity expectations. This position does not have direct supervisory or employee relations responsibilities.


Role and Responsibilities

  • Provide shift-level coordination and direction for assigned work areas, including organizing workflow, prioritizing tasks, and ensuring execution aligns with operational goals.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on Distribution Center processes, equipment, and safety standards.
  • Train, coach, and mentor team members by modeling correct procedures, reinforcing SOPs, and supporting new employee onboarding.
  • Provide real-time feedback and guidance to employees to reinforce performance expectations and adherence to standards.
  • Monitor workflow and identify operational issues, escalating concerns and recommending solutions to management.
  • Conduct daily safety checks of distribution centers and report findings to manager.
  • Conduct daily equipment inspections of forklifts, balers, cart tippers, and other material handling equipment and report findings to manager. Take appropriate action from manager as directed (e.g. using equipment tag-outs for equipment in need of service or repair).
  • Conduct opening and closing procedures for the outlet and warehouse in support of the manager.
  • Ensure a safe and clean environment for customers and staff within the distribution center.
  • Assist with customer questions or escalations on the sales floor.
  • Assist in coordinating Logistics activities within the Distribution Center.
  • Support shift continuity in the absence of the Assistant Site Manager by escalating issues, maintaining communication, and ensuring safe and efficient operations.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Supervisory Responsibility

This role does not have direct reports and does not perform employee relations functions such as hiring, corrective action, performance evaluations, or terminations. The Team Lead may provide day-to-day work direction and operational guidance during shifts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • Forklift certification or ability to be certified within 30 days in role.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in retail, warehousing, logistics, or recycling operations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including writing and reading emails, Excel, and familiarity with D365 or similar ERP systems.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills; bilingual English/Spanish a plus.
  • Valid Texas Driver License.
  • Experience working with or advocating for marginalized communities is highly valued.
  • Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs as needed and walk warehouse floors and outdoor lots.
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, or crouching in operational areas.
  • Exposure to dust, heat/cold and outdoor work areas.
  • Must be able to safely navigate GCT outlet and post-retail facilities.
  • Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled facility.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Goodwill Central Texas is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all Team Members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Background Check Requirement:

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment background check. This may include verification of employment history, education, criminal background, and other information relevant to the position.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Wheeling, West Virginia.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Wheeling area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Wheeling requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Audit Project Manager-Audit Data Analytics and Automation
description:
The Audit Project Manager, Internal Audit Data Analytics & Automation is responsible for building and administering the organization's internal audit data analytics program from the ground up. This role will design the analytics strategy, select and implement tools and methodologies, and establish repeatable processes that embed data-driven techniques into the audit lifecycle, from risk assessment and planning through fieldwork, continuous monitoring, and reporting. Working closely with audit leadership and engagement teams, this individual will develop scripts, dashboards, and automated routines that extract, transform, and analyze data from enterprise systems to identify risk indicators, control exceptions, and process anomalies across the organization's global operations.

Beyond building the program, this role will administer it on an ongoing basis, maintaining analytics infrastructure, managing access and data governance considerations, training audit staff on tools and techniques, and continuously enhancing capabilities to keep pace with the organization's evolving systems and risk landscape. The ideal candidate combines strong technical proficiency in data analytics and automation with a solid understanding of internal audit methodology, internal controls, and risk management, and is comfortable operating with significant autonomy to establish a new capability within the function.

• Design, build, and implement the internal audit function's data analytics and automation program, including strategy, methodology, tool selection, and governance.

• Administer the analytics program on an ongoing basis, including maintaining infrastructure, managing data access and security considerations, and overseeing version control of scripts and models.

• Develop and maintain scripts, queries, and automated workflows (e.g., Python, SQL, ACL/Diligent, Power BI, or similar tools) to extract and analyze data from enterprise systems.

• Partner with audit managers and engagement teams to identify opportunities where analytics and automation can enhance risk assessment, test design, sample selection, and audit execution.

• Build continuous auditing and continuous monitoring routines that flag control exceptions, anomalies, and emerging risk indicators between formal audit cycles.

• Create and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations that communicate audit results, key risk indicators, and program metrics to audit leadership, the Audit Committee, and the Board.

• Translate business and audit requirements into technical specifications, and validate that analytics outputs are accurate, reliable, and audit-ready (i.e., fully documented and reperformable).

• Train, mentor, and provide hands-on support to audit staff to build broader data analytics literacy and adoption across the department.

• Stay current on emerging analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence tools and techniques relevant to internal audit, and recommend enhancements to the program accordingly.

• Ensure analytics work adheres to data governance, information security, and privacy requirements, in coordination with IT and information security teams.

• Support special projects, investigations, and ad hoc analyses requested by audit leadership, the Audit Committee, or executive management.

• Document methodologies, source data mappings, and analytic routines to ensure continuity, repeatability, and knowledge transfer within the department.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in internal audit, risk management, or a related field, with demonstrated handson experience building or supporting data analytics programs.

• Proficiency in data querying and analysis using SQL and at least one scripting/analytics language such as Python or R.

• Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, or similar.

• Experience with audit analytics or GRC platforms (e.g., ACL/Diligent) strongly preferred.

• Solid understanding of internal audit methodology, internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO), and risk assessment concepts.

• Ability to work independently to design new processes and capabilities in an environment with limited existing infrastructure.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical analytics work into clear insights for non-technical audit and business stakeholders.

• Experience working with large, complex data sets from general ledger, payments, treasury, or other enterprise systems in a global organization preferred.

• Professional certification such as CIA, CISA, CDA, or CPA preferred, or willingness to obtain within an agreed timeframe.

• Prior experience in financial services, payments, or a multinational corporate environment is a plus.

Responsibilities

The Associate Claims Examiner (ACE) utilizes general understanding of department’s operation and objectives. They are responsible for entering claim indemnity payments, SROI filing, issue Benefit Notices, complete void/stop payment, and reissuing of checks with a 99% timeliness goal. The ACE position will provide customer service to the claims department, and assist Claims Technical and Operations with other duties as needed and as time allows. This position will make inquiries with claims examiners, medical providers and injured workers, as needed, to assess return to work status and determine whether further payments should be issued. This position acts in a fiduciary role on behalf of insureds in assessing the need for indemnity payments. Job functions are considered routine and predefined and require minimum evaluation. The ACE administers the payment of benefits with the utmost, good faith, in compliance with the rules, regulations and statutes of the State of California and the WCAB. The ACE must be a team player.

This position requires particular attention to detail, and is often task-oriented. This position will require 120 hours of classroom training at Supervisor’s direction within the first year in position in order to obtain Experienced Examiner Certification. 30 hours of continuing education every two years is required to maintain that certification.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Make indemnity payments to claimants, both lump sum and ongoing payments, including initial, final and retroactive periods.
  • Issue Benefit Notices as required with regards to the start, changing and ending of benefits.
  • Will issue Permanent Disability denials in certain circumstances and notify claims examiner with an Activity.
  • Transmit Second Report of Information (SROI) to the State of California as required.
  • Gather and document information from medical providers on disability status of claimants.
  • Referral to Return to Work Coordinator who will gather and document information from insureds on return to work status of their injured employees as well as availability of modified or alternate duties. Follow up on return to work status, through coordinator, until an offer is made or a final decision not to accommodate is made.
  • Refers cases as appropriate to management by setting an activity for review.
  • Maintains professional client relationships.
  • Timely and appropriate notification to examiner on cases with indemnity payments, on need for appropriate reserves to ensure adequacy for life of claim.
  • Coordinate and process void, stop pay, and reissue Indemnity payments.
  • Offer and, if accepted, enroll claimants in our EFT program.
  • Attend Examiner Certification training as directed by Supervisor.
  • Upon certification as an Experienced Examiner, additional duties may be added including, but not limited to, drafting of settlement documents and calculation of wage statements.
  • Assist technical and operations with other duties as needed and as time allows.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of related administrative office work experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail and deadline structures.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with all levels of staff.

title: Systems & Application Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Systems & Applications Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, support, and continuous improvement of the organization's server infrastructure, enterprise technology platforms, and business applications. This role helps ensure the reliability, security, and performance of critical systems while providing technical support for internally developed and third-party business applications.

The ideal candidate combines strong systems administration skills with application support experience and is comfortable working across a diverse technology environment including Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, Microsoft 365 services, storage systems, security technologies, and business applications.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Administration

• Administer and maintain Windows and Linux server environments.

• Support virtualization platforms and associated infrastructure.

• Assist with storage, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.

• Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure operational stability.

• Perform system patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management activities.

• Manage identity and access controls, including Active Directory and related services.

• Support cloud-based infrastructure and SaaS platforms.

• Participate in infrastructure projects and technology deployments.

Application Support

• Serve as a technical resource for internally developed and third-party business applications.

• Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues.

• Coordinate incident resolution with software developers, vendors, and business stakeholders.

• Participate in application deployment, testing, and change management activities.

• Create and maintain application support documentation and procedures.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and application optimization.

• Assist in supporting application integrations and data workflows between business systems.

Security & Compliance

• Support cybersecurity initiatives, vulnerability remediation, and security best practices.

• Assist with audit, compliance, and documentation requirements.

• Participate in incident response and root cause analysis activities.

• Ensure systems adhere to organizational security standards and policies.

Operations & Support

• Provide technical support and escalation assistance for complex issues.

• Participate in on-call support rotations as required.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts and administrative tools.

• Coordinate with technology vendors and support providers.

• Document system configurations, procedures, and operational standards.

• Collaborate with business units to understand and support operational requirements.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.

• 4-7 years of experience administering enterprise infrastructure and business systems.

• Experience with Windows Server and Linux administration.

• Experience with VMware or similar virtualization platforms.

• Experience administering Microsoft 365 services.

• Experience supporting business-critical applications.

• Working knowledge of networking, storage, backup, and cybersecurity concepts.

• Experience with scripting and automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting internally developed business applications.

• Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud services.

• Experience with enterprise backup, monitoring, and logging platforms.

• Experience supporting ERP platforms, payment processing solutions, or application integrations.

• Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Azure, AWS, Linux, or Security+.

title: SSDS Software Engineer - JobID-0291
description:
About The Role:
Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT), a leading defense technology company, is seeking a SSDS Software Engineer to be part of our Advanced Capabilities team and based out of our Arlington, VA location.
This SSDS Software Engineer will focus heavily on designing, developing, integrating, and testing tactical combat system software interfaces, specifically interacting with naval combatants (SSDS), fire control loops, and self-defense systems (RAM/CIWS). This role requires full-time presence on-site at our Arlington, VA office.
Clearance & Location Requirements:
  • All applicants must currently possess an active Secret U.S. Security Clearance.
  • This is a fully on-site position, based out of our Arlington, VA location.
What You Will Do:
  • Design, implement, and test high-performance tactical software components using modern C++ or Java.
  • Integrate software components with complex Navy tactical combat systems, specifically developing interfaces and middleware wrappers for SSDS, RAM, or CIWS data streams.
  • Build low-latency software interfaces to transport tactical messages across network protocols (TCP/UDP, DDS, ActiveMQ, Kafka).
  • Prototype next-generation automated testing solutions and support integration within IDT labs and on-site Navy land-based test sites (LBTS).
  • Translate complex tactical Navy weapon specifications and ICDs (Interface Control Documents) into functional, automated test scripts and software requirements.
Who You Are (Required):
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or other STEM field (or equivalent full-time professional experience)
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in the design, development, and management of complex software systems for the DoD.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time as needed
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C++ or Java, with an understanding of memory management and real-time execution constraints.
  • Navy Combat Systems Exposure: Hands-on software development or integration experience supporting tactical Navy programs (such as SSDS, RAM, or CIWS).
  • Tactical Networking: Experience with publish-subscribe middleware like DDS (Data Distribution Service) and standard network protocols.
  • Development Workflow: Proficiency with Git/SVN, Jira, Confluence, and working within structured Software Development Life Cycles (SDLC).
What Makes You Stand Out:
  • DevOps & Containers: Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman), orchestration (Kubernetes, Swarm), and deployment automation (Ansible, Salt, Terraform).
  • CI/CD Tools: Experience with Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and GitLab CI pipelines.
  • Infrastructure: Experience with virtualization (VMware ESXi) and configuring basic network topologies (VLANs, routing).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

At each location, our employees work together in a modern, snack-filled, and social office space, designing innovative solutions for our defense industry customers. title: Inventory Specialist
description:
JOB PURPOSE

An Inventory Specialist oversees product levels including, storing, receiving, and distributing processes of an organization’s products and supplies. This also includes weekly cycle counts to ensure all product match inventory tracking system. Their main duties include controlling the flow of supplies and equipment, tracking, and analyzing inventory levels and developing protocols for loss mitigation.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Follow inventory tracking system to optimize inventory control.

· Examine the levels of supplies, components, and raw material to determine shortages.

· Document daily deliveries and shipments to update inventory.

· Prepare detailed reports on inventory operations, stock levels, and adjustments.

· Evaluate new inventory to ensure it is ready for shipment.

· Perform daily analysis to predict potential inventory problems.

· Order new supplies to avoid inefficiencies or excessive surplus.

· Checking Receiving Dock for shipments and deliveries.

· Working with Buyer/Planner and production manager to keep inventory up-to-date and ensuring quantities in NetSuite match actual inventory.

· Assist in supplying the line with needed part quantities for daily builds.

· Adhere to guidelines and procedures to ensure the safe handling, removal, and disposal of both hazardous and non-hazardous materials.

· All other duties, as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS


Required Qualifications include:

· Must be at least 18 years old.

· Associate degree

· 2+ years of previous experience or equivalent combination of education and experience

· Able to work well under stress and maintain a professional and positive attitude.

· Ability to focus on tedious tasks and see projects through to the end by breaking them down into smaller, manageable tasks.

· Extremely high attention to detail, with the ability to multi-task

· Ability to analyze information, maintain records, organize data, and use reference material to write reports.

· Ability to work independently with limited supervision, but also able to work effectively and efficiently in a team environment and delegate tasks.

· Must be energetic, motivated, self-directed, and enthusiastic.

· Maintain a positive attitude, be goal-oriented and focused on the overall strategic picture of the organization and follow through with tasks assigned.

· Strong computer skills with everyday experience working with Microsoft products.

· Must possess a strong work ethic.

· Strong people skills, including effective communication both orally and written.

· Required to maintain confidentiality.


WORKING CONDITIONS

Work is performed in an operational warehouse environment, with some time spent in a typical office environment. Specific job assignments may require day, evening, weekend, or holiday hours. Overtime may be required.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Team members are constantly standing, walking, carrying, pulling/pushing, bending, seeing, kneeling, stooping, reaching, hearing, as well as handing paperwork, and computer and phone usage. Team members will be lifting objects weighing 50 lbs. or less regularly.

N/A

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Cybersecurity Engineer


Open Dealer Exchange (ODE), is seeking an Cybersecurity Engineer to support its workforce in Southfield, MI. As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will own and mature our identity security posture across a complex, multi-platform environment, serving as the primary driver of a structured role based access control (RBAC) program and a trusted technical advisor across infrastructure, IT, and development teams. The ideal candidate will have deep experience with Entra ID, Active Directory, identity lifecycle automation, and governing access in regulated enterprise environments. Open Dealer Exchange is a dynamic, exciting place to work. Open Dealer Exchange offers a hybrid work model as well as an excellent compensation/benefit package.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise RBAC: Build a cohesive role-based access control model across Entra ID, Active Directory, and Entra External ID, replacing ad hoc access grants with governed, role-aligned entitlements.
  • Lead identity lifecycle automation: Integrate the HR system with Entra ID to automate provisioning and deprovisioning, ensuring access changes are event-driven and auditable at the point of hire, transfer, and termination.
  • Govern directory structure and access hygiene: Define and enforce naming conventions, group structures, and access review cadences across all directory platforms.
  • Manage non-human identities: Govern service accounts, including managed identities, service principals, and app registrations, enforcing least privilege and credential hygiene across all environments.
  • Advise development teams on identity security: Provide architectural guidance on token handling, session management, and federation patterns for teams building or maintaining identity adjacent systems.
  • Drive Conditional Access and PIM: Lead Conditional Access policy design and own Privileged Identity Management configuration and the privileged access model for admin roles across Azure and M365.
  • Support Entra External ID governance: Advise teams on External ID tenant configuration, custom policy, user flows, and external identity federation.
  • Produce compliance-ready documentation: Maintain IAM documentation including access control matrices, provisioning runbooks, and audit-ready entitlement inventories supporting FCRA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations.
  • Collaborate across the security program: Align IAM initiatives with the broader security roadmap and participate in change management and architecture review processes alongside security engineers and the Cybersecurity Manager.

title: Cattle Doctor - Wrangler Feedyard
description:
About the Company:

Cactus Feeders is an Amarillo, Texas-based cattle company. Originally founded by the Engler Family in 1975, today we operate 15 Feedyards and Outside Cattle Locations, producing over a million head of fed cattle annually. The Company has locations throughout the Texas Panhandle, Southwest Kansas, and Eastern Colorado.

Location:

Wrangler Feedyard in Tulia, Texas

Job Description:

A Cattle Doctor is responsible for providing daily care of the cattle through proper diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of illness. This position operates within the Cattle Department, where cattle doctors follow established company animal health protocols under the guidance and training of the company veterinarian to ensure optimal health, performance, and welfare of the cattle.


About the Position:

Cattle Doctor

  • Work under the supervision of the Cattle Manager and in alignment with animal health protocols developed by our staff veterinarian.
  • Perform daily pen checks to visually evaluate cattle for symptoms of illness, stress, or injury.
  • Accurately diagnose and administer appropriate treatments, including injections, oral medications, or topical applications.
  • Record all treatments and observations using standardized documentation systems to maintain animal health compliance.
  • Assist with necropsies and contribute to evaluations of treatment outcomes.
  • Communicate health concerns with other cattle teams, including pen riders and processing crew.
  • Help maintain cleanliness, organization, and inventory of animal health tools, medicines, and equipment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma, GED, or completion of technical/trade school preferred but not required.
  • Experience in cattle handling or livestock care is strongly preferred.
  • BQA (Beef Quality Assurance) certification in any segment is a plus.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a physically demanding, outdoor environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to animal welfare.
  • Willingness to work in varying weather conditions and shift tasks as needed.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly wages based on experience, skills, and qualifications.
  • Full-time position
  • Bi-weekly pay with direct deposit
  • Competitive & affordable health + dental + vision insurance packages
  • 100% paid retirement through Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • 401K
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Continuing Education Scholarships

Cactus Feeders provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Corporate & Foundation Relations Officer
company: By The Hand Club For Kids
description:
By The Hand Club For Kids is a Christian, after-school program that emphasizes academic excellence while nurturing the whole child – mind, body and soul. Located in Chicago’s most under-resourced neighborhoods, By The Hand helps children have abundant life. The culture of By The Hand is Christ-centered, people-focused and results oriented. While loving and nurturing, By The Hand has a strong results-orientation, a very structured program and a growth mindset that believes with hard work we can all continue to learn and grow.

Joining By The Hand’s incredible mission as an abundant life builder means jumping right into the work of healing and hope on behalf of our extraordinary children. You’ll have the opportunity of a lifetime to impact the trajectory of generations of stories; helping students soar to success in their academic performance, practice personal accountability and, even more importantly, grow in their understanding of God and their relationship with Jesus.

By The Hand is a not-for-profit, religious organization. Individuals employed at By The Hand are working in ministerial roles and perform all or some of the following responsibilities: sharing the Gospel, teaching chapel, leading Bible studies, discipling students, and modeling behavior that is consistent with Christ’s teaching.

Rate of Pay: $90,000 - $100,000 per year

Overview of Position

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Strategic Engagement, the Corporate and Foundation Relations (CF) Officer directly drives By The Hand’s fundraising efforts by actively managing a portfolio of major corporate and foundation relationships. In this high-impact role, the CF Officer will develop and execute targeted strategies to cultivate new funding partnerships, maximize current opportunities, and expand the organization’s grant footprint toward an overall fundraising goal exceeding $13 million. The CF Officer will be expected to manage the full fundraising cycle from identification to stewardship of all entities in their portfolio. To effectively drive partner relations and secure funding, the CF Officer will serve as a cross-functional catalyst—collaborating closely with the Grants Manager on grant writing and compliance, partnering with Volunteer Development to deliver high-quality corporate engagement experiences, and aligning with the broader Fund Development team to optimize every relational touchpoint. The CF Officer will be held accountable for meeting an individual fundraising goal through their identified portfolio, plus growth.

Spiritual Requirements

  • Has a personal and saving relationship with Jesus Christ, evidenced by a lifestyle that demonstrates the Word of God, and is in regular fellowship with other members in a Bible-believing church.

  • Agrees with the By The Hand Club Doctrinal Statement and adheres to the Employee Biblical Standards of Living.

  • Shows by example the importance of Scripture memorization, Bible study, prayer, witnessing and fellowship.

  • Integrates Biblical principles into all organizational objectives and goals.

  • Is ready to pray with and offer spiritual advice to staff, children, families, and others.

  • Is prepared to share religious beliefs with anyone who inquires.

Role Responsibilities

  • Performs in a way that is consistent with the vision, mission, and culture of By The Hand and commits to excellence in every aspect of the overall operation.

  • Models cultural values of By The Hand Club For Kids in day-to-day behavior.

  • Follows all policies as outlined in the operational guide, including maintaining brand standards and ensuring 100% adherence to the Child Protection Policy.

  • Participates in employee growth plans, including quarterly conversations and annual review meetings.

  • Develops and executes corporate and foundation fundraising strategies, in collaboration with the supervisor, that cultivate relationships and secure major gifts.

  • Plans and implements annual strategic cultivation plans with monthly action steps to achieve projections.

  • Proactively identifies new funding opportunities and works to maintain these opportunities.

  • Researches potential corporate and foundation grantors for solicitation and establishes effective, multifaceted communication with them.

  • Ensures timely submission of high-quality grant proposals; tracks grant proposals and takes steps to improve success rate.

  • Works with Grants Manager to ensure compliance with funder guidelines and stewardship of funder relationships.

  • Works closely with the Volunteer Development team to adhere to the Volunteer/Donor cycle and handoff criteria.

  • Supports corporate sponsorships and works to ensure a multifaceted engagement approach is implemented with corporate partners.

  • Tracks and reports corporate and foundation activities with an emphasis on progress toward achieving goals.

  • Tracks progress toward the portfolio goals on a weekly basis and attends a weekly team and individual check-in.

  • Records actions, notes, and other relevant information in the donor database.

  • Stays closely attuned to the corporate and foundation philanthropic community in order to identify and capitalize on all funding opportunities that might support new and existing By The Hand initiatives, including capital programs.

  • Sources and attends appropriate networking events to establish a presence in the community and meet new prospects.

  • Participates in larger fund development organizational projects when expertise and knowledge are applicable.

  • Performs all other duties as required and assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • This position requires a Christ-like servant leader who has a sense of calling and models Biblical principles.

  • Passion and commitment to urban student transformation, confidence to lead in a challenging situation, and belief that all children can learn.

  • Operates with high autonomy and initiative.

  • Proactively drives projects from concept to execution.

  • Outstanding problem-solving skills with an orientation toward results, action, impact, and influence.

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to determine the steps required to achieve overarching goals.

  • Ability to work both as a team player and independently.

  • Demonstrated strong relationship-building skills with children and adults.

  • Demonstrated ability to generate seven figures in revenue from foundations and corporations annually.

  • A successful track record in identifying and securing new corporate and foundation funders.

  • Understands performance management and corporate and foundation reporting requirements.

  • Superior written and oral communication skills; attention to detail, with a commitment to improving the quality and content of proposals, grants and reports.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with a diverse group of foundation and corporate contacts, including board members and influential stakeholders.

  • Results-oriented and driven with an entrepreneurial and innovative approach to fundraising.

  • Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Education and Experience

  • B.A. or B.S. in Non-profit, Marketing, Communication, Business, Education or related field.

  • At least 5 years of corporate and foundation fundraising experience preferred.

  • Ability to utilize database software, research programs, Microsoft Office, Ninety, Google Suite and Google Drive and all social media platforms.

  • Must have a valid driver's license, available transportation and their own auto insurance in order to travel around the city.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopies, filing cabinets and fax machines. This job is not a virtual job, but it requires in-person attendance as agreed upon by your immediate supervisor.

Physical Demands

The employee is regularly required to speak and listen. This role may require you to move equipment from room to room and lift up to 50 pounds. The individual is also required to travel throughout the city and to other organization sites to meet with partners, candidates, and staff.

Disclaimer

The duties and responsibilities described are not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee may be required to perform. The employee may be required to perform additional functions as necessitated by business demands. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. Employment with By The Hand Club For Kids is at will, and the employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation.

By The Hand is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified candidates with a disability, absent undue hardship. An employee or applicant who believes he or she has a disability and may require an accommodation must contact the Human Resources Department at hr@bythehand.org or call 773-854-4176.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Canton, Massachusetts.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Canton area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Canton requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Remote | Industrial Design CAD Expert — $40–$80/hour
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for experienced Industrial Design CAD professionals with strong expertise in mechanical engineering, aerospace, industrial design, and multi-part CAD assembly interpretation to contribute to an advanced AI training project focused on engineering design analysis.

Selected professionals will review complex CAD assemblies, interpret design intent and component relationships, and develop precise technical question-and-answer content grounded in real engineering data. The work requires strong CAD knowledge, careful technical reasoning, and the ability to produce objective, unambiguous, assessment-ready material. No prior experience in AI is required.

Key Responsibilities

CAD Assembly Interpretation & Design Analysis

  • Review complex multi-part CAD assemblies provided in native FreeCAD format
  • Analyse overall design intent, assembly structure, component relationships, and functional behaviour
  • Identify important mechanical features, interfaces, and technical nuances within each assembly
  • Apply industrial design, mechanical engineering, or aerospace knowledge when interpreting technical details
  • Evaluate assemblies with strong attention to accuracy, consistency, and engineering logic

Technical Question Development

  • Author clear, objective, and non-guessable technical questions based on assembly data
  • Develop several unique questions for each assigned assembly
  • Ensure question sets cover assembly structure, function, component relationships, and design considerations
  • Create prompts that require exact, technically grounded answers
  • Avoid ambiguity and ensure every question can be verified against the source assembly

Answer Authoring & Technical Validation

  • Produce precise and technically accurate answers supported by the underlying CAD data
  • Verify answers against geometry, assembly relationships, and available technical documentation
  • Review question-and-answer sets for clarity, consistency, and correctness
  • Identify unclear or insufficiently supported conclusions before final submission
  • Maintain strong standards for objective, assessment-ready technical content

Documentation & Project Collaboration

  • Produce clear technical documentation and structured engineering content
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively through written and verbal channels
  • Collaborate with project coordinators to clarify requirements and resolve ambiguities
  • Provide feedback and suggestions that improve project processes and content quality
  • Manage assigned deliverables independently while maintaining agreed quality standards and timelines

Ideal Profile

  • Demonstrated background in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, industrial design, or a closely related discipline
  • Strong foundational knowledge of CAD systems and engineering design principles
  • Expertise in interpreting multi-part assembly drawings, CAD files, and technical documentation
  • Proven ability to author technical documentation, assessment material, or other structured engineering content
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical precision
  • Familiarity with FreeCAD or comparable CAD environments
  • Direct FreeCAD experience is advantageous but not required
  • Ability to work independently and manage deliverables effectively in a remote environment
  • Strong interest in technical education, structured assessment, or expert-driven AI initiatives
  • No prior experience in AI research or model training is required

Engagement Details

  • Part-time independent contractor engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Compensation: $40–$80/hour
  • Work will involve CAD assembly interpretation, technical question authoring, answer development, engineering analysis, and documentation
  • Strong experience with multi-part CAD assemblies and technical design interpretation is important for this engagement
  • Familiarity with FreeCAD is beneficial but not mandatory
  • No prior experience in AI is required
  • Project scope, workload, timing, and duration may evolve depending on project requirements
  • Work must be completed without using confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, institution, or other third party

About the Platform

This opportunity is available through 24-MAG LLC. We connect experienced professionals with remote consulting opportunities across technical, evaluation, and project-based workstreams.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed by 24-MAG LLC for recruitment and opportunity matching in accordance with our Privacy Policy: ﻿

title: Head of Maintenance & Availability
description:
TAKE YOUR CAREER IN A NEW DIRECTION

At Eurostar, we’re fuelling the future of rail travel – operating in five countries and sparking new opportunities for travellers. But our trains connect much more than just people and places. They’re helping us build a greener, more inclusive future for everyone. Join us and you’ll be part of a passionate team which always goes the extra mile.

An exciting opportunity awaits you as Head of Maintenance & Availability in our Rolling Stock department. The Head of Maintenance & Availability plays a key role delivering the reliability, availability, and performance of the fleet. In this role you will mitigate capacity constraints, support depot modernisation to accommodate a new train fleet, whilst ensuring current fleets meet life-span objectives. The expected role outputs will be aligned with Eurostar Groups safety, environmental, and customer service objectives.

This permanent position is based in at our Temple Mills Depot in Leyton, with the expectation you attend site 4 days per week.

The close date for this role is 5pm on Tuesday, 29 September 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible; Eurostar reserves the right to contact candidates before close date and to close the role earlier if suitable candidates are identified.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone to:

  • Lead all Maintenance & Availability activities to ensure safe, reliable, and punctual train service delivery.
  • Drive depot operational performance, fleet availability, and reliability to meet commercial and transport plan commitments.
  • Champion a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with safety regulations, maintenance standards, and company policies.
  • Develop and implement strategies to increase depot capacity, support fleet growth, and prepare for future operational demands.
  • Manage budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation to deliver cost-effective operations.
  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams, including succession planning and capability development.
  • Foster strong relationships with key stakeholders across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, People, and external partners.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives, operational modernisation programmes, and industrialisation strategies across the depot.

You'll need...

  • Degree level qualification in Engineering or a related technical discipline
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in a train depot in technical and leadership roles, preferably supported by multiple years in a core Engineering function
  • Significant leadership experience within train depot operations
  • Strong track record of managing maintenance operations, fleet availability, and technical performance.
  • Advanced knowledge of depot operations, maintenance regimes, capacity planning, and operational delivery.
  • Proven ability to lead large teams, drive performance, and build a positive safety-first culture.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness with experience managing budgets, forecasts, and operational costs.
  • Highly developed analytical, planning, problem-solving, and disruption management capabilities.

Benefits

We’re constantly working to create a bright future for our company and our colleagues. That’s why we offer a wide range of brilliant benefits, including:

  • Travel benefits that can be used for both work and play including 75% off underground network from Day 1
  • Competitive defined benefit pension scheme
  • Free Eurostar tickets
  • Discounted Eurostar tickets for friends and family
  • Ongoing training and development
  • Free, confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Peer-to-Peer support from trained Mental Health First Aiders/Personne de Confiance
  • Lots of other exclusive deals, discounts and perks

A whole new platform for your career - If you think you’ve got what it takes to help us make Eurostar bigger and better than ever before then we’d love to hear from you.

At Eurostar we believe in giving everyone an equal chance. We actively encourage applications from talented individuals regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, marital status, whether you’re pregnant or on maternity leave.

Your individuality is your strength, and we want a diverse team that reflects the world we live in.

title: Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and delivery-focused Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer, who is passionate about developing innovative solutions using Agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate should have experience in designing, implementing, and optimizing Agentic workflow and building scalable, production-grade Agentic AI models.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, test, and manage day-to-day execution of AI projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and alignment to architectural design.
  • Translate architectural blueprints into executable components, prototypes, and production-ready services.
  • Oversee the development of GenAI applications, RAG pipelines, and agent-based solutions using frameworks like Langchain, LangGraph and Google ADK.
  • Work on data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model optimization.
  • Optimize performance of existing Agentic AI models and pipelines.
  • Review code, support reusable component development, and enforce engineering best practices.
  • Utilize cloud-based services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for model deployment and scaling.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and data science.
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve performance bottlenecks in applications.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in AI/ML engineering or software development using Python and its frameworks.
  • Experience delivering projects using GenAI, LLMs, or Transformer models and Agentic AI based solutions.
  • Solid understanding of prompt engineering, APIs, data preprocessing, and model integration.
  • Exposure to vector databases and RAG architectures for enterprise knowledge retrieval. Exposure to MCP and Agent to Agent Communication
  • Familiarity with SQL, NoSQL, and data warehousing solutions and ability to analyze complex datasets and derive meaningful conclusions.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes for AI model deployment.

title: Data Analyst, Insurance
description:
The Role

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics team in New York. Reporting to the Director of Analytics, you will play a key role in transforming data into insights that drive business decisions across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Underwriting.


This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in SQL and data visualization who is eager to grow their technical skills, business understanding, and impact in a fast-paced, collaborative fintech environment. You’ll work cross-functionally to uncover trends, optimize processes, and empower teams with data-driven insights that move the business forward.


Location
This is hybrid role based in NYC (3 days/week onsite).


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cross-functional projects with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Underwriting teams to understand requirements and develop reports that deliver actionable insights for key decision-makers.
  • Translate and analyze complex data sets to identify key business drivers, uncover trends, and highlight opportunities to improve performance and efficiency.
  • Create and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, integrating data from multiple sources to deliver a visual story, driving strong business decisions.
  • Own ad-hoc reporting across all internal teams to ensure business strategic alignment.
  • Leverage dbt to clean, structure, and transform data within the data warehouse, maintaining high-quality datasets for analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to address evolving data needs and ensure data consistency across the organization.
  • Document data definitions, reports, and structures to maintain clarity, scalability, and data integrity for all stakeholders.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst or business intelligence role within a Fintech or Insurance company
  • Hands-on experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experienced with SQL
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, including data mining, evaluation, and visualization.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented and curious about how data informs decisions across product, marketing, sales, and operations.


Nice to Have:

Working knowledge and experience with:

    • dbt (data build tool)
    • Snowflake
    • Git


Our Data Stack

Our analytics ecosystem is built on Snowflake for data warehousing, dbt for transformations, and Power BI for visualization and reporting. Data pipelines are managed through Stitch, with Dagster orchestrating automated workflows for file exports and email processes. All dbt projects are version-controlled in GitHub, ensuring reliability and collaboration across the team.


Benefits

  • Opportunities to make an impact within a fast growing company
  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance, beginning day one
  • Health savings account with employer contribution
  • Flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, commuter)
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • Flexible working hours
  • Paid parental leave
  • Company sponsored short and long term disability


Base Salary

The base salary range is between $115,000 - $145,000 annually.

Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location and current market data and may vary from the range above.



TheGuarantors is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all.
