Selected professionals will analyse detailed mechanical assemblies, interpret native CAD files and engineering drawings, and develop precise question-and-answer content grounded in real-world engineering data. The work requires strong technical judgement, careful attention to component relationships and design intent, and the ability to produce objective, assessment-ready technical material.

Key Responsibilities

Mechanical Assembly Analysis

  • Analyse complex multi-part mechanical assemblies provided in native FreeCAD format
  • Interpret component relationships, interfaces, geometry, and overall assembly design intent
  • Review engineering drawings and supporting technical information
  • Identify key mechanical functions, design considerations, and dimensional relationships
  • Apply sound engineering judgement when evaluating assembly behaviour and technical details

Technical Question Development

  • Develop objective, precise, and non-guessable question-and-answer sets for assigned assemblies
  • Create several detailed technical questions covering mechanical functions, design rationale, and dimensional considerations
  • Ensure each question is grounded in verifiable assembly data
  • Structure prompts so that answers are technically specific and unambiguous
  • Maintain alignment with real-world engineering standards and terminology

Answer Authoring & Technical Validation

  • Produce accurate and clearly written answers supported by the source assembly data
  • Verify technical conclusions against CAD geometry, drawings, and component relationships
  • Review question-and-answer pairs for logical consistency and technical correctness
  • Identify and clarify ambiguities before finalising deliverables
  • Maintain high standards for objectivity, precision, and assessment readiness

Documentation & Remote Collaboration

  • Prepare clear technical documentation and supporting notes where required
  • Communicate promptly with project coordinators regarding questions, ambiguities, or technical issues
  • Use written and verbal communication to clarify engineering requirements
  • Incorporate feedback and adapt deliverables to evolving project standards
  • Manage assigned work independently while maintaining agreed timelines and quality expectations

Ideal Profile

  • Proven background in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, industrial design, or a closely related discipline
  • Strong foundational and applied knowledge of CAD systems and engineering design principles
  • Expertise in analysing complex mechanical assemblies and interpreting engineering drawings
  • Familiarity with FreeCAD is advantageous
  • Experience with SolidWorks, CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, or comparable CAD platforms is highly relevant
  • Demonstrated ability to produce clear, precise, and objective technical documentation or assessment materials
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to explain technical insights clearly to varied audiences
  • Comfortable working independently and managing deliverables in a remote environment
  • Strong commitment to technical accuracy, consistency, and objective assessment

Engagement Details

  • Part-time independent contractor engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Compensation: $40–$80/hour
  • Work will involve mechanical assembly analysis, engineering drawing interpretation, technical question authoring, answer development, and documentation
  • Experience with complex CAD assemblies and technical design interpretation is important for this engagement
  • Familiarity with FreeCAD is beneficial, while experience with other major CAD platforms is also relevant
  • Project scope, workload, timing, and duration may evolve depending on project requirements
  • Work must be completed without using confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, institution, or other third party

This opportunity is available through 24-MAG LLC. We connect experienced professionals with remote consulting opportunities across technical, evaluation, and project-based workstreams.

The Talent Outreach Specialist supports the organization's early career talent strategy by developing and maintaining university partnerships, coordinating recruiting events, managing internship recruitment activities, and building talent pipelines for future hiring needs. title: Temporary Shipping & Receiving Associate
description:
Shipping & Receiving Associate

Montana Supply | Big Sky, Montana
Department: Operations
Position Type: Part-time, Temporary (October 15 - December 23)
Compensation: Hourly

About the Role

Montana Supply is seeking a dependable, organized, and experienced Shipping & Receiving Associate to join our Operations team in Big Sky.


The Shipping & Receiving Associate plays an important role in keeping our inventory and daily operations running smoothly. This position takes ownership of the day-to-day flow of incoming and outgoing merchandise, including receiving deliveries, processing inventory, maintaining backstock, replenishing the sales floor, fulfilling eCommerce orders, and keeping our stockroom organized and efficient.


This is a hands-on role that requires strong attention to detail, good judgment, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with our Shipping & Receiving, Merchandising, and Sales teams.

What You'll Do

Receiving & Inventory — 50%

  • Bring incoming deliveries to the receiving area within one hour of arrival.
  • Sort and inspect deliveries, verifying merchandise against purchase orders and invoices.
  • Identify deliveries that are past their cancellation date and communicate with the appropriate buyer or manager before receiving.
  • Receive and process deliveries accurately, efficiently, and according to established standards.
  • Ensure packages are processed within five business days of their initial delivery date.
  • Communicate receiving discrepancies, inventory issues, and delayed deliveries to the Shipping & Receiving Manager.
  • Compare actual shipments against purchase orders and invoices to identify discrepancies.
  • Prepare merchandise for the sales floor according to labeling and merchandising standards, including steaming apparel, labeling products, and sorting floor stock from backstock.
  • Restock the sales floor as needed and according to daily priorities.
  • Maintain accurate and organized backstock by returning loose or misplaced merchandise to its appropriate location as part of end-of-day procedures.

Restocking & Backstock Organization — 20%

  • Maintain a clean, organized, clearly labeled, and easily navigable backstock area.
  • Organize inventory according to established backstock procedures and evolving operational standards.
  • Receive and properly organize excess sales floor merchandise returned by the Sales or Visual teams.
  • Regularly assess the backstock area for efficiency, accessibility, and effective use of space.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to improve inventory flow, organization, labeling, and storage.

Stockroom Organization & Supplies — 20%

  • Maintain the overall organization and cleanliness of receiving and stockroom areas.
  • Monitor shipping and stockroom supplies and communicate replenishment needs.
  • Assist with scanning, filing, and organizing inventory documentation.
  • Support improvements to backstock flow, labeling, storage, and workspace efficiency.
  • Help maintain an organized and productive receiving environment throughout the workday.

Outgoing Shipments — 10%

  • Monitor eCommerce sales throughout the day and pull, package, and prepare customer orders for timely shipment.
  • Package authorized vendor returns according to established procedures.
  • Deliver outgoing packages to the appropriate drop-off location.
  • Pick up mail and packages from the post office three times per week.
  • Help ensure outgoing shipments are accurate, properly packaged, and completed on schedule.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in shipping, receiving, inventory, stockroom, warehouse, retail operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including shifts that may exceed eight hours.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to read, write, and perform basic math.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including familiarity with Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with Lightspeed Retail POS or another inventory management system is preferred.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is reliable, punctual, and trustworthy.
  • Takes ownership of their responsibilities and follows through.
  • Can prioritize competing demands and manage their time effectively.
  • Works confidently with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Notices problems and takes initiative to find practical solutions.
  • Communicates clearly and respectfully with coworkers across departments.
  • Is comfortable receiving feedback and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Takes pride in maintaining an organized, efficient workspace.
  • Looks for opportunities to improve processes rather than simply working around problems.
  • Brings a positive, collaborative attitude to the team.

Working Relationships

This position works closely with the Shipping & Receiving Manager, Merchandising Team, Sales Manager and Sales Team, and other members of the Operations team.


The Associate will receive daily priorities and operational guidance from the Shipping & Receiving Manager while taking independent ownership of assigned receiving, inventory, backstock, and shipping responsibilities.

Why Join Montana Supply?

The Shipping & Receiving Associate is an important part of the team behind Montana Supply's customer experience. When inventory is received accurately, backstock is organized, the sales floor stays replenished, and orders ship on time, the entire business runs better.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a hands-on environment, takes pride in getting the details right, and wants to make a tangible contribution to a small, collaborative team in Big Sky.

Additional Information

This is a temporary, part-time, hourly position based in Big Sky, Montana. The responsibilities listed above represent the primary functions of the role but are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, skills, or qualifications. Montana Supply may adjust responsibilities as business needs evolve.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Tacoma, Washington.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Tacoma area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Tacoma requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Grosse Pointe Park, Michigan.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Grosse Pointe Park area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Grosse Pointe Park requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Sr Systems Engineer
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:

General Dynamics Mission Systems is seeking a Sr Systems Engineer 2 to support the D5LE2 program within the SWC Fire Control engineering organization. The successful candidate will apply foundational systems engineering principles across the system development life cycle, contributing to the design, analysis, and verification of mission-critical fire control subsystems supporting the U.S. Navy's strategic deterrent. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer looking to build deep domain expertise in a safety-critical, long-horizon defense program while working alongside experienced systems engineers and technical leads.

What sets you apart:

  • Eagerness to learn and grow within a complex, safety-critical systems engineering environment​
  • Strong analytical foundation with developing proficiency in requirements management and system modeling tools​
  • Effective communicator who asks the right questions and escalates appropriately​
  • Collaborative team member who takes initiative on assigned tasks and seeks feedback​
  • Commitment to professional development and building domain expertise in fire control systems

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support requirements analysis, functional analysis, performance analysis, system design, trade studies, integration and test (verification) for D5LE2 subsystems under the guidance of senior engineers​
  • Assist in developing and maintaining system models and architectures using MBSE tools (Cameo/MagicDraw, DOORS) in support of D5LE2 program milestones​
  • Apply developing critical thinking skills to identify and escalate system design weaknesses with proposed solutions​
  • Perform interface definition studies of system components and products under direct supervision​
  • Research and analyze vendor products, COTS components, GFE/CFE, specifications, and manuals to determine feasibility of design or application​
  • Generate technical engineering products using appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools (T9001, SPALT, peer review)​
  • Develop system security documentation on both new and fielded information systems​
  • Plan and execute sub-tasks for assigned activities, tracking progress against schedule​
  • Support Modeling and Simulation activities in alignment with D5LE2 program objectives​
  • Participate in peer reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes​
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Solid understanding and application of systems engineering principles, concepts, and theories​
  • Solid use of tools for managing requirements (DOORS or equivalent) and modeling systems (Cameo/MagicDraw or equivalent)​
  • Developing familiarity with MBSE methodologies and digital engineering concepts​
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly report findings relevant to sound systems engineering design​
  • Solid ability to effectively use Microsoft Office tools for documentation, analysis, and presentation​
  • Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle complex assignments efficiently​
  • Understanding of the system development life cycle from concept through disposal​
  • Awareness of safety and surety principles in the context of strategic weapons systems

D5LE2 Program Context:

D5LE2 is the next-generation life extension of the Trident II D5 strategic weapons system, supporting the U.S. Navy's sea-based nuclear deterrent through the 2080s​

  • Key milestones: Preliminary Design Review (PDR) 2028, Critical Design Review (CDR) 2032​
  • Engineering team applies MBSE, digital engineering, and rigorous systems engineering processes in a safety-critical, CNWDI-controlled environment​
  • Part of the SWC Fire Control engineering organization (DE256) at General Dynamics Mission Systems, Pittsfield, MA

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits

Workplace Options:This position is fully onsite. While on-site, you will be a part of the team located in Pittsfield, MA

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $95,384.00 - USD $105,817.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Piedmont, California.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Piedmont area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Piedmont requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Analista Funzionale IT
description:
ZCA Digital è un’azienda nata dalla fusione di Sinergidea e di Zero Carbon Audit: riunendo in un’unica realtà ciò che le due aziende avevano da offrire, ZCA Digital intende rispondere alle esigenze del mercato IT e alla necessità di rendere il mondo digital più sostenibile. Proponiamo servizi di consulenza, di sviluppo software, servizi in campo ESG e nell’area del contact management. Abbiamo le nostre sedi a Milano e a Novara ed offriamo i nostri servizi sull’intero territorio nazionale.

Attualmente la nostra azienda è alla ricerca di un Analista Funzionale IT che segua le attività del cliente, realtà multinazionale dedicata allo sviluppo di prodotti e servizi destinati al settore finanziario e bancario.
Chi cerchiamo verrà coinvolto a tempo pieno nell'identificazione degli obiettivi di progetto condivisi dal cliente e tradurli in requisiti funzionali e tecnici che indirizzeranno le attività del gruppo di lavoro IT.

La persona individuata si occuperà primariamente dell'analisi e della raccolta dei requisiti, si interfaccerà con il team tecnico, elaborando la documentazione a corredo dell'attività. Il lavoro verrà realizzato in stretta collaborazione con tutto il personale coinvolto nel progetto e con il manager di riferimento, che coordinerà a livello di progetto le attività del team.

Per policy aziendale, è previsto che l'attività venga svolta nei primi mesi di lavoro in modalità ibrida, con tre gg a settimana in presenta in sede di Biella (BI). In seguito l'attività sarà da remoto con presenza occasionale in sede.

Con lo scopo di garantire l'operatività del gruppo di lavoro, è necessaria un'ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; potrà infatti essere necessario dover interagire con clienti terzi e interlocutori localizzati all'estero.



Requisiti

Questa posizione richiede una persona che abbia accumulato esperienza lavorativa nel ruolo e abbia operato in contesti strutturati, in modo che sappia operare in autonomia e sappia interfacciarsi con figure sia tecniche che manageriali.

Sono necessarie le seguenti competenze tecniche:
  • Java
  • Database relazionali
  • Sql
  • strumenti per la gestione del ciclo di vita del software
  • Jira/ Confluence
  • Git o strumenti similari
Inizio attività: il prima possibile
Tipologia contrattuale: collaborazione in p.iva o un contratto di assunzione (det. con rinnovi)
Retribuzione: max 250 e/gg (p.iva) o 31.000+ diaria (assunzione)
______________________________________

La ricerca è rivolta a tutte le persone, nel rispetto delle pari opportunità. Crediamo e supportiamo la diversità tra i/le nostri dipendenti e collaboratori/trici. Tutte le candidature verranno prese in considerazione e verranno valutate in base ai meriti della persona, a prescindere dal colore, razza, nazionalità, etnia, sesso, genere, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, disabilità, responsabilità genitoriale, seniority anagrafica, religione e credo.
 In conformità al GDPR, i dati personali verranno trattati esclusivamente ai fini dell’eventuale futura instaurazione di un rapporto di lavoro con la Società.

Si prega di inviare il CV dettagliato e con indicazione di autorizzazione al trattamento dei propri dati, nel rispetto delle norme vigenti.

title: Cost Engineer II
description:
Job Summary

The Cost Engineer II manages project costs, forecasts, commitments, changes, and financial reporting for a portfolio of capital projects.

This role works closely with project managers, planners, contractors, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure project cost information is accurate, current, and aligned with the project schedule. The Cost Engineer II works with a moderate level of independence, resolving day-to-day cost issues and escalating complex matters as needed.

The role engages directly with budget holders and project leadership to support sound business decisions and effective stewardship of project funds.


Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Cost Control & Forecasting

  • Maintain budgets, commitments, actual costs, Value of Work Done (VOWD), cash-flow phasing, accruals, and forecasts aligned to the project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
  • Prepare and review monthly Forecast Final Cost (FFC) reports and explain significant variances.
  • Ensure cost forecasts align with project schedules and actual work progress.
  • Flag cost issues to the project team early and propose solutions.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and semiannual forecasting and estimating processes.

Change Control & Governance

  • Track approved and pending changes, risks, threats, and opportunities in the cost tool.
  • Confirm budget changes and trends are documented and approved to maintain an accurate cost estimate and history of project performance.
  • Support the Project Controls Supervisor in running the change management process.
  • Verify the correct coding of purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and estimates, and maintain required cost logs and registers.
  • Follow PEMEX Deer Park cost engineering and project-control procedures.

Reporting & Systems

  • Maintain accurate cost information within SAP and other project-control systems.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and periodic cost reports for project teams, budget holders, and senior stakeholders.
  • Work with planners, project delivery managers, and the central cost team to explain variances against previous submissions.
  • Support reporting improvements and digital initiatives.
  • Capture cost data for use in future benchmarking and estimating.

Contractor & Vendor Cost Assurance

  • Ensure contractors meet the cost control requirements set out in their contracts.
  • Review contractor estimates, man-hour budgets, scope changes, and budget revisions.
  • Review contractor and supplier invoices and supporting documentation for payment.
  • Maintain cost documentation and records for audits and cost recovery.
  • Support benchmarking and contractor, subcontractor, and vendor reviews and audits.

Business Partnership

  • Work with project managers, planners, Finance, Supply Chain, and contractors to resolve cost issues.
  • Represent the cost function in project and functional meetings and workshops.
  • Support annual financial planning activities, including year-end close, budget rollovers, forecast resets, and project closeout, to ensure accurate financial reporting and proper disposition of project costs.
  • Support project closeout, including final cost validation, settlement readiness, capitalization, and residual balance resolution.

Broader Team Support

  • As part of a small cost team, this role may be required to support other cost or finance activities across capital projects, turnaround, and non-routine maintenance, either temporarily or permanently, as business needs evolve.
  • Provide informal guidance to Cost Analysts and Cost Administrators on process and system matters.

Key Challenges

  • Manage approximately 30-35 capital projects in different phases.
  • Complete forecasting and cost reviews within condensed monthly deadlines.
  • Work effectively in a demanding refinery and turnaround environment.


Qualifications:

  • Cost Control: Applies cost engineering principles to forecasting, change control, and variance analysis with limited supervision.
  • Business Partnership: Builds credibility with project managers, budget holders, and contractors, and explains cost implications clearly to non-financial audiences.
  • Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves day-to-day cost issues, escalating complex matters appropriately.
  • Attention to Detail: Keeps cost data accurate across a high-volume portfolio.
  • Adaptability: Works well with competing priorities and shifting project demands.
  • Initiative: Identifies risks, opportunities, and process improvements, and takes ownership of outcomes.
  • Communication: Explains complex cost information clearly in reports and presentations, and raises difficult issues professionally.
  • Hands-On Approach: Willing to perform detailed cost and reconciliation work as required.


Job Knowledge, Skills & Experience


Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–6 years of project cost-control experience, preferably with refining or petrochemical capital projects.
  • Experience with SAP, Primavera P6, project-control systems, and Microsoft Office.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup formulas, complex formulas, graphs, and cost curves.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, change control, cost reporting, scheduling, contracting, and risk management.
  • Experience working with project teams, contractors, suppliers, and Finance.
  • Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • S/4HANA, EPPM, EcoSys, or Power BI experience a plus.

Physical requirements:

  • Hybrid schedule — minimum 3 days on-site per week.
  • Occasional extended hours during planned and unplanned events, including turnaround execution.
  • Must hold or be able to qualify for a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC).
  • Must have legal authorization to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Hopewell, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Hopewell area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Hopewell requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: CRM Executive
description:
At Wonderskin, we believe beauty should be effortless, long-lasting, and transformative and we've built a brand that proves it. Powered by patented Wonder Blading technology, we've cracked the code on long-wear beauty, delivering bold, flawless results that speak for themselves.

We are now looking for a driven CRM Executive to help build the roadmap for the global CRM landscape. This role will manage, design and execute marketing campaigns across email, SMS, Whatsapp and direct mail and turn that community into lasting relationships.

As a CRM Executive you will be responsible for managing the ‘day-to-day’ strategy, with a primary focus on campaigns in their entirety. This involves maximising customer relationships and communication from the brand, knowing how best to segment and manage an ever growing database, and delivering strong customer lifetime value.

Reporting into the Head of CRM, this role will work closely with the CRM Manager, who manages automated lifecycle journeys.

The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes customer data, is AI fluent, moves fast, and understands what it takes to achieve maximum commercial and marketing success. If you're passionate about delivering world-class multi-channel CRM campaigns, obsessed with segmentation and personalisation that actually delivers retention, and want to be part of a brand where science meets self-expression, you might just be our kind of person.

What You Will Do

CRM Strategy + Campaign Planning

  • Design, build, analyse and execute global day-to-day (BAU) CRM campaigns across all channels -email, SMS, Whatsapp and beyond.
  • Maintain and support the CRM campaign calendar, in line with the overarching brand campaigns ensuring timely sends and alignment with launches, promotions, and brand priorities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer behaviours and streamline direct marketing campaigns to compliment their unique personal preferences.
  • Own the development of segmentation-led and initiative-driven campaign concepts across the customer base.
  • Proactively review performance and customer behaviour to spot opportunities (new segments, drop-off points, high-value cohorts) and translate them into brand-right campaign ideas.
  • Bring fresh CRM concepts forward consistently, not just one-off sends, but repeatable, scalable programmes that perform.
  • Monitor engagement, deliverability, and emerging trends relevant to Wonderskin's retention goals.

Campaign Execution (Hands-On Delivery)

  • Build and deploy a high volume of campaigns across all channels, email, SMS, Whatsapp, and more, from brief to final send.
  • Set up sends that meet channel best practices (subject lines, preview text, mobile-first layout, clear CTAs, personalisation).
  • Produce a mix of campaign types including:
    • Product and launch campaigns (education, transformation, routine content)
    • Promotional and offer-led sends
    • Quick-turn reactive campaigns based on stock, trends, and performance insights
  • Ensure all campaigns are aligned with brand tone, visual identity, and campaign messaging.
  • Conduct ongoing A/B tests and thorough analysis of each send, segment and cohort behavior and product evidence based progressive next steps to ensure CRM performance continuously evolves.

Segmentation + Audience Management

  • Own audience segmentation across all channels - deciding who gets what and when to ensure the right message reaches the right customer.
  • Build and manage segments and lists, keeping targeting sharp, relevant, and personalised as the customer base grows.
  • Monitor list health, deliverability, and compliance (GDPR/consent), escalating relevant concerns internally when necessary.
  • Support audience growth and retention initiatives, including sign-up capture, loyalty, and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Partner closely with the automation lead so that BAU campaigns and triggered lifecycle flows complement rather than overlap.
  • Monitor and report on key performance metrics related to customer retention and engagement.
  • Develop benchmarks and establish testing frameworks to drive continuous improvement.

Retention Strategy

  • Develop and implement campaigns specifically focused on increasing customer retention and lifetime value.

Promotional Campaign Ownership

  • Own key CRM promotional moments that require dedicated planning and execution.
  • Plan campaign beats around key dates, build assets quickly, and ensure sends feel native and on-brand (not “ad in disguise”).
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to keep promo activity aligned with launches, offers, and wider campaign messaging.

Collaboration + Campaign Support

  • Execute independently on assigned concepts while contributing your own creative direction.
  • Support larger campaigns by contributing creative input and helping shape overarching brand and seasonal Campaigns.
  • Work alongside creative, brand, product, communications, and paid teams to ensure content is aligned and performs effectively.

Collaboration + Campaign Support

  • Execute independently on assigned campaigns while contributing your own creative and strategic direction.
  • Support larger campaigns by contributing CRM input and helping shape the retention approach across email, SMS, and beyond.
  • Work alongside brand, creative, product, ecommerce, and paid teams to ensure messaging is aligned and performs effectively.
  • Assist with loyalty, referral, or partnership coordination where relevant to campaigns.

Performance Mindset + Reporting

  • Use CRM & AI analytics to learn what's working and iterate quickly.
  • Track campaign and flow performance and apply learnings to improve subject lines, segmentation, timing, cadence, and creativity.
  • A/B test consistently to sharpen open rates, click-through, conversion, and retention.
  • Support reporting on CRM metrics including engagement, conversion, revenue per send, retention, churn, and customer lifetime value.
  • Stay informed on ESP/platform updates, deliverability changes, and CRM best practices.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience delivering multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, or push (beauty/lifestyle highly preferred).
  • Previous experience in a CRM Executive, CRM Assistant, Email Marketing, Campaign, or similar role preferred.
  • Strong instincts for turning customer data and insight into brand-safe, high-performing campaigns quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM/ESP platform (Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar).
  • Comfortable building segments and A/B tests, with an eye for targeting, messaging, and conversion.
  • Solid understanding of segmentation, campaign management, deliverability, and what drives engagement and retention.
  • Familiarity with ecommerce platforms (e.g. Shopify) and analytics tools is a plus.
  • Highly organised, proactive, quick-moving, and calm under pressure when deadlines are tight.

What You Will Gain

From day one, you'll be deep in the work, building, sending, and iterating in one of the most exciting spaces in beauty right now. This isn't a role where you'll be watching from the sidelines.

Instead you will get

  • Hands-on CRM experience across strategy, multi-channel campaign execution, and audience segmentation
  • Exposure to a high-growth, globally recognised beauty brand with a passionate and engaged audience
  • The creative and strategic freedom to bring your own ideas forward and see them come to life at scale and at pace
  • A career path to progress into Senior CRM, Retention, or Lifecycle Marketing roles
  • The chance to grow alongside a brand that's still writing its story

This is a high-output, data-driven role with genuine progression opportunities, built for someone ready to make their mark and grow with us.

Our Commitment to You

At Wonderskin, we are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the world we live in. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or family status.

We believe diverse perspectives make us a stronger, more creative team, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued and can do their best work.

Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay, we didn't write this list expecting to find a perfect match. If you are excited about this role and can tick most of the boxes, we would love to hear from you. We hire for potential, attitude, and passion just as much as experience, so if Wonderskin feels like your kind of place, take the leap and apply.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Chicopee, Massachusetts.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Chicopee area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Chicopee requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:

Hudbay (TSX, NYSE: HBM) is a copper-focused mining company with three long-life operations and a world-class pipeline of copper growth projects in tier-one mining-friendly jurisdictions of Canada, Peru, and the United States.


Hudbay's operating portfolio includes the Constancia mine in Cusco (Peru), the Snow Lake operations in Manitoba (Canada) and the Copper Mountain mine in British Columbia (Canada). Mission:

title: SDET (Salesforce)
description:
As a Salesforce SDET, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our Salesforce solutions.
  • Test Planning: Collaborate with the development, business analysis, and project management teams to understand project requirements, define test strategies, and develop comprehensive test plans.
  • Test Case Development: Design, document, and maintain detailed test cases and test scenarios to validate Salesforce functionality, customizations, and integrations.
  • Manual Testing: Perform thorough manual testing of Salesforce applications, identifying and documenting defects, and working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Automation Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard tools and frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability.
  • Regression Testing: Conduct regression testing to ensure that existing functionalities are not adversely affected by new changes or updates.
  • Performance Testing: Evaluate the performance and scalability of Salesforce applications, identify potential bottlenecks, and recommend optimizations to improve performance.
  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Coordinate and conduct UAT sessions with business stakeholders to validate that the solutions meet their needs and expectations.
  • Defect Management: Track, manage, and report defects using a defect tracking system, ensuring that all issues are addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest Salesforce features, best practices, and industry trends to continuously enhance testing processes and methodologies.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of high-quality Salesforce solutions.
  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation of test plans, test cases, test results, and defects to ensure transparency and traceability.
  • Risk Assessment: Identify potential risks and issues related to Salesforce implementations and provide recommendations for mitigation.

title: Senior Planner
description:
Summary

The Senior Planner will lead planning and scheduling activities across mining and EPCM construction projects, from engineering through construction and commissioning. The ideal candidate has a proven track record building and maintaining integrated project schedules, ensuring alignment with cost, scope, and quality standards. This role requires strong analytical skills, technical expertise in Primavera P6, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional project teams to support sound, timely decision-making.

Location: Wells, BC - FIFO

Responsibilities

The Senior Planner will be responsible for the following functions:

Schedule Development & Baselines:

  • Develop and maintain the project's Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and detailed schedules in Primavera P6, covering engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
  • Establish schedule baselines and manage the change control process for schedule revisions.
  • Build resource- and cost-loaded schedules in coordination with Cost Control and discipline leads.

Schedule Analysis & Forecasting:

  • Perform critical path analysis, look-ahead scheduling, and scenario / what-if planning to identify risks and flexibility in the plan.
  • Monitor progress and forecast completion dates, flagging variances and potential delays early.
  • Support delay analysis and schedule impact assessments for change orders and claims.

Cost & Schedule Integration:

  • Integrate schedule and cost data using Earned Value Management (EVM) principles.
  • Coordinate with Cost Control to align progress measurement, forecasting, and reporting.

Communication & Reporting:

  • Prepare progress reports, S-curves, dashboards, and schedule narratives for project leadership and clients.
  • Present schedule status and risks at project review meetings and planning workshops.
  • Maintain formal documentation of schedule baselines, revisions, and approvals.

Team Leadership & Coordination:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior planners/schedulers; review their work for quality and consistency.
  • Coordinate with Field Engineering, Procurement, Permitting, and Site Operations to ensure schedules reflect real site conditions and constraints.

title: SPD/CSR TECH (Per Diem)
description:
The Sterile Processing Technician (SPD/CSR Tech) is an essential member of the Surgical Services team responsible for the proper decontamination, inspection, assembly, sterilization, storage, and distribution of surgical instruments, procedural trays, equipment, and supplies used throughout the hospital.

The Sterile Processing Technician helps ensure that instrumentation and equipment are available, properly processed, and ready for safe patient use in accordance with hospital policies, manufacturers' instructions for use (IFUs), infection prevention standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and knowledgeable in infection prevention, sterilization practices, surgical instrumentation, and the proper handling of reusable medical devices.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Completion of a Sterile Processing Technician, Central Service Technician, or related healthcare training program preferred.

Certification

One of the following certifications is required:

  • Certified Registered Central Service Technician (CRCST) through the Healthcare Sterile Processing Association (HSPA); or
  • Certified Sterile Processing and Distribution Technician (CSPDT) through the Certification Board for Sterile Processing and Distribution (CBSPD).

Experience

  • Previous experience in Sterile Processing, Central Sterile, Central Supply, Surgical Services, or an Operating Room environment preferred.
  • Previous acute-care hospital experience preferred.
  • Experience with surgical instrumentation, instrument assembly, decontamination, sterilization, and sterile storage strongly preferred.
  • Experience processing instrumentation for multiple surgical specialties is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of sterile processing and infection prevention principles.
  • Knowledge of surgical instrumentation and basic surgical terminology.
  • Understanding of decontamination, disinfection, sterilization, and sterile storage procedures.
  • Knowledge of steam sterilization and other sterilization methods used within the facility.
  • Ability to identify and properly assemble surgical instruments and instrument sets.
  • Ability to follow manufacturers' Instructions for Use (IFUs).
  • Understanding of sterilization monitoring, including mechanical, chemical, and biological indicators.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to patient safety.
  • Ability to accurately follow count sheets, department procedures, and written instructions.
  • Ability to recognize damaged, malfunctioning, or improperly cleaned instrumentation.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize urgent instrumentation and supply needs.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced hospital environment.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Surgical Services and other clinical departments.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to utilize instrument-tracking or hospital information systems as applicable.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.

title: Youth Basketball Official
description:
General Purpose:

The Youth Basketball Official is responsible for officiating recreational basketball games in a fair, consistent, and professional manner while promoting a positive experience for participants, coaches, and spectators. Officials enforce league rules, maintain game flow, ensure player safety, and uphold good sportsmanship during youth basketball league games. This position requires sound judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to remain impartial in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities:

The following duties are NOT intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed by all employees in this classification, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. Incumbent(s) may not be required to perform all duties listed and may be required to perform additional, position-specific duties.

  • Officiate youth basketball games according to league rules and Minot Park District policies.
  • Make fair, consistent, and impartial rulings during games, including violations, substitutions, scoring and player conduct.
  • Ensure games begin and end on schedule while maintaining an efficient pace of play.
  • Promote good sportsmanship and maintain a safe, respectful environment for participants, coaches, and spectators.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with players, coaches, scorekeepers, supervisors, and fellow officials.
  • Address rule questions and minor disputes calmly and professionally while enforcing league policies.
  • Inspect the court and equipment before games to ensure a safe playing environment.
  • Report injuries, emergencies, incidents, rule violations, or facility concerns to the supervisor immediately.
  • Assist with light setup and cleanup of basketball equipment before and after games as needed.
  • Attend required meetings and training sessions to stay current on league rules, procedures, and expectations.
  • Represent the Minot Park District in a positive and professional manner.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education/Experience:

  • Previous basketball playing, coaching, or officiating experience preferred but not required.
  • Training will be provided for qualified applicants.

Knowledge/Skills:

  • Basic knowledge of basketball rules and gameplay or willingness to learn.
  • Ability to make quick, confident decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm, impartial, and professional during competitive situations.
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to work independently.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during games.
  • Ability to move quickly on and around the court.

Schedule Requirements:

  • Flexible scheduling based on league needs.
  • Games are typically scheduled Monday through Thursday evenings, with occasional Saturday games.
  • Officials work with the recreation supervisor to establish availability and schedules.

Other duties as assigned and performed as required.

title: Program Management Analyst - Journeyman
description:
Position Summary

As a company, MAG is dedicated to providing real-time situational awareness to help our customers make the world safer. At MAG, we believe that our success is due to the exceptional employees we recruit, hire, and retain. If you are interested in joining a team that is laser-focused on serving our customers with technical expertise, operational excellence, and flawless execution, then we encourage you to apply today!

MAG Aerospace is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Program Management Analyst with Acquisition Analyst experience that will provide support to a Program Office (PMA) at NAS Patuxent River, MD. Support will be hybrid/on-site at the PMA. This position is aligned under the PMA’s BFM Functional Lead, and supports a PMA Level II Integrated Product Team (IPT) and works with multiple Level III IPTLs for a UAS program in Lexington Park, MD. The primary support required includes acquisition financial planning for staffing, contracting and other funding actions for current year execution, and out-year planning. Procurement planning, staff planning and spend plan development/tracking for project/program support, strong inter- and intra-team communication skills, resource planning, and acquisition and briefing support for a PMA IPT. Primary focus will be managing/tracking/and coordinating the financial execution for the supported IPT.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

  • Support development, status/updating, and execution of Spend Plans in the NAVAIR Common Spend Plan Tool (CSPT).
  • Track, update, and monitor financial data using PMA Execution and Requirements spreadsheets, in coordination with IPT Analysts, and BFMs.
  • Use AMS Visualization and Excel Pivot tables to display and interpret planning, execution, and other financial information.
  • Coordinate with PMA BFM team for funding requests/spend plan execution and maintain data bases to track associated information.
  • Advise the IPT of current TOA allocation and management of TOA balance
  • Brief spend plans/financial documents at funding reviews.
  • Support response preparation for financial taskers and RFIs for IPT review.
  • Coordinate with other analysts to ensure AMS tools are updated across the IPT.
  • Provide recommendations to the IPT on types of funding required for specific actions.
  • Support preparation of budget language for budget documents
  • Ensure projects are fully funded prior to RFP release.
  • Support BFM team for coordination with field activities' financial POCs for MIPR instructions and external contract awards for MIPRs.
  • Support the entering of Program Initiation Document (PID) in Program Management Tool (PMT) to include PID Purchase Request (PR) Worksheets, Statement of Work, and Request for Proposal, Technical Evaluations and Funding Documents.
  • Support Acquisition and Procurement planning, including Procurement Planning Conferences, Contracts meetings, and support the preparation of Procurement Planning Agreements, and development of execution plans and schedules to create Program Initiation Documents (PIDs).
  • Support preparation of acquisition documentation and information (SOWs, CDRLs, cost estimates, Security forms, J&As, Sole Source documents Government Estimate (IGEs) and DD254 (Security Forms).
  • Work with Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL) and Contracts to ensure modifications and delivery orders are funded and executed in a timely manner.
  • Work with IPTL, Analysts, and Contracts to ensure CLINs are established and exercised before funds are obligated. Identify and track program risks and mitigations.
  • Support internal and external communications/responses for queries, data calls, drills, program briefs and other requests for information from internal and external Stakeholders.
  • Apply analytic techniques in the evaluation of program/project objectives.
  • Analyze requirements, status, budget, and schedules.
  • Perform management, technical, or business case analyses.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

Knowledge and Skills

The required skills and knowledge include:

  • Must be an excellent communicator.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience with NAVAIR Acquisition Management System (AMS) – Procurement Management Tool (PMT), Contract Deliverable Requirements List tool (CDRL), Resource Management Tool (RMT) and primary experience with Common Spend Plan Tool (CSPT).
  • Mid-level knowledge with NAVAIR, DoN, and DoD acquisition and requirements directives, policies, and procedures.
  • Ability to create and manage team presentations provided to internal teams, prime contractors, and their subs, as well as senior acquisition and Department of the Navy leadership, as required.

The minimum years of related experience required:

  • Three (3) plus years of NAVAIR business/acquisition related experience is required

Education

The minimum level of education required is:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related discipline.
  • Substitution for a BS degree with a AS degree in a business-related discipline and a minimum of (7) seven years’ experience.

Desired Requirements

The desired skills, knowledge, and education include:

  • Experience with DoD/DoN acquisition documentation to include: Requirements documents, Acquisition Plan/Strategy, Acquisition Program Baseline, Systems Engineering Plan, Program Life Cycle Cost Estimate, Environmental Plan, Risk Assessment, Clinger-Cohen Act Compliance, and Program Protection Plans.
  • Experience with DoN/DoD Requirements Directives and Policies.
  • Experience with the DoN Program Objective Memorandum (POM) planning process, and development of strategies, planning, issue sheet development, and briefs for IPT specific inputs.

Other Qualifications

Outside of the above, other certifications, licenses, or clearances include:

  • Active Secret clearance is required

Special Note

The position is contingent upon candidate’s ability to meet physical and medical requirements as needed by the position; including compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictional requirements.

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: https://www.magaero.com/benefits/. Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $95,000 to $125,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.
