title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Suffolk, Virginia.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Suffolk area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Suffolk requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: STAFF CRNA | ANESTHESIOLOGY
description:
About the Role:

The Staff Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) plays a critical role in delivering high-quality anesthesia care to patients across a variety of surgical and procedural settings. This position involves the comprehensive assessment, planning, and administration of anesthesia, ensuring patient safety and comfort throughout the perioperative period. The Staff CRNA collaborates closely with surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to develop and implement individualized anesthesia care plans. Additionally, the role requires continuous monitoring of patients’ physiological status during procedures and the ability to respond swiftly to any changes or emergencies. Ultimately, the Staff CRNA contributes to positive patient outcomes by applying expert clinical judgment, advanced technical skills, and compassionate care in a fast-paced environment within the United States healthcare system.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current and unrestricted Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) license in the United States.
  • Graduation from an accredited nurse anesthesia educational program.
  • Certification by the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists (NBCRNA).
  • Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certifications.
  • Demonstrated clinical experience in anesthesia administration within a hospital or surgical setting.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary surgical team environment.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems and anesthesia information management systems.
  • Additional certifications such as Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) or Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC).
  • Advanced training or experience in specialized anesthesia techniques or subspecialties.
  • Strong background in patient education and pain management strategies.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct pre-anesthetic assessments to evaluate patient health status and identify potential anesthesia risks.
  • Develop and implement anesthesia care plans tailored to individual patient needs and surgical requirements.
  • Administer various types of anesthesia, including general, regional, and local, while continuously monitoring patient vital signs.
  • Collaborate with surgical teams and other healthcare professionals to ensure seamless perioperative care.
  • Manage airway and ventilation during procedures and provide post-anesthesia care and pain management.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of anesthesia care and patient responses.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols, infection control standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing education and training to stay current with advances in anesthesia practice and technology.

Skills:

The Staff CRNA utilizes advanced clinical skills to perform thorough patient assessments and administer anesthesia safely and effectively. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential for coordinating with surgical teams and ensuring patient-centered care. Critical thinking and rapid decision-making abilities are applied daily to monitor patient status and respond to any intraoperative changes or emergencies. Proficiency with technology, including anesthesia delivery systems and electronic health records, supports accurate documentation and enhances patient safety. Additionally, ongoing learning and adaptability enable the CRNA to incorporate the latest evidence-based practices and innovations into their clinical work.

title: Resident. Instructor
description:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Create a nurturing, positive learning environment and develop strategies to help the clients cope effectively with social, emotional and physical situations of daily living and facilitate independent performance in these areas.

2. Must be able to perform all job functions required. Must be able to lift and transfer 70-75lbs. The work is active and performed both inside and outside of the home.

3. Must be able to utilize approved protective hold techniques in order to keep you, clients, and co-workers safe.

4. Implement Individual Plan of Care/Follow-Along Plan based in the Interdisciplinary Team’s identification of client needs; record data on all identified teaching strategies, behavior plans, report client’s progress needs and any barriers that impede progress. Responsible to maintain and document an awareness of individual treatment plans, inclusive of use of leisure time, community experiences, use of public transportation, safety skills, personal hygiene and activities of daily living.

5. Monitor medical, physical and behavioral changes in individuals on a daily basis and report changes to the Supervisor, RN Program Coordinator or Program Director as it occurs, is observed or discovered; write up incident reports and submit to Program Coordinator or Residential Program Manager within 24 hours.

6. Once Medication Certified, administer medication to clients at prescribed times; in accordance with agency policy and DDS regulatory standards. Report all errors of medication administration or documentation to the RN, Program Manager and Program Coordinator immediately.

7. Monitor and assist in making medical and other related appointments as requested. Following medical appointments assist and monitor follow through on all doctors’ orders and recommendations per RN direction.

8. Participate in the planning, purchasing and preparation of meals within available budgetary resources; ensure clients’ dietary plans are followed.

9.Maintain the appearance, cleanliness and upkeep of the house, properties and vehicle, insuring they are clean and safe. Report all repair needs to the Program Manager and/or Program Coordinator in a timely manner.

10. Conduct self in a professional manner when interacting with participants, supervisors, co-workers, families, medical profession and members of the community.

11. Participate in training opportunities (in-service training, staff meetings, conferences, etc.), as required; maintain all required training per agency policy and DDS regulatory requirement.

12. Provide accurate accounting of agency’s petty cash and client funds in an informative, auditable condition at all times, as required or requested by the Residential Program Manager.

13. Assures individuals’ right to privacy and adheres to CRI’s confidentiality policy.

14. Take individuals to a variety of community based outings ensuring that all health and safety measures in the Individuals support plan are followed while in the community. Utilizes the agency vehicle following state laws and safety procedures.

15. Familiarize oneself with CRI policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with same.

16. Assist in developing a positive neighborhood/community relationship.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

1. Demonstrate organizational ability, experience and ability to communicate effectively with persons with developmental disabilities.

2. Demonstrate some knowledge of educational and behavioral programs.

3. Demonstrate willingness to learn about current issues in the field of developmental disabilities.

4. Be able to communicate with people at various ability levels.

5. Possess organizational abilities to implement programs and services designed to enhance the individual’s learning process.

6. Possess self-motivation.

7. Be interested in improving the quality of life for people; be interested in household management; be interested in teaching.

8. Display patience, encouraging attitude, optimism, energy, communication skills, and a nurturing temperament.

9. Have the ability to perform active work, both inside and outside of the program.

10. Must possess a valid CT driver’s license and have a good driving record. Must have reliable transportation and may be required to utilize personal vehicle to transport clients.

EDUCATION

A high school diploma or GED and at least two years of experience in the field of Human Services preferred. A Bachelor’s degree in a related Human Services area in addition to experience is preferred.

description:
About Us

J.W. Pepper was founded in 1876 and is the world’s largest retailer of sheet music, with a particular focus on the K12 education market, offering over 1.2 million products on our website from over 1,000 suppliers. The company is headquartered in Exton, PA, with a large distribution facility in Atlanta, GA.

Position Overview

The IT Project Manager owns multiple concurrent software and enterprise application projects, serving as a driver of projects, from early discovery through delivery. The IT Project Manager is directly responsible for all phases of their assigned projects including project intake, gathering requirements, confirming scope, planning, execution, testing, delivery and go-live. The IT Project Manager collaborates closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and deliver expected value.

Candidates should have at least 5 years of experience in technical project management, including agile and waterfall methodologies, requirements gathering and strong communication skills. This position reports to the Director of IT Project Management within the CIO organization.

Requirements

Project Management

  • Serve as a key point of contact for business stakeholders on a regular basis, facilitating intake discussions, clarifying business needs, determining high level effort estimate and scope, ensuring all requests are documented in IT project intake.
  • Own and lead multiple concurrent IT projects from discovery through delivery.
  • Manage projects involving new application builds, system integrations, platform migrations, and software implementations.
  • Develop and maintain project plan and schedule, risk and issue logs, and dependency tracking.
  • Plan and sequence work based on the project scope and available resources. Proactively identify and escalate resource constraints or conflicts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including internal IT architecture, IT development teams, business partners, and external vendors.
  • Proactively identify, communicate and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies, including impacts to other initiatives.
  • Provide regular status on progress, milestones, risks, issues and technical or business blockers.
  • Facilitate project meetings and manage project communications. Create, maintain, and ensure the completion and proper storage of all required project documentation and artifacts throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Tailor project management practices, templates, and communications based on the project size and scope.
  • Ensure all project documentation and artifacts are completed, stored, and archived in accordance with standards at project close.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in response to changing priorities by assessing and communicating impacts to project plans, timelines, and resource allocation when direction shifts from IT and business leadership.

Business Analysis

  • Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business needs and requirements during project intake and discovery
  • Analyze and document current and future-state business processes using techniques such as stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process mapping.
  • Develop business analysis deliverables, including workflows, use cases, business rules, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Conduct gap analyses to identify process improvements and ensure alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with IT architecture, product owners and development teams to refine requirements and ensure shared understanding.
  • Support the creation of test cases and participate in testing activities to validate that delivered solutions meet approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively identify and communicate risks, issues, and dependencies related to requirements or solution design.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • 401(K)
  • Opportunities to work in a creative, music-focused environment
  • A collaborative team that values innovation and culture
  • Fun Company Culture

J.W. Pepper & Son provides equal employment opportunity for everyone regardless of age, sex, color, race, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, religious persuasion, marital status, veteran status, disability that does not prohibit the performance of essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation, or other classifications protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Early Career Project Manager
description:
Overview

Job Title: Early Career Project Manager

Location: Arnold AFB, TN

Job Family Code: Q-Program Management & Operations (tech)

Function/Branch: Engineering/Engineering Solutions

Directorate: Engineering & Tech Support

Position Type: Regular, Full Time

Pay Type: Exempt

Grade: L07 (QA0705)

Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate: $77,000 - $106,000/ per year

Overview

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for an early career Project Manager, supporting TOS II, at AEDC in Arnold AFB, TN. The project manager will be working as a member of the Engineering Solutions branch responsible for supporting the United States Air Force Test Operations and Sustainment efforts. The Engineering Solutions branch performs cutting edge technology development work in support of the National Defense Strategy.

Open to internal and external candidates.

Job Summary

Engineering Solutions is a dynamic technology development and engineering analysis branch of Beyond New Horizons, LLC with projects ranging from Level-of-Effort sustainment activities, Pressure and Hazardous Material System In-Service Inspection projects, Technology Development projects, Laboratory upgrades, and Ground Test projects. The Project Manager will be responsible for managing costs, schedules, and resources for these efforts. This role includes tracking earned value metrics, reporting project status monthly, and flagging any issues that may arise to ensure projects stay on track. The ideal candidate will have a robust understanding of project management principles, tools, and techniques.

Job Duties:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Develop detailed project plans, outlining scope, goals, deliverables, required resources, and timelines for each project.
  • Cost and Schedule Management: Manage workloads, oversee project budgets, schedules, and resource allocation to ensure timely, cost-effective project delivery.
  • Earned Value Analysis: Track earned value metrics to monitor project progress and performance relative to cost and schedule, identifying potential deviations early.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify, document, and manage project risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies and escalate as needed to supervisors.
  • Resource Coordination: Work with supervisors to plan and allocate resources effectively across various projects, ensuring alignment with project goals.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Report monthly on project status, highlighting progress, upcoming milestones, budget status, and any challenges or risks. Work together with customer project managers and analysts.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively suggest process improvements and support initiatives that enhance project delivery and team collaboration.
  • It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in project management, Engineering, Business, Management plus two years project management experience, which must include budget management, financial forecasting, and controlling project costs to ensure projects stay within budget.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense Secret level security clearance and access to the AEDC local area network
  • Due to Air Force Security requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required for employment at AEDC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven ability to develop project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • 5+ years of Project Management experience in technology, maintenance, or related project types.
  • Experience in tracking and analyzing earned value metrics to gauge project performance and forecast potential deviations.
  • Strong written and verbal skills for reporting project status and presenting to stakeholders across all levels.
  • Proficiency in risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies to proactively address potential project risks.
  • Experience working collaboratively with line supervisors to optimize resource allocation across projects and manage competing priorities.
  • PMP Certification or similar credentials preferred.
  • Experience working with government projects
  • Ability to develop and maintain relationships with employees, clients, and customers.
  • The ability to participate in and foster a work environment that is based upon openness, trust, communication, teamwork, empowerment, innovation, and satisfaction.
  • Active Department of Defense Secret Security Clearance

What We Offer

  • Competitive salaries
  • Continuing education assistance
  • Multiple healthcare benefits packages
  • 401K with employer matching
  • Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

Who We Are

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

Join our Team!

U.S. Citizenship is required. At this time BNH will not sponsor any applicants for employment authorization or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1b, F1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, E-2, E-3, L-1, or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations and refers to the amount BNH is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time jobs will be adjusted based upon the number of hours agreed to work at location Tennessee: Arnold Air Force, TN.

L07: $77,000 - $106,000 / year at Arnold Air Force Base, TN.

BNH is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Kitchen Supervisor
description:

title: Buyer
description:
JOB PURPOSE or JOB SUMMARY:

The Buyer works in cooperation with the Purchasing Manager to ensure incoming materials, components, and supplies are ordered and received to meet critical production schedules, effectively reviewing MRP requirements to reduce overall costs and increase inventory turns.


Contributes to a positive working culture, builds strong relationships, and lives out the values of integrity, collaboration, and accountability.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

  • Reviews and analyzes MRP and other related reports to procure components or services from suppliers.
  • Ensures purchase orders and change orders for assigned parts, materials, and supplies are input into the system and documented in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with established procedures.
  • Ensures integrity of purchase orders by verifying all information provided on supplier acknowledgment, including part numbers, descriptions, pricing, and delivery dates.
  • Expedites purchase orders related to past-due items, special orders, and other requests on an as-needed basis. Follows up as necessary.
  • Communicate with sales and production teams regarding the status of orders in relation to sales order dates and/or scheduling requirements.
  • Assists in solving discrepancies with suppliers, inventory, finance, and engineering.
  • Assists in obtaining and analyzing supplier quotes.
  • Assists with supplier negotiations to get the best possible pricing.
  • Demonstrates leadership and sound judgment in representing the purchasing department and JEM Technical internally and externally.
  • Compliance with all JEM policies and procedures, including ISO, OSHA, and AWAIR requirements.
  • Supports JEM’s vision and mission and exemplifies JEM’s core values daily.
  • Maintains regular and predictable attendance.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear.
  • The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms.
  • The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

The mental and physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.


WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to work near moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

title: Junior Data Scientist
company: Grupa Allegro Sp. z o. o.
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist with a strong analytical and business mindset - someone who enjoys decoding market mechanisms, tracking emerging product trends, and applying statistical models to solve complex platform puzzles.

Our team drives the logic that powers a trustworthy and competitive marketplace. As part of the Marketplace organization dedicated to delivering the best experiences for our buyers and sellers, we specialize in data-driven solutions focused on driving their growth - particularly through identifying market-relevant products, monitoring and optimizing product mapping quality for internal processes, and building robust reporting to extract actionable insights for business teams.

Moreover, we are actively leveraging cutting-edge AI to build agentic workflows that capture emerging trends and feed critical intelligence back into partner-support processes. We work in close collaboration with developers and product teams across the entire project lifecycle, from ideation to implementation.

Why should you work with us?

  • Data Science plays a key role in the operation of Allegro - through your models, trend insights, and mapping tools, you will directly influence business decisions and partner growth.
  • You will participate in cutting-edge projects, including building Agentic AI systems and automated trend detection in a large-scale e-commerce ecosystem.
  • Support of experienced Data Scientists - there is always someone to exchange ideas with, as we have top specialists and experts on board.
  • Access to huge data sets and state-of-the-art data processing technologies in GCP (BigQuery, VertexAI, Cloud Composer, Dataflow, Airflow, PySpark, Gemini/GPT models).
  • Opportunity to learn best software engineering, code quality, and MLOps practices in practice.
  • We share knowledge at industry conferences, host internal meetups, and actively co-create the DS/ML community in Poland and globally.

What's in it for you:

  • Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
  • A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
  • A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
  • English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
  • A training budget, inter-team tourism , hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
  • An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
  • Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

Our offer is addressed to people who:

  • Have foundational experience or academic background in building classical ML/DS solutions (such as regression, classification, clustering, time series) and data analysis using SQL.
  • Understand classical ML algorithms, their strengths, weaknesses, and basic hyperparameter tuning techniques.
  • Know how to evaluate model performance using statistical metrics and diagnose basic data & mapping quality issues.
  • Can explore data effectively by writing cost-efficient SQL queries, aggregating data, and creating clear reports or visualizations to deliver actionable business insights.
  • Are capable of ingesting, validating, and transforming tabular data and product metadata into features ready for modeling.
  • Can map business challenges (e.g. product relevance, mapping accuracy, trend detection) into analytical/modeling problems.
  • Write readable, clean Python code following standards and best practices, with awareness of basic testing (e.g. unit tests) and cloud cost optimization basics.
  • Possess practical and theoretical knowledge of Generative AI & Agentic AI principles (prompting, validation, agent workflows) and enthusiastically leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot) to accelerate daily work.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, presenting findings and insights effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Speak English and Polish at a B2+ level or higher.
  • Graduated with a degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Physics (or similar quantitative field) or have early-career experience in Data Science / Data Analytics positions.

title: Clay Modeling Lead, Robot Industrial Design (10+ years)
description:
We are helping an on-demand, autonomous ride-hailing company hire a Clay Modeling Lead, Robot Industrial Design to lead the development and execution of clay models that translate design vision into precise three-dimensional form. Working at the intersection of design, engineering, and craftsmanship, you’ll help bring future mobility concepts to life from early ideation through production feasibility.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Industrial Design, Digital Modeling, Engineering, and Prototype teams to ensure physical models accurately reflect design intent while meeting technical and manufacturing requirements.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional automotive clay modeling expertise with strong leadership skills, deep technical knowledge, and a passion for craftsmanship. You have a refined understanding of automotive proportions and surface development and can guide complex modeling programs from early concepts through production while maintaining the highest standards of design quality.

As a Clay Modeling Lead, Robot Industrial Design, you'll:

  • Plan and manage clay modeling activities across multiple vehicle programs, balancing priorities, schedules, staffing, and studio resources to meet development timelines.
  • Lead the creation and refinement of full-size and scale clay models, ensuring exceptional surface quality, precision, craftsmanship, and alignment with design intent.
  • Collaborate with Industrial Designers, Digital Modelers, Engineering, and Prototype teams to translate digital designs into accurate physical surfaces and resolve development challenges.
  • Prepare presentation models and design bucks that effectively communicate design intent during leadership, executive, and cross-functional reviews.
  • Continuously improve clay modeling processes, workflows, tooling, and fabrication techniques to increase efficiency and model quality.
  • Help oversee studio equipment, materials, vendor relationships, budgets, and resource planning to maintain a safe, organized, and productive modeling environment.
  • Champion automotive clay modeling best practices while incorporating new technologies and methods that enhance the design development process.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of hands-on automotive clay modeling experience within automotive design studios.
  • Proven experience leading clay model development from early concept through production, supporting both concept vehicles and production programs.
  • Extensive experience creating and refining full-size and scale clay models using traditional hand modeling techniques and precision surfacing methods.
  • Expert understanding of automotive proportions, Class-A surface development, vehicle architecture, and production feasibility.
  • Strong knowledge of clay modeling equipment, studio fabrication processes, milling workflows, and digital-to-physical model development.
  • Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills with the ability to balance multiple concurrent programs.
  • High attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, quality, and design excellence.

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance

description:
TITLE: Customer Experience Specialist
DIVISION: Customer Experience
REPORTS TO: Customer Experience Director
FLSA CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt/Hourly

description:

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Analyst II to support data governance, engineering drawing migration, and asset information management within the Data and Systems Strategy organization.

This role will help ensure engineering and asset information is accurate, organized, properly classified, and easy to find and use. The position will play a key role in migrating and improving a large portfolio of engineering drawings by reviewing records, identifying data quality issues, correcting metadata, resolving hierarchy and classification challenges, and validating migrated information.

The Engineering Analyst II will work closely with Asset Information Management (AIM), Engineering, Operations, Drafting, Technical Information Systems, and external service providers to improve data quality and strengthen information governance and turnover processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review engineering records and determine appropriate classifications and hierarchy structures.
  • Perform data cleansing, remediation, and metadata correction activities to improve data quality and searchability.
  • Conduct data quality assessments to identify:
    • Missing information
    • Inconsistent metadata
    • Duplicate records
    • Classification issues
    • Hierarchy gaps
    • Mapping errors
  • Validate migrated engineering drawings and associated metadata for accuracy and completeness.
  • Participate in testing to confirm improvements to document searchability, accessibility, and usability.
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Drafting, Operations, AIM, and external service providers to resolve data issues.
  • Facilitate discussions around hierarchy, classification, metadata, and data mapping requirements.
  • Document findings, issues, resolutions, and data quality results.
  • Track migration activities, progress, and quality metrics and prepare status reports.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of asset information turnover processes.
  • Help establish consistent data governance practices across Operations, Engineering, Projects, and AIM.
  • Translate technical data requirements into clear information for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, processes, reporting, and information management.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in data governance, data management, information management, or a related discipline, preferably within the energy sector.
  • Familiarity with data governance principles, frameworks, and data quality practices.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Operations, Asset Information Management, Drafting, Technical Information Systems, Compliance, and external service providers.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing SharePoint sites, libraries, lists, or document repositories.
  • Experience using PowerApps for forms, workflows, or business processes.
  • Experience with Power BI, including dashboards, reporting, or data visualization.
  • Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.
  • Experience supporting data governance within an asset-intensive organization.
  • Familiarity with pipeline industry standards and asset information management best practices.
  • Experience with engineering drawing/document migration or remediation projects.

title: MLOps Engineer ID72409
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Middle/Senior MLOps Engineer to move computer vision models from experimentation into reliable production. The role combines ML infrastructure, GPU optimization, and deployment across cloud and edge environments. You will build reproducible pipelines, monitoring, and lifecycle controls for image and video workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- End-to-End Deployment: Own the complete lifecycle transition from AI/ML experimentation to reliable, high-performance production deployment.
- Infrastructure & Pipelines: Build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD workflows necessary for rapid and efficient model deployment, including large-scale image/video data ingestion, dataset versioning, and managing manual/automated image annotation workflows.
- System Stability & Monitoring: Implement robust production monitoring systems, build visibility dashboards, and set up data and concept drift detection to ensure ongoing model accuracy and system reliability.
- Model Lifecycle Management: Manage experiment tracking and model versioning to ensure full reproducibility and traceability of all models in production.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists and AI researchers to translate experimental models into robust, production-ready solutions.
- Resource & Cost Optimization: Manage cloud environments and GPU compute resources to ensure systems are not only highly scalable but also cost-effective, focusing on model optimization for heavy GPU workloads, including latency, throughput, batching, and GPU memory utilization.
- Edge & Cloud Deployment: Deploy computer vision models to cloud environments and optimize them for Edge GPU deployment in specific use cases.

MUST HAVES
- You must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US (e.g., Green card holders, TN visa holders, GC EAD, H4 EAD, U4U with EAD), as we are unable to sponsor or take over employment visa sponsorship at this time;
- 3+ years of professional experience in MLOps, DevOps, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
- Engineers located in the US must reside in Dallas, TX, and be willing to work onsite.
- Note: This role is strictly focused on Computer Vision and GPU engineering. Profiles heavily focused on LLMs, RAG pipelines, chatbots, or prompt engineering will not be a fit unless accompanied by solid, practical CV MLOps experience.
- MLOps Core: Hands-on experience with experiment tracking, model registry/versioning, drift detection, and production monitoring.
- Computer Vision: Strong hands-on experience in CV pipelines, including training computer vision models on GPUs, dataset management, and infrastructure monitoring specific to CV model quality/drift.
- Infrastructure & Cloud: Strong practical experience navigating cloud environments and managing/provisioning GPU compute resources.
- DevOps & Automation: Deep understanding of containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and designing robust CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
- AI/ML Foundation: A solid conceptual understanding of AI/ML fundamentals to effectively communicate, troubleshoot, and collaborate with applied model developers.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Chardon, Ohio.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Chardon area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Chardon requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:
At Chewy, taking care of pets and the people who love them through the highs, the lows, and the everyday is what drives us. Grounded in that purpose and focused on our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, we work every day to help people feel more confident, supported, and capable in caring for the animals they love—showing up with the products, services, care, and guidance they need, whenever they need it.

Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.

Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy.

If you're energized by building, leading, and making a meaningful impact, this leadership opportunity may be the right fit for you.


Our Opportunity
Chewy is seeking an experienced and strategic Director, Transportation Strategy & Network Planning to define and own the long-term strategy for Chewy’s transportation network planning, network design, carrier strategy, and transportation capabilities. This leader will establish the multi-year vision and operating mechanisms required to optimize transportation cost, service, speed, capacity, reliability, and customer experience while enabling Chewy’s long-term growth. The Director will own the five-year transportation strategy and capability roadmap, translating enterprise growth, customer, and financial objectives into clear network, carrier, planning, and investment strategies. This role will have significant influence over network strategy, capability development, portfolio prioritization, and transportation planning. The Director will make and influence complex decisions requiring tradeoffs across cost, speed, service, capacity, customer experience, operational complexity, and long-term flexibility. The Director will lead a high-performing organization responsible for transportation strategy, network planning, programs, and capabilities and will partner closely with Transportation Operations and third-party carriers to translate strategy into executable operating plans. This leader will also work across Fulfillment Center Operations, Engineering, Technology, Product, Delivery Experience, Customer Care, Finance, Procurement, HR, and other enterprise functions to establish priorities, secure investment, and drive alignment.

A successful leader will consistently demonstrate Chewy’s Operating Principles, particularly Customers First, Act as an Owner, Operate at Depth, Deliver Results, Earn Trust, and Debate Openly; Commit Fully. This leader must be comfortable operating autonomously in a highly complex environment, making consequential decisions with imperfect information, and creating alignment across teams where direct authority is distributed.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own Chewy’s long-term transportation strategy, translating enterprise growth, customer, and financial objectives into network design, carrier, mode, capacity, planning, and capability strategies.
  • Own the five-year transportation strategy and portfolio roadmap, defining the physical, operational, analytical, and technology capabilities required to support Chewy’s future transportation network.
  • Establish the strategic direction for transportation network planning, including supply and capacity planning, equipment requirements, carrier and mode strategy, network connectivity, and short-, mid-, and long-term planning horizons.
  • Make and influence complex network decisions across cost, speed, service, capacity, reliability, customer experience, operational complexity, and long-term flexibility. Establish clear principles, analytical frameworks, and mechanisms for evaluating these tradeoffs.
  • Develop and maintain an integrated transportation portfolio roadmap, prioritizing physical, operational, analytical, and technical enhancements based on customer impact, financial value, network requirements, and enterprise priorities.
  • Partner with Transportation Operations to translate long-term network strategy into executable operating plans while maintaining ownership of network design, planning strategy, capability roadmaps, and optimization frameworks.
  • Establish and own transportation performance mechanisms across cost, transit time, delivery reliability, capacity, carrier performance, and customer experience. Identify structural opportunities and drive actions when performance does not meet expectations.
  • Develop business cases and investment strategies for major network and capability changes, incorporating financial return, customer impact, operational feasibility, capacity, risk, and long-term strategic value.
  • Use advanced analytics, modeling, and simulation to improve decision making, understanding customer, network, and carrier behavior and translating those insights into clear business, operational, and technical improvements.
  • Catalyze innovation across the transportation network by understanding industry trends, emerging carrier capabilities, technology advancements, and evolving customer expectations. Challenge conventional approaches and identify opportunities to create structural competitive advantage.
  • Influence senior leaders across Operations, Finance, Technology, Product, Procurement, Customer Experience, and other enterprise functions to establish priorities, resolve complex tradeoffs, secure investment, and drive alignment around transportation strategy.
  • Build strategic relationships with third-party transportation providers, engaging senior carrier leadership to influence capabilities, network design, service models, capacity strategies, and long-term partnership opportunities.
  • Build and lead a high-performing organization by establishing the appropriate organizational structure, hiring and developing exceptional talent, building leadership depth and succession, and creating mechanisms that establish clear accountability and consistently Deliver Results.
  • Operate at Depth while maintaining strategic perspective, developing a deep understanding of network economics, carrier performance, transportation flows, capacity constraints, customer outcomes, and planning assumptions while empowering the organization to own day-to-day execution.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear strategies and recommendations, communicating effectively with senior executives and translating transportation complexity into actionable business decisions.
  • Lead high-impact, executive-level initiatives that enable growth, unlock incremental profitability, improve customer experience, and create scalable capabilities for Chewy’s future transportation network.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or network planning, including significant leadership experience in complex transportation environments.
  • Deep knowledge of transportation networks across multiple modes, carrier structures, operating models, and contract structures.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing long-term transportation, logistics, or network strategies with significant business impact.
  • Experience developing or implementing network planning, optimization, simulation, or decision-support capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex systems and identify structural opportunities that may not be apparent through conventional approaches.
  • Strong understanding of transportation supply, capacity, equipment, carrier economics, network design, and short-, mid-, and long-term planning.
  • Proven ability to make complex tradeoffs among competing business objectives and to think systemically across cost, customer experience, speed, service, capacity, risk, and operational complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, establish direction where precedent may not exist, and make high-quality decisions with imperfect information.
  • Proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives and delivering measurable business results in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen with demonstrated experience developing business cases, evaluating investments, modeling complex tradeoffs, and translating data into executive-level decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth analysis, synthesize complex information, develop compelling narratives, establish strategy, and make clear recommendations to senior business and technical leaders.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills with the ability to engage effectively from front-line operations through senior executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and Earn Trust across functions, influence decisions outside direct areas of authority, constructively challenge perspectives, and create alignment around difficult decisions.
  • Experience sponsoring and leading large, cross-functional initiatives with broad scope and material impact beyond the Transportation organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to Build High-Performing Teams, including hiring and developing exceptional talent, building leadership capability, creating succession plans, establishing clear accountability, and scaling execution through others.
  • Ability to Operate at Depth when necessary while maintaining strategic perspective, empowering leaders, and avoiding unnecessary dependence on the Director for day-to-day execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge the status quo, Think Big, identify emerging opportunities, and translate innovative ideas into scalable business capabilities.
  • Relentless curiosity and a willingness to develop expertise in unfamiliar areas while rapidly building credibility with functional experts and senior leaders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

title: Project Officer, BirdsPlus Index
location: Remote (with travel as needed. All travel will be reimbursed.)
description:
Title: Project Officer, BirdsPlus Index

Supervisor: BirdsPlus Index Director

Location: Remote (with travel as needed. All travel will be reimbursed.)

Salary: Estimated at $40,000; Based on experience


Term of position: This is a contractor position and is supported through outside funding commitments.


Application deadline: Open until filled


Position Summary:

American Bird Conservancy (ABC) is a fast-growing, results-focused nonprofit seeking employees with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to make a difference for birds and their habitats throughout the Americas. Inspired by the wonder of birds, ABC achieves lasting results for the bird species most in need while also benefiting human communities, biodiversity, and the planet’s fragile climate.


ABC is seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Project Officer to help grow the BirdsPlus Index, an ambitious effort to transform how biodiversity is measured on working lands around the world. ABC’s BirdsPlus Index, a tool to evaluate and monitor conservation value of sites (particularly restoration, agroforestry, ranches, and other working lands) using birds (detected via acoustics) as indicators. It will provide an essential tool to measure conservation benefits of conservation practices and impact investments on working lands for birds.


Since 2023, ABC has been developing the BirdsPlus Index and piloted a pipeline of projects that aim to measure the impact of different types of land management in Costa Rica, Ecuador, Honduras, Mexico and the United States and seek to expand these efforts to other locations and countries in the Americas.


The Project Officer will work closely with the BirdsPlus Index Director to coordinate biodiversity monitoring projects from planning through final reporting. The position will receive mentoring in the scientific concepts, workflows, and technologies that support the BirdsPlus Index and will progressively assume responsibility for independently managing projects, serving as the primary point of contact for partners, coordinating logistics, training collaborators, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality project outcomes that advance bird conservation.


Primary Duties:

Project Management and Coordination

  • Coordinate multiple biodiversity monitoring projects simultaneously, ensuring project timelines, budgets, deliverables, and contractual obligations are completed efficiently and on schedule.
  • Manage project logistics from initiation through completion, including coordinating field deployments of automated recording units (ARUs), equipment preparation, shipping, permitting, travel, and contractor activities.
  • Conduct international travel (approximately 3–5 trips annually) to support project implementation, partner engagement, training, and field activities.
  • Assist with the deployment, maintenance, and retrieval of autonomous recording units (ARUs) and other biodiversity monitoring equipment.

Partner Engagement and Capacity Building

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner organizations throughout project implementation, maintaining regular communication and fostering productive, long-term relationships.
  • Coordinate meetings and technical discussions with non-governmental organizations, research institutions, land managers, and internal ABC staff.
  • Provide training and technical support to project partners on field protocols, biodiversity monitoring methodologies, data collection standards, and the use of BirdsPlus Index tools and technologies.
  • Represent ABC professionally during meetings, workshops, field activities, and partner engagements.

Data Management and Quality Assurance

  • Coordinate the collection, organization, management, and quality assurance of biodiversity monitoring data generated through BirdsPlus Index projects.
  • Coordinate with software developers, data scientists, and technical staff to resolve data quality issues and facilitate efficient processing through analytical workflows.

Reporting and Technical Communication

  • Prepare technical reports, project summaries, presentations, and other project deliverables in collaboration with the BirdsPlus Index team.
  • Translate complex scientific analyses into clear, concise, and professional reports and communications for partners, donors, and other stakeholders.
  • Develop figures, maps, data summaries, and supporting materials that effectively communicate project outcomes and lessons learned.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

To Apply:

Please apply online at Paylocity.


If you have any difficulties uploading your resume and cover letter, then please send them as ONE document to birdsplusindex@abcbirds.org



At American Bird Conservancy, we believe that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills makes us more effective. We are committed to creating a respectful and inclusive work environment for all of our employees.


As an equal opportunity employer, ABC is committed to ensuring that employees and applicants for employment have equal opportunities regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor unrelated to the requirements of the position.

title: Rigger
description:
Overview

Are you looking for a new career and new challenges? Are you looking for an exciting opportunity that offers both paid training and room to grow?

If yes, then apply today for the position of Rigger at Electric Boat where we will assist in building the most advanced and sophisticated submarines in the world!

What We Offer:

  • Paid Training
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401K plan with up to 6% employer match
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • Shift Premium
  • Health and Wellness Programs
  • Commuter/Van Services/Ripta
  • Tuition Reimbursement Programs
  • Safety Boot Reimbursement Program
  • Growth Opportunities

Rigger duties include but are not limited to:

Electric Boat Riggers participate in all indoor & outdoor lifting, handling and moving of heavy loads at the facility.

  • Riggers will be required to use typical rigging equipment that includes but is not limited to straps, cables, chains, slings, block and tackle, pulleys, and booms
  • Riggers will work with mobile cranes with a capacity of up to 120 ton and overhead cranes (radio control and pendent control) with a capacity of up to 60 ton. Riggers will eventually become trained and qualified to operate overhead cranes and forklifts along with types of handling gear
  • This position requires the use of hand signals to communicate with mobile crane operators to ensure all lifting and handling functions are completed properly and safely
  • This position also requires work to be performed on ships, barges as well as indoors and outdoors
  • Candidates will be required to work at heights, confined spaces, inclement weather and support extended hours and overtime as business needs dictate

This position is located at the Quonset Point facility in North Kingstown, RI.

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma/GED OR a minimum of 2 years related technical experience
  • Must have experience or training in at least one of the following areas;
    • Rigging or related lifting & handling, heavy equipment operator, construction or related experience
  • Valid drivers' license
  • Available to work all shifts and to support overtime as needed
  • Ability to work at heights, in confined spaces and in extreme temperature conditions as required
  • Ability to read, interpret, and work from policies and procedures
  • Individuals are required to possess their own basic hand tools

Preferred:

  • Rigging or related lifting & handling experience or training
  • Heavy Equipment Operator
  • Forklift experience
  • Experience in Mobile Crane and/or overhead crane operation
  • Experience operating Crawler Crane
  • Vocational, Technical and Community Colleges or Apprentice programs
  • Understanding of basic crane hand signals
  • Experience working in the construction environment
  • Ability to read, interpret, and work from blueprints
  • Military/Navy experience

Skills

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong written communication skills for documentation and reporting purposes

Physical Qualifications

Climbing, Crawling, Kneeling, Light Lifting, Medium Lifting, Pulling, Pushing, Reaching, Stooping, Twisting

Environmental Attributes

Cold, Dry, Dusty, Fumes, Hot, Inside, Noise, Oily, Outside, Wet

title: Med Tech: 6a-6p/ 6p-6a
description:

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: Edison High School, Virginia, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Edison High School, Virginia.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Edison High School area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Edison High School requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Distribution Designer
description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking an experienced Distribution Designer or Design Engineer to support ongoing projects for Utilities. The role is remote and open to candidates nationwide, though preference is given to those living in or near Florida. The ideal candidate has strong experience with utility standards and workflows, including the use of PoleForeman, Autodesk Utility Design (AUD), INFOR EFD, and ArcFM.This individual will be responsible for preparing detailed design packages for overhead and underground electric distribution systems, collaborating with remote team members, and interfacing with utility contacts as needed.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • System Design and Engineering

    • Develop electric distribution design packages (OH/UG) per Electric Utilities’ standards and specifications.

    • Use PoleForeman for pole loading calculations and structural analysis.

    • Produce designs using Autodesk Utility Design (AUD) and ArcFM, incorporating GIS data and field notes.

    • Navigate INFOR EFD for work management and tracking.

    • Apply NESC, NEC, and utility criteria for clearance, conductor selection, and construction unit application.

  • Project Support & Documentation

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Elkhorn, Wisconsin.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Elkhorn area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Elkhorn requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
