title: IT Help Desk Analyst - Tier 1
description:
Millennium Hotels & Resorts – Corporate
Location: Onsite – Denver Tech, Colorado (5 Days in the Office)
Hourly - $22.00 - $25.00

Join the Team at Millennium Hotels & Resorts

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, we are driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and delivering exceptional hospitality experiences across a global portfolio. Our corporate teams play a critical role in supporting our properties, driving strategy, and enabling operational success.

About Corporate Operations

Our corporate office serves as the strategic and operational hub for Millennium Hotels & Resorts, supporting the hotels across multiple regions and brands. From finance and human resources to operations, marketing, and development, our teams work collaboratively to drive performance, enhance guest experiences, and support our employees across the portfolio.

This environment is fast-paced, collaborative, and focused on delivering results while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and service.

As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotels are backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence.

At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:

  • Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit – Taking ownership and acting with agility
  • Innovation – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
  • Progressive & Solutions-Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results

These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our employees.

About the Role

As our IT Help Desk Analyst – Tier 1, you will play an integral role in providing timely, reliable technical support to our employees while contributing to a collaborative and service-focused IT team environment.

This role is ideal for someone who brings a passion for helping others, strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement and results.

Your Impact – Frontline / Tier 1

You are a key point of contact for employees needing technical assistance. Your responsiveness, technical knowledge, and service mindset will help ensure employees have the tools, access, and support they need to work effectively. You will troubleshoot issues, resolve common technical problems, and escalate more complex matters while providing a positive support experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide first-level technical support to employees by phone, email, chat, or in person
  • Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, network, and system issues
  • Troubleshoot computers, monitors, printers, mobile devices, applications, and peripheral equipment
  • Assist employees with password resets, account access, software issues, and basic connectivity problems
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Tier 2, Tier 3, or the appropriate IT resource

Service & User Experience

  • Deliver responsive, professional, and customer-focused technical support
  • Communicate technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical knowledge
  • Follow up on open issues to ensure timely resolution and a positive user experience
  • Anticipate user needs and approach problems with a solutions-first mindset
  • Maintain a professional and helpful attitude in a fast-paced environment

Ticket Management & Documentation

  • Accurately log, prioritize, track, and resolve help desk tickets
  • Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and relevant technical information
  • Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, user accounts, and support activities
  • Meet established response and resolution timeframes
  • Identify recurring issues and communicate trends or potential improvements to IT leadership

Systems & Access Support

  • Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding by supporting account setup, equipment, and access needs
  • Support user access to company systems, applications, and technology resources
  • Assist with the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of IT equipment
  • Follow established procedures for user permissions, security, and access management
  • Support IT projects, system upgrades, and technology initiatives as assigned

Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with IT and other departments to resolve technical issues
  • Communicate effectively with employees, managers, vendors, and IT team members
  • Share knowledge and contribute to a positive, solutions-oriented team environment
  • Support a culture of respect, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Assist with developing and maintaining helpful technical resources and knowledge articles

Security, Compliance & Standards

  • Follow all company IT policies, security standards, and procedures
  • Protect confidential company and employee information
  • Follow cybersecurity best practices and report suspected security incidents promptly
  • Maintain accuracy in technical documentation, ticketing, and asset records
  • Uphold a culture of accountability, security, and operational excellence

Requirements

Education & Experience

    • High school diploma or equivalent required
    • Associate degree, technical certification, or coursework in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred
    • Experience in customer service, hospitality, retail, or another service-oriented environment is preferred
    • CompTIA A+, Google IT Support, or other entry-level IT certification is a plus, but not required

Technical Skills

    • Basic understanding of computers, hardware, software, and networking concepts
    • Familiarity with Windows operating systems and common business applications
    • Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues and identify when escalation is needed
    • Comfortable learning new software, systems, and technology
    • Basic understanding of password management, user accounts, and access permissions
    • Ability to accurately document issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in a ticketing system

Communication & Problem-Solving

    • Strong customer service and communication skills
    • Ability to explain technical information clearly to non-technical users
    • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
    • Patient, professional, and approachable when assisting users with technical issues
    • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
    • Ability to prioritize multiple requests and manage competing deadlines
    • Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to learn and develop technical skills

Hospitality & Team Mindset

    • Passion for providing excellent internal customer service
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, hospitality-driven environment
    • Demonstrates ownership and follows through on assigned tasks
    • Works collaboratively with team members and other departments
    • Maintains a positive, solutions-oriented attitude
    • Demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and accountability

Physical & Work Requirements

    • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods
    • Ability to occasionally lift, move, or set up standard IT equipment such as computers, monitors, and printers
    • Flexibility to support occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday IT needs as business requirements dictate

Benefits

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, we support our employees with a competitive benefits package designed to promote wellbeing and long-term success:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match (where applicable)
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Hotel Room Discounts across our global portfolio
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to plan terms and company policy.

Why Join Us

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, you’re not just taking a job—you’re joining a team passionate about hospitality, growth, and creating memorable experiences.

Whether you’re behind the scenes or on the front line, your work makes an impact. If you’re ready to learn, grow, and be part of something meaningful, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
Background

Our 5-year goal is to build on our heritage in elite sport to become the global leader in premium indoor cycling. We will achieve this by expanding our connected product portfolio, accelerating innovation across hardware and digital platforms, and delivering world-class user experiences that keep riders engaged and motivated.

Product development sits at the heart of this vision. Wattbike’s combination of hardware innovation, software excellence and best-in-class performance measurement has established a loyal user base and strong brand reputation.

We are investing in next-generation product development to serve a broader range of customers, increase penetration in international gym and DTC markets, and create seamless training experiences across our hardware and the Wattbike Hub app.

The Role

At Wattbike, we’re driven by a mission to create the world’s most accurate, reliable, and connected training platforms. To continue pushing the limits of performance technology, we’re looking for an experienced Embedded Firmware & Software Engineer to join our hardware engineering team.

You’ll play a key role in developing the firmware and software that power our range of smart, connected indoor training bikes. From sensor integration and power management to wireless communication and user interface control, you’ll help shape the experience that defines Wattbike’s precision and performance.

This role demands a hands-on engineer with a deep understanding of Nordic SoCs, C/C++ embedded development, and wireless communication technologies such as BLE, ANT+, and Wi-Fi. You’ll work closely with the electronics, mechanical, and app development teams to deliver seamless connectivity, stability, and performance across the Wattbike ecosystem.

Immediate priorities:

1. Ownership: Quickly become the internal authority on Wattbike firmware and embedded systems

2. Processes: Implementation of best practice across the design and development of Wattbike firmware

3. Quality: Identify opportunities to improve firmware quality, reliability, and maintainability

Key Responsibilities

Process & Continuous Improvement

• Establish and maintain firmware development standards, documentation, and version control best practice.

• Identify opportunities to improve firmware quality, reliability, and maintainability.

• Stay current with emerging tools, frameworks, and wireless technologies relevant to IoT and connected fitness.

• Lead initiatives to streamline firmware and software development and testing workflows.

• Investigate and resolve firmware issues across development and production stages.

Testing, Validation & Certification

• Develop automated unit and integration tests to ensure software stability and performance.

Debug hardware–software interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and serial tools.

• Conduct performance profiling, fault analysis, and root-cause investigation.

• Support validation, certification, and regulatory compliance processes for connectivity and safety.

Design & Development

• Lead the design and development of firmware for new and existing Wattbike products.

• Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for Wattbike products, from concept through production. • Develop and optimise code for Nordic Semiconductor SoCs using C and C++.

Work within RTOS or bare-metal environments to manage sensors, displays, and connectivity modules.

• Configure and integrate wireless communication stacks (BLE, ANT+, Wi-Fi) to support data transfer, device pairing, and IoT functionality.

• Optimise firmware for low-power performance, reliability, and scalability.

• Implement robust bootloaders, over-the-air (OTA) updates, and system diagnostics.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Act as the internal authority for firmware development within Wattbike.

• Work closely with the electronics, app, and cloud teams to ensure seamless system integration.

• Translate product requirements into efficient firmware architectures and software interfaces.

• Provide technical input on system design, feature planning, and future product architecture.

• Support manufacturing partners in debugging and optimising firmware for production environments

Measures of Success

• Ownership & Leadership: Quickly become the go-to expert for firmware, driving technical decisions with confidence and accountability.

• Reliability & Performance: Deliver firmware that achieves target performance metrics, connectivity reliability, and uptime.

• Quality & Maintainability: Establish clean, documented, and maintainable codebases that support long-term scalability.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work effectively with hardware, software, and manufacturing teams to ensure aligned, on-time delivery.

• Innovation: Introduces new ideas, tools, or methods that enhance product features or development efficiency.

• Process Improvement: Implement improved development workflows, testing frameworks, or debugging processes that enhance team productivity.

Requirements

Essential:

• Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years experience embedded development with 5+ years in a senior/lead developer role

• Proven experience developing embedded firmware in C and C++ for microcontroller-based systems.

• Strong hands-on experience with Nordic Semiconductor SoCs (nRF52/nRF53 family) and the Keil compiler or equivalent toolchains.

Solid understanding of BLE, ANT+, and Wi-Fi communication protocols and embedded networking principles.

• Experience in low-power system design, RTOS environments, and peripheral interfacing (I²C, SPI, UART, ADCs...).

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills using industry-standard tools and methods.

• Familiarity with source control systems (e.g. Git) and structured development workflows.

Desirable:

• Desktop software development experience.

• Interest in sports technology or connected fitness equipment.

Skills & Attributes Required

• Detail and process oriented mindset

• Hands-on approach to problem solving and development

• Resilience & adaptability. Thrives in an agile, fast-paced, SME environment and embraces change.

• Genuine interest in cycling, sport, fitness training, and human performance measurement and technology is a bonus.

Benefits

  • A Wattbike for your home
  • A relaxed culture that supports a great home and work blend
  • Support for personal progression
  • 26 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Pension and life insurance
  • A staff discount on accessories
  • Cycling clubs for the casual rider and racing enthusiasts
  • Onsite training Zone

title: Community Work Incentives Coordinator (CWIC)
description:
Provide information, referral, and advocacy services to individuals with disabilities who are looking for work and who are receiving disability benefits from Social Security or have questions about NH Medicaid programs, state benefits, and public health insurance. Provide work incentives counseling services to individuals with disabilities or receiving state benefits who are looking for work or who are working and trying to navigate the benefits/entitlements systems. Participate in economic development outreach activities for members of the general community, service providers, community organizations, and individuals with disabilities and family members.

Essential functions

  • Provide information and referral services to members of the general community: service providers, community organizations, individuals with disabilities and families about available work incentives for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and/or Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) beneficiaries, medical coverage options (including NH Medicaid programs), subsidized housing options, and state benefits.
  • Conduct timely intakes to ascertain facts about beneficiary issues, provide accurate information, and counsel individuals' about how earnings from employment will affect their SSI and/or SSDI work incentives and state benefits programs (especially medical coverage).
  • Provide in-depth benefits analysis services for NH Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) fee-for-service and referrals with the development of a comprehensive Benefits Summary and Analysis and Work Incentives Plan.
  • Refer job searching beneficiaries to community partner organizations such as NH Vocational Rehabilitation (VR), Employment Networks (ENs), New Hampshire Works/One-Stop Career Center/Unemployment Office, etc.
  • Provide on-going financial counseling follow-up services to all beneficiaries, with priority going to those who are employed or have a job offer pending.
  • Refer general information, referral, and advocacy questions to I&R specialists if they need further information and referral.
  • Maintain professional knowledge and skills by reviewing professional literature and attending trainings and workshops given by VCU, SSA, and other professional resources.
  • Support and uphold GSIL policies and procedures, workplace regulations and safety practices.
  • Share newsworthy information appropriately throughout the organization.

Competencies

  • Deductive ability with analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrate competent interviewing and partnering skills.
  • Demonstrate ability to link individuals with disabilities to employment opportunities.
  • Ability to interpret Federal, State, and local laws, regulations, and administrative code about public benefits.
  • Knowledge of disability terminology used to describe awareness of cultural and political issues for various disability populations.
  • Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) disability programs knowledge.
  • Knowledge of SSA and other Federal, State, and local work incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of all public benefits programs (including TANF and public medical coverage), basic operations and inter-relationships among the programs, specifically in terms of their impact upon employment.
  • Translating technical information for lay individuals.
  • Accessing information in a variety of ways (including the ability to be able to recognize when additional information is needed);
  • Accessing specific Employment Network (EN) information.
  • Interpersonal skills (e.g. recognize and help people manage anger and conflict, enjoy working with individuals).
  • Counseling and evaluation-related skills (ability to listen, evaluate alternatives, advise on potential course of action).
  • Knowledge of SSA field office structure and how to work with various SSA work incentive specialists e.g., Area Work Incentives Coordinator (AWIC), Plan to Achieve Self Support (PASS) Specialists, Work Incentive Liaisons (WILs); and
  • Knowledge of ethics (e.g., confidentiality, conflict of interest);
  • Ability to manage beneficiary case files and information electronically.

Physical/Mental demands

  • While performing the duties of this position, the individual is regularly required to sit, use a computer, a telephone, and other office equipment.
  • This position requires the ability to express or exchange ideas and to comprehend and present detailed and critical information including but not limited to financial information. Exceptional judgment and creativity are regularly required to evaluate results and make decisions.

Required education and experience

  • Must hold CWIC certification and suitability clearance.

Preferred education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in social services, human services, or in a relevant field, education, and/or related experience preferred.
  • Personal experience with a disability preferred.

Additional eligibility requirements

  • Attain 15 Continuing Certification Credits (CCCs) to maintain CWIC certification each year through VCU trainings and benefits analysis review trainings.

About Us

Granite State Independent Living is a statewide non-profit and New Hampshire's only Center for Independent Living, we stay close to our roots with a focus on our 5 core services of education, information, advocacy, support, and transition services for people with disabilities and underserved youth. We can speak and think with authority on behalf of the people we serve and support because we are led by a board of directors and staff of which over 51% are people with disabilities.

We carry out our mission through our Home Care Services, Community-Based Disability Supports and Employment Services. With the help of our local New Hampshire communities, we assist people with the tools for living life independently, so they can change their lives for the better. While much has changed over the years, one thing remains the same; GSIL is committed to the principle of personal choice and direction.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Davie, Florida.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Davie area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Davie requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. title: Ohjaaja (joulun ajan sijaisuuksia) Rinnekodit Mäntylään
description:
Rinnekodit on työntekijöidensä kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia tukeva työpaikka. Rakennamme yhdessä arvostavaa ja yhdenvertaista työkulttuuria, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä.

Haemme nyt ohjaajia erimittaisiin määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin välille 9.11.2026-31.1.2027 varmistamaan asiakkaidemme sujuvaa arkea tiimimme vuosilomien aikaan.

Tervetuloa Rinnekodit Mäntylään!

Asumisen tuen yksikkömme Rinnekodit Mäntylä aloitti toimintansa upeissa, moderneiksi remontoiduissa tiloissa Tapiolan ytimessä vuonna 2023. Yksikkö tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista asumispalvelua 29 kehitysvammaiselle asiakkaalle. Lisäksi Mäntylässä on 10 yhteisöllisen asumisen paikkaa.

Liikenneyhteydet meille ovat loistavat: voit kulkea meille kätevästi metrolla, bussilla tai vaikka polkupyörällä.

Tavoitteemme on tukea asiakkaidemme toimijuutta ja osallisuutta heidän omassa arjessaan. Asiakkaidemme toimintakyky vaihtelee ja jokainen heistä on omanlaisensa persoona. Tällaisena haluamme asiakkaamme myös kohdata; meillä jokainen on juuri oikeanlainen omana itsenään!

Tehtävä ja sen tavoitteet

Ohjaajana olet avainroolissa asiakkaiden yksilöllisten tarpeiden tunnistamisessa ja laadukkaan hoidon tarjoamisessa. Varmistat asiakkaillemme sujuvan arjen lomakauden aikana ja olet mukana luomassa tunnelmallista joulun aikaa.

Työsi sisältää muun muassa perushoitoa, lääkehoitoa sekä ohjausta ja tukea arjen eri toiminnoissa. Sanallisen ohjaamisen lisäksi tuet asiakkaita myös tarvittaessa fyysisesti päivittäisissä toimissa. Tarjoamme hyvän perehdytyksen ja erilaisia koulutuksia sujuvan työskentelyn varmistamiseksi.

Työskentelet ammattitaitoisella otteella asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta kunnioittaen ja hänet arvostavasti kohdaten.

Odotamme sinulta:
- lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja Lupa- ja valvontaviraston Suosikki-rekisteröintiä TAI loppuvaiheen opintoja
- sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikorttia (Kanta-varmennekortti) TAI valmiutta hankkia kortti koeajan aikana
- valmiutta kolmivuorotyöhön
- suomen kielen perusosaamista, jota tarvitset kirjaamisessa ja asiakkaiden kohtaamisessa
- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa
- aiempi kokemus autisminkirjon henkilöiden kanssa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi

Rinnekodit on savuton ja päihteetön työpaikka.

Tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen tehtävään valitulta lainsäädännön (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta) tarkoittamalla tavalla ennen työsuhteen solmimista. Rikosrekisteriote ei saa olla kuutta kuukautta vanhempi.


Työyhteisö ja kulttuuri

Työyhteisöömme kuuluu lähihoitajia, sairaanhoitajia, erityisohjaajia, kodinhuoltaja, vastaava ohjaaja, sekä esihenkilönäsi toimiva palveluyksikön johtaja. Esihenkilösi on sitoutunut tukemaan sinun ja koko työyhteisön kehittymistä valmentavalla otteella – kannustaen, palautetta antaen ja huolen hetkellä kuunnellen. Rohkaisemme toisiamme kasvamaan sekä omilla poluillamme että yhdessä!

Käytössämme on turvallisemman tilan periaatteet. Näitä yhdessä noudattamalla varmistamme jokaiselle arvostavan, turvallisen ja viihtyisän työyhteisön, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä.


Tarjoamme sinulle:
- valmistuneelle lähihoitajalle palkkaluokan G22 mukaisen palkkauksen (2562,61-2901,33 € + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset vuorolisät)
- loppuvaiheen lähihoitajaopiskelijalle palkkaluokan G22 -6% mukaisen palkkauksen (2408,85 - 2727,25 € + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset vuorolisät)
- monipuolisen työterveyshuollon ja laajan vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen
- oman perehdyttäjän ja sinulle suunnitellun vieraanvaraisen perehdytyksen
- tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi ja vahvuuksiasi
- mahdollisuuden osallistua urasparraukseen


Työpaikan hakeminen ja rekrytoinnin eteneminen

Voit jättää hakemuksesi helposti vastaamalla muutamaan kysymykseen. Toivomme, että jätät hakemuksesi suomeksi. Hakuaika päättyy 18.10.2026 – voimme kuitenkin sulkea rekrytoinnin jo aiemmin oikean henkilön löytyessä. Ensimmäiset haastattelut pidämme 21.9.2026 alkavalla viikolla. Työ alkaa 9.11.2026 ja päättyy joko 3.1. tai 31.1.2026.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme ja kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia henkilöitä hakemaan meille töihin.


Kysyttävää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä:

Palveluyksikön johtaja Tomas Öhman

Arkisin 8-16 puh. 040 670 4880

tai tomas.ohman@rinnekodit.fi


Lue lisää yksiköstämme: Rinnekodit Mäntylä


Rinnekodit on kaupungistuvan Suomen erityispalvelujen tuottaja. Rinnekodit tarjoaa vaikuttavia sote-palveluja ikääntyneille, kehitysvammaisille, eri tavoin vammautuneille, mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille ja asunnottomille henkilöille, lapsille ja nuorille sekä muille erityistä tukea tarvitseville ihmisille. Rinnekodit on myös merkityksellinen työpaikka noin 2 900 sote-alan ammattilaiselle, jotka tekevät työtä ammattitaidolla ja sydän mukana. Rinnekodit on yhteiskunnallinen yritys ja osa Diakonissalaitoksen yleishyödyllistä säätiökonsernia.

www.rinnekodit.fi

title: Program Administrator - Too Good Program (Part-Time)
description:
Cherishing Our Children Since 1977

Helping children and families help themselves to live a better life and build a stronger community.


The Center for Family and Child Enrichment (CFCE) is dedicated to help children and their families by providing the right services and solutions based on individual needs. CFCE is constantly evolving to better support our community.



The Program Administrator at the Center for Family and Child Enrichment (CFCE) provides overall administrative, operational, and programmatic oversight of CFCE’s Too Good for Drugs (TGFD) prevention program. The Program Administrator provides leadership and supervision to designated program staff, ensures effective and consistent implementation of the Too Good for Drugs curriculum, monitors program performance and outcomes, and promotes compliance with CFCE policies, funder requirements, and applicable regulatory and evidence-based program standards.

The Program Administrator works collaboratively with schools, community organizations, behavioral health providers, families, referral sources, and other stakeholders to support the successful delivery of substance-use prevention and life-skills programming to children, adolescents, and families. The position is responsible for maintaining high-quality services, supporting staff development, monitoring program documentation and performance, coordinating referrals and enrollment activities, and promoting culturally responsive and trauma-informed services for diverse and underserved populations.


Why join CFCE:

  • Great benefits package, including a Zero (0) cost out of pocket medical plan, 13 Paid Holidays and a competitive Paid Time Off Package
  • Making an invaluable impact in your community
  • Growth and professional development opportunities available
  • Qualify for Public Service Loan Forgiveness
  • We are a tax-exempt organization under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code


Some of the Functions Include:

  • Oversee daily administration and operations of the Too Good for Drugs program.
  • Supervise, support, and evaluate designated program staff.
  • Coordinate program scheduling, groups, educational activities, referrals, and enrollment.
  • Ensure consistent and effective implementation of the Too Good for Drugs curriculum.
  • Monitor program participation, outcomes, documentation, and compliance.
  • Maintain effective relationships with schools, families, community partners, and referral sources.
  • Coordinate staff training, coaching, and professional development.
  • Complete required program reports, outcome measures, and administrative documentation.
  • Support quality improvement, community outreach, and educational activities.
  • Assist with budget monitoring and other program administrative functions.
  • Ensure compliance with CFCE policies, funder requirements, applicable regulations, and confidentiality standards.
  • Prepare and present program updates and performance data as needed..
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Minimum Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Education, Public Health, Behavioral Science, or a related field required; Master’s preferred.
  • Five years of experience in prevention, behavioral health, social services, youth services, education, or a related field.
  • Supervisory or program management experience required.
  • Experience with evidence-based prevention programs and the Too Good for Drugs curriculum preferred.
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, families, and diverse or underserved populations preferred..
  • Valid Driver’s License, current auto insurance, and access to a reliable vehicle


Skills Needed

  • Strong program management, organizational, and supervisory skills.
  • Knowledge of substance-use prevention, youth development, and evidence-based programming.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse and underserved populations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and electronic documentation systems.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable requirements.


CFCE is a Drug Free Workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Centrum Medyczne Damiana jest jednostką współpracującą z firmą Medicover, które jest liderem na rynku prywatnej opieki zdrowotnej w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej. Jakość świadczonych usług oraz satysfakcja Klientów sprawiają, że spółki Medicover są utożsamiane z kompleksową opieką medyczną na najwyższym poziomie.


Obecnie poszukujemy kandydatów na stanowisko:

Do Twoich zadań na tym stanowisku należeć będzie:

  • zapewnianie najwyższej jakości usług medycznych oraz monitorowanie zgodności realizowanych świadczeń z obowiązującymi standardami,
  • koordynacja działań oraz ścisła współpraca z zespołami i działami powiązanymi,
  • współpraca z wymagającymi klientami w środowisku międzynarodowym,
  • odpowiedzialność za budżet jednostki oraz efektywne zarządzanie kosztami zgodnie z założeniami biznesowymi,
  • bieżący kontakt i utrzymywanie relacji z kontrahentami oraz aktywne pozyskiwanie nowych partnerów biznesowych,
  • negocjowanie warunków współpracy, w tym kontraktów i warunków cenowych.

Najlepszy kandydat to osoba, która:

  • posiada doświadczenie na stanowisku managerskim, mile widziane w sektorze medycznym, ​
  • swobodnie komunikuje się w języku angielskim na poziomie minimum C1,
  • wyróżnia się wysoko rozwiniętymi umiejętnościami interpersonalnymi oraz łatwością w budowaniu trwałych relacji, a także umiejętnością reprezentowania organizacji w kontaktach z klientami i partnerami biznesowymi,​​
  • efektywnie współpracuje z różnorodnymi zespołami i dba o pozytywną atmosferę współpracy,​
  • prezentuje przedsiębiorcze podejście, przejawia inicjatywę oraz konsekwentnie realizuje wyznaczone cele biznesowe.

Jakie warunki współpracy możemy Ci zaproponować?

  • zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę na pełen etat,
  • pracę w modelu od poniedziałku do piątku,
  • proces wdrożeniowy oraz wsparcie umożliwiające sprawne wejście w nową rolę,
  • dostęp do rozbudowanej platformy benefitowej, a w niej m.in.: karta sportowa, prywatna opieka medyczna, ubezpieczenie na życie oraz inne możliwości dopasowane do różnych potrzeb!​

title: Pump Technician
description:
Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, services, and solutions for the LNG and industrial gases industry. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over $1.5B in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Nikkiso Cryogenic Services (NCS) is an industry leader in the provision of services to the industrial gas and air separation industries, enhanced oil recovery operations, marine, clean energy, and alternative fuels markets. Boasting a vast portfolio of innovative solutions, cutting-edge technology, and expert services, the company stands tall as a go-to service provider for a wide range of clients. The company has carved a niche for itself in the market with its consistent delivery of top-tier services that are tailored to meet the specific needs of each industry. Our products have been instrumental in enabling customers to realize safer, greener, and more sustainable operations. From liquefied natural gas (LNG) systems to industrial gas equipment, every product is designed and manufactured with the utmost consideration for safety and environmental sustainability.

Nikkiso Cryogenic Services is not just a leading service provider to a range of industries, but also a champion of safer, greener operations. Its products and services are designed to meet the dual objectives of operational efficiency and sustainability, helping clients achieve their goals while minimizing environmental impact.

Job Overview

Job Summary

The Pump Technician is responsible for high-quality repair of cryogenic pumps. The position performs disassembly, analysis, troubleshooting, and rebuilding of customer pumps. The Pump Technician must be highly productive and produce quality repairs on time and within budget to achieve complete customer satisfaction. The senior pump technician will be responsible for overseeing various safety and compliance measures.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Read, interpret and work from drawings
  • Disassemble, analyze, and rebuild cryogenic pumps, accessories, and motors to optimize performance
  • Operate drill press, hydraulic press, bench grinder, pipe threading machine, pipe bender, cutting torch, band saw, and other shop equipment
  • Analyze condition of parts for causes of damage by operation in the field in order to communicate with customers and improve reliability
  • Perform assembly of cryogenic pump components
    • Fit, align, and adjust all components, including bearings and seals, and units to close tolerances and
    • Document all clearances on assembly clearance data sheet for review and approval of engineering
  • Check work to ensure conformance to specifications, instructions, and customer requirements on all drawings and work instructions per standard operating procedures
  • Perform troubleshooting as needed
  • Rework parts when necessary
  • Contribute input to failure analysis when requested
  • Maintain tools, equipment. and work area in accordance with 5S principles
  • Follow all quality, engineering, sales, and safety procedures
    • Coordinate, participate in, and potentially lead weekly and monthly safety meetings.
    • Ensure safety and compliance measures are met.
    • Lead shop’s 5S initiative.
  • Maintain consistent and regular attendance to meet production schedules.
  • Provide technical guidance to customers
  • Communicate with customers regarding service evaluations and coordination of service-related issues
  • Meet customer and company production schedules at a rate of 80% on time or better
  • Perform all duties in accordance with OSHA standards and regulations and
  • Comply with company safety policies and procedures
  • Promote Customer Focus throughout the company
  • Support IMS requirements in areas of responsibility for conformance with international requirements and state and federal regulations
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but does serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the department.

Qualifications

Competencies

  • Ability to read prints and schematics.
  • Analytical skills for cryogenic pumps.
  • Balancing skills related to cryogenic pump repair.
  • Inspection skills on machinery.
  • Knowledge of basic AC/DC circuitry.
  • Understanding of materials of construction
  • Understanding of various system components (regulators, valves, solenoids, pressure relief devices, etc.)
  • Microsoft Office skills.
  • Organized.
  • Initiative.
  • Communication skills, including the ability to explain clearly, listen to the feedback of clients – and relay this to colleagues.
  • Team player.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Customer focus.
  • Problem solving skills.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 7-8 Years of mechanical experience.
  • Cryogenic pump experience is ideal.
  • Experience in the industrial manufacturing industry preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Stand, walk, sit, talk, hear, type, and write.
  • Reach with hands and arms, bend, stand on a stool or climb, and use fingers and hands to feel and use objects, tools, or controls.
  • Use standard office equipment such as computers, telephones, printers, copiers, etc.
  • Lift files and open desk drawers and filing cabinets.
  • Lift 50-100 pounds.
  • Work in shop environment, primarily at the Customer Center, however, may go to customer sites.

Work Environment

  • Job will generally be performed in a workshop environment.

Safety

  • Complete safety training requirements.
  • Participate in other training as directed by the company or manager.
  • Wear appropriate PPE as required and direct others as appropriate.
  • Report safety issues and concerns promptly.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

EEOC Statement

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/DisabledNikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases Group companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: General Production Grade 1-SS
description:
Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. is a global leader in the production, distribution, and marketing of fresh, value-added, and shelf-stable fruits and vegetables under our Fresh and Foods divisions. Our diverse product portfolio proudly bears the Del Monte® brand and also includes prepared fruits and vegetables, juices, beverages, snacks, and desserts - available in over 80 countries worldwide. With operations spanning more than 35 countries, we’ve proudly been nourishing families for over 135 years.


Purpose of Position:


Del Monte Foods is the Foods Division of Fresh Del Monte, a global grower, producer and marketer of fresh, value-added, and shelf-stable produce. Del Monte Foods has a powerful portfolio of brands, including the iconic Del Monte®, Contadina® and S&W®. We are currently seeking Seasonal General Production Workers. Del Monte Foods in Plover, Wisconsin is hiring Seasonal General Production Workers to support our annual vegetable pack season. Seasonal employment typically begins in June and may continue through October with opportunities for extended work through late November/early December based on operational needs and employee performance.


Seasonal employees may work in a variety of production, canning, warehouse, sorting, sanitation, cleanup, or packaging support roles throughout the facility. Assignments are determined based on operational needs, training, and employee qualifications.

Schedules may include day or night shift assignments, overtime, weekends, and shifts up to 12 hours per day during peak production periods.


Del Monte Foods en Plover, Wisconsin está contratando Trabajadores Generales de Producción Temporales para apoyar nuestra temporada anual de empaque. Los empleados temporales pueden trabajar en producción, selección, limpieza, empaque, apoyo de almacén, saneamiento u otras áreas operativas según las necesidades del negocio. Durante la temporada alta, puede ser necesario trabajar horarios flexibles, tiempo extra y fines de semana.


Accountabilities:

  • Key Responsibilities for General Production Grade 1 Roles
  • Employees may perform duties in one or more operational areas, including:
  • Inspect, sort, and remove defective or foreign material from raw or finished product
  • Support canning and packaging operations by monitoring line flow and product quality
  • Supply materials such as lids, jars, or packaging components to production lines
  • Maintain clean work areas, platforms, equipment, and walkways
  • Assist with sanitation and cleanup throughout production and warehouse areas
  • Operate assigned production equipment or assist equipment operators
  • Monitor conveyors and production lines for jams, defects, or equipment concerns
  • Handle product, packaging materials, or waste materials safely and efficiently
  • Follow all food safety, GMP, quality, and safety requirements
  • Report equipment malfunctions, safety concerns, or product issues to leadership
  • Assist with additional operational duties as assigned


Training

  • On-the-job training is provided for all assigned work areas. Employees may be cross trained in multiple operational functions based on business needs.


Seasonal Incentives


To support employees during our peak pack season, Del Monte Foods offers select incentives for eligible seasonal workers. These incentives are designed to assist with temporary relocation and seasonal work demands and may include:

• Housing assistance or housing incentives

• Transportation allowance

• Sanitation Bonus (for eligible employees)


These incentives are available only during the active pack season (typically June through early October) and are subject to eligibility requirements, availability, and business needs. Incentives may be modified or discontinued at any time based on operational conditions.


Minimum Skills Required:

  • Ability to work safely in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
  • Ability to maintain productivity and quality standards during extended shifts
  • Ability to work cooperatively with supervisors, crew leaders, and co-workers
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive tasks throughout the shift
  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions including heat, humidity, wet conditions, noise, and moving equipment
  • Ability to work overtime, weekends, and flexible schedules during peak production periods
  • Ability to comply with all food safety, GMP, quality, and workplace safety requirements
  • Ability to safely work around conveyors, forklifts, production machinery, hot surfaces, and processing equipment
  • Reliable attendance and dependability throughout the seasonal production period.
  • Previous manufacturing, production, warehouse, food processing, agricultural, or industrial experience
  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced or team-based environment
  • Experience operating or working around manufacturing or packaging equipment
  • Prior experience with sanitation, cleanup, sorting, inspection, or production support activities
  • Bilingual communication skills are a plus but not required.
  • An equivalent combination of education, training, military service, agricultural work, manufacturing experience, warehouse experience, or related work experience that demonstrates the ability to successfully perform the essential functions of the position may be considered.


***Please note: This position does not qualify for relocation expenses.***


Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. is a global leader in the production, distribution, and marketing of fresh and fresh cut fruits and vegetables. Our diverse product portfolio also includes prepared fruits and vegetables, juices, beverages, snacks, and desserts—available in over 80 countries worldwide. With operations spanning more than 35 countries, we’ve proudly been nourishing families for over 135 years.


We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fresh Del Monte and its affiliates do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also participate in E-Verify* where applicable, to ensure employment authorization eligibility. Driven by our core values—Excellence, Care, Passion, Trust, and Creativity—we invite you to explore our career opportunities and join our FRESH team.

title: Safety Advisor
description:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending, a 401k with employer matching, paid holidays, Life and Disability Insurance, and additional supplemental products.

title: Production Coordinator Lead
description:
About Us:

Panelmatic, Inc. was founded in 1957 in Youngstown, OH to serve manufacturing industries with the design and build of custom electrical, instrument, and pneumatic control panels. Our business has sufficiently grown over the years to support expansion for our clients. We have produced control packages for many of America's top corporations in the chemical, environmental, food, pulp and paper, rubber, petroleum, pharmaceutical, glass, metals, and utilities industries. We also deliver equipment for use worldwide. Our rigorous methodology assures compliance with domestic and international standards. We can meet the needs of our diverse clientele from start to finish through sales, design, fabrication, testing, and delivery.

Since 1957, we have been known for our high-quality, custom-built control packages, our comprehensive service, and our technological and manufacturing expertise. This expertise assures you of our ability to handle the largest and most complex packages quickly and efficiently.

Job Summary:

Panelmatic is seeking a detail-oriented experienced Production Coordinator Lead. The Production Coordinator will coordinate production schedules and manufacturing activities.

Job Duties:

  • Coordinate production schedules, priorities, and manufacturing activities to support on-time delivery.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for production coordination and schedule-related issues.
  • Monitor daily production progress and proactively identify potential delays, constraints, or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Production, Engineering, Purchasing, Inventory, Quality, Supply Chain, and Logistics, to resolve production issues.
  • Assign, track, and follow up on action items while holding task owners accountable to committed deadlines.
  • Ensure all required stage gates are completed and verified prior to Clear-to-Build.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date production schedules, records, trackers, and status reports.
  • Provide regular production status updates and communicate changes, risks, and recovery plans to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Coordinate material, labor, information, and other production requirements to support manufacturing schedules.
  • Monitor workflow and production capacity to identify opportunities to improve throughput and efficiency.
  • Escalate production risks and issues in a timely manner and help drive corrective actions to resolution.
  • Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives related to production delays, quality issues, and process inefficiencies.
  • Assist in prioritizing work based on customer commitments, production requirements, material availability, and business needs.
  • Partner with Inventory and Purchasing to identify and resolve material shortages or supply constraints that may impact production.
  • Coordinate with Quality to ensure required inspections, documentation, and quality requirements are completed before production milestones.
  • Support timely delivery of finished products by maintaining visibility of production status through completion and shipment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve scheduling processes, communication, workflow, and overall operational efficiency.
  • Help establish and maintain standardized processes, procedures, and best practices for production coordination.
  • Provide guidance and day-to-day leadership to Production Coordinators and/or other team members as assigned.
  • Serve as a resource and escalation point for less experienced coordinators.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, urgency, teamwork, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4–7 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably within metal manufacturing/fabrication.
  • Previous experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Production Coordination
    • Inventory Control
    • Purchasing
    • Supply Chain
    • Logistics
    • Shop Management
    • Manufacturing Operations
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production flow, and shop operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of production scheduling and time management.
    • Experience tracking production performance and identifying schedule risks.
    • Ability to effectively communicate with both shop-floor personnel and office/management teams.
    • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to take ownership, follow through, and hold others accountable to commitments.
    • Project management or production planning experience preferred.
    • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and process optimization principles.
    • Knowledge of quality control standards and manufacturing best practices.
    • Knowledge of manufacturing safety standards and a commitment to maintaining a safe work environment.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
    • Experience with ERP, MRP, inventory management, or manufacturing scheduling software.
    • Acute attention to detail, particularly regarding production schedules, documentation, and deadlines.
    • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
    • Ability to work effectively under pressure and adapt to changing production priorities.
    • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional technical, manufacturing, or business education is a plus.

Leadership Expectations

  • As the Lead in this role, the Production Coordinator is expected to:
    • Take ownership of the overall production coordination process and ensure priorities are clearly communicated.
    • Proactively identify issues rather than waiting for problems to impact the schedule.
    • Establish clear ownership and deadlines for cross-functional action items.
    • Follow up consistently and escalate missed commitments when necessary.
    • Mentor and support other Production Coordinators.
    • Drive accountability while maintaining positive and professional working relationships.
    • Provide leadership through organization, communication, urgency, and follow-through.
    • Continuously look for ways to improve production flow, reduce delays, and optimize operational efficiency.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, HSA, term life, AD&D, STD, LTD
  • 100% medical premium paid for by Panelmatic for the employee-only level medical coverage
  • 80% paid for by Panelmatic and 20% paid for by the employee on all other level medical coverage (i.e. employee plus child, employee plus spouse, family)
  • 401(k) contributions matched 100% up to 4%
  • Scholarships, educational reimbursement, paid volunteerism, and paid personal and professional development provided
  • PTO and paid holidays provided
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Competitive wages
  • Family-friendly environment with average employee tenure above five years

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Riverside, Illinois.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Riverside area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Riverside requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Keravalle
description:
Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Keravalle.

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

  • Joustavan työajan

  • Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

  • Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

  • Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

  • Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin

Toivomme sinulta

  • Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

  • Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

  • Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

  • Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Clearwater, Florida.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Clearwater area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Clearwater requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Analyst, Corporate Finance (Deals)
description:
Job Title: Analyst, Corporate Finance

Department: Corporate Finance
Reporting To: Emma Villaruel
Location: Los Angeles
Hybrid Working: 3 days in your local office
Full-time | Permanent

The Role

Joining our global Corporate Finance team, the Analyst will be based in our Los Angeles office and play an active role in Kobalt’s deal processes. Working closely with A&R, senior management and Legal, the team provides financial analysis to support the signing of artists and songwriters, catalogue acquisitions and broader financial and strategic analysis.

You’ll be responsible for analysing potential investments, building and managing financial models, evaluating streaming and royalty data, and developing recommendations to support deal decisions. This role requires strong financial and analytical judgement, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple live deals and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with the A&R team to analyse new signing opportunities and provide financial insight to support deal negotiations.
  • Build and manage financial models in Excel to evaluate musical assets, analysing streaming and royalty data and forecasting future cash flows to inform valuations and potential offers.
  • Develop a point of view on potential investments, identifying key opportunities, risks and sensitivities and making recommendations based on your analysis.
  • Prepare investment memos that clearly communicate key findings and recommendations to A&R and senior management.
  • Conduct financial analysis to test and refine investment assumptions and support wider strategic and commercial projects across the team.
  • Work with large and varied datasets, identifying trends and translating analysis into clear commercial insights.
  • Manage multiple live deal processes and analytical requests, working closely with stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve modelling, analysis and team workflows through automation and new technology.

What You’ll Bring

  • A strong interest in music and a desire to make the industry fairer and more rewarding for creators.
  • A relevant background in Finance, including a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or Economics, and 1-2 years experience in a finance or music industry role.
  • Strong Excel skills and some experience building and managing financial models is beneficial.
  • Experience analysing financial or commercial data and using it to form opinions and recommendations.
  • The ability to assess the merits, risks and key assumptions of potential investments and confidently discuss your conclusions.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present financial analysis clearly to different stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deals, data inputs and stakeholders within tight deadlines.
  • An interest in using automation and technology to improve financial analysis and team workflows.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value:

  • Experience using SQL to query and analyse data.
  • Experience with Python, Tableau or other data and visualisation tools.
  • Knowledge of the music industry, particularly music publishing, recorded music or music rights.
  • Experience valuing assets, forecasting cash flows or assessing investment opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

By Month 1: You’ll have developed an understanding of Kobalt’s deal process, internal systems and music publishing fundamentals. You’ll be working on live deals and building relationships with A&R, Legal and the wider Corporate Finance team.

By Month 3: You’ll be taking ownership of core analysis across standard deal opportunities, independently gathering and interrogating data, building financial models and developing recommendations with appropriate oversight from senior members of the team.

By Month 6: You’ll be independently managing the financial analysis for straightforward deals from initial assessment through to recommendation, confidently communicating your findings to stakeholders and contributing to more complex deals, catalogue acquisitions and wider strategic analysis.

Key Behaviours for Success

Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: You critically analyse financial and commercial data, challenge assumptions and develop well-reasoned recommendations to support investment and deal decisions.

Commercial Judgement: You look beyond the numbers to understand the commercial drivers, risks and opportunities behind a potential investment and develop a clear point of view.

Time Management & Prioritisation: You effectively manage multiple live deals, analytical requests and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair, and rewarding for artists, songwriters, and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, FINNEAS, and Andrew Watt as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and progress. Our values: Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered, and Transformative. Shape how we work, build, and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know we’re happy to help.

If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below. To get you in the right mood, have a listen here to songs by our talented creators, especially curated to get you in the right mood when looking for the next challenge!

IMPORTANT NOTICE

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States. Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other status or characteristic protected by law.
