title: Managing Director - Central
description:
Position Description


Advanced Energy United seeks a solutions-oriented, innovative, and politically savvy Managing Director to join United’s policy team. The Managing Director will oversee a team of advocates and shape policy advocacy strategies in the Central U.S. region, lead member engagement in the region, and work collaboratively with program directors to develop and implement multi-year strategies and campaigns designed to achieve policy successes that will accelerate the transition to 100% clean energy and electrified transportation while expanding markets for the advanced energy industry.


This is a unique opportunity to join a high-functioning team and organization, and lead strategy and execution in key states. The ideal candidate will be a highly energetic and self-starting professional who brings a background in issue advocacy at the state or federal level and experience with clean energy. The Managing Director will work collaboratively with United’s other Managing Directors, and will lead strategy development and execution, with project teams on both internal and external projects to advance United’s policy agenda in priority states including Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Texas and Wisconsin. Candidates should be creative and flexible, with the ability to develop and execute strategies, working in multiple venues with diverse stakeholders. The successful candidate will have excellent organizational, managerial and mentoring skills, the ability to find common ground both with corporate membership and external stakeholders, and a successful track record generating revenue. Candidates will need to travel frequently to meet with United members, coalition allies and stakeholders, public officials, and internal team members.



Responsibilities


  • Lead development of political and policy strategies for accelerating the transition to 100% clean energy and electrified transportation, as well as identify future venues for policy and political success in targeted states.
  • Manage a geographically dispersed advocacy team and lobbyists on the ground.
  • Work collaboratively across United’s policy team on developing and implementing strategies to meet short and long-term policy objectives in key states as part of United’s core portfolio. This will include legislative, regulatory, and administrative (e.g. governor’s office) engagement.
  • Work with United members to develop and reach consensus on policy positions in key states and on key issues. Facilitate member calls and lead policy discussions to coalesce member input and prioritize areas of interest and engagement.
  • Work with team members to ensure high-quality member engagement opportunities are conducted in targeted states through direct decision maker engagement, including lobby days and candidate education, earned media, and expert testimony; and participate in legislative, rulemaking, and administrative processes, as needed.
  • Develop and maintain excellent working relationships with coalition partners, philanthropy, allies, and key legislative, regulatory and administrative staff.
  • Represent United effectively in front of funders and member prospects and help raise funds to support strategies and engagement in key states.
  • Ability to master the politics of the region through development of relationships with key players and decision makers, as well as a general understanding of the levers of power in these states and how to leverage the advanced energy industry to affect policy change.
  • Travel on an as needed basis (up to 30%) to targeted states for advocacy days, conferences, meetings with key allies and stakeholders, staff development, and other efforts on behalf of United.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s and/or Advanced degree, Political Science, Public Policy, or Economics preferred, or applicable comparable experience
  • Minimum of ten years of professional experience in public policy, with a portion of that engagement in the clean energy or transportation sector
  • Experience managing a team in a remote environment
  • Viewed as a subject matter expert in a specific focus area
  • Political campaign or organizing experience, preferably in the clean energy advocacy space
  • Entrepreneurial approach, flexible attitude, and ability to operate independently, making decisions consistent with United’s mission/vision

  • Ability to lead, motivate and develop an internal team and work collaboratively across project teams with colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills, both written and verbal
  • Intellectual curiosity, inquisitive nature, and excellent listening and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage a project budget and financials
  • Performance-oriented individual with a strong work ethic, demonstrated initiative and commitment to achieving goals

The employee is regularly required to use hands and talk or hear. The employee is required to sit for long periods of time; reach with hands and arms; may need to balance, stoop, kneel or crouch, walk up and down stairs.

Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

  • Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

  • Joustavan työajan

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

  • Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

  • Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

  • Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

  • Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin

Toivomme sinulta

  • Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

  • Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

  • Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

  • Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

Edellytämme sinulta

  • Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

  • Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in St Johns, Florida.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the St Johns area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near St Johns requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
At Wonderskin, we believe beauty should be effortless, long-lasting, and transformative and we have built a brand that proves it. Powered by patented Wonder Blading technology, we have cracked the code on long-wear beauty, delivering bold, flawless results that speak for themselves.

We're a fast-growing brand with a passionate global community, and we thrive on creativity, experimentation, and pushing the boundaries of traditional beauty. Now we are hiring a Head of Performance Creative to lead the creative engine behind our growth marketing.

This is a great opportunity to define and own the performance creative strategy of a fast-moving beauty brand, working directly with our Growth team and CEO to build the frameworks, team and pipelines that turn creative into our biggest growth lever, seen by millions of people.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive performance creative strategy across paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Snap, AppLovin/Axon, Google, YouTube), translating business objectives into scalable, revenue-generating campaign frameworks.
  • Lead an internal production team with creative strategists, editors and designers, as well as oversee our creative agency partnerships.
  • Maximise creative performance output, elevating the quality, speed, and volume of high-performing creative assets, focused on performance and engagement, ensuring metrics are scaled effectively across campaigns.
  • Directly shape the creative and strategic direction of new product launches and existing product relaunches, feeding into our long-term growth strategy.
  • Drive the organisation's approach to AI and emerging creative technologies, embedding tools like Claude, Gemini, Sora etc. into production pipelines to future-proof output and accelerate innovation.
  • Using data and insights to develop creative iterations and updates that continuously drive compounded improvement.
  • Work with our paid channel reps to identify new trends, innovations and opportunities to incorporate into our strategy.
  • Analyse top-performing ads in the beauty and skincare space to inform our creative approach.
  • Provide strategic and creative feedback to the wider marketing team.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • You have significant experience (5+ years) in paid social, creative strategy or performance marketing, including experience leading or mentoring a team.
  • You're a digital native with extensive knowledge in DR / Social / Digital first creative.
  • You're a powerhouse who can generate multiple ad concepts quickly and enjoys testing innovative formats.
  • You understand the principles of growth/performance marketing for Meta, TikTok and other paid channels, with a strong grasp of platform-specific nuances.
  • You have a research-oriented mindset - regularly analysing competitor activity, platform trends, and beauty/skincare category content.
  • You're comfortable moving from concept to live creative/ad at speed when required.
  • You're an early adopter of AI tools and emerging creative technologies, with a genuine interest in embedding them into workflows.
  • You're a self starter with a strong sense of ownership who takes pride in their work.
  • You're able to manage competing priorities and workloads across a team.
  • You're high energy and results focused.

A portfolio showcasing strategic and creative work, along with examples of team leadership, would be advantageous to provide during application.

BONUS Tools & skills

    • Asana
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • TripleWhale
    • Canva
    • CapCut

What You Will Gain

From day one, you will be deep in the work, leading, creating, and iterating in one of the most exciting spaces in the digital world. This isn't a role where you'll be watching from the sidelines, instead you will get to:

  • Own performance creative strategy across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin and other channels, from first concept to live ad, at real speed.
  • Build and shape a high-performing creative team inside a high-growth, globally recognised beauty brand with a genuinely engaged audience.
  • Full creative freedom to pitch your own ideas and see them tested and scaled, not shelved.
  • A real stake in the next chapter of Wonderskin's story.

This is a high-output, creatively driven leadership role built for someone ready to make their mark, grow with us, and help shape where Wonderskin goes next.

Our Commitment to You

At Wonderskin, we are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the world we live in. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or family status.

We believe diverse perspectives make us a stronger, more creative team, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued and can do their best work.

Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay, we didn't write this list expecting to find a perfect match. If you are excited about this role and can tick most of the boxes, we would love to hear from you. We hire for potential, attitude, and passion just as much as experience, so if Wonderskin feels like your kind of place, take the leap and apply.

title: Senior Business Analyst ID85837
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Business Analyst to connect business stakeholders with technical teams and turn complex needs into practical solutions. The role focuses on Service Cloud and cross-system processes, combining process modeling, Agile delivery, data flows, and UAT. You will help ensure solutions are clear, testable, and aligned with business goals.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process observation.
- Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
- Map current-state and future-state business processes using standard modeling techniques such as BPMN, swimlane diagrams, and data flow diagrams.
- Facilitate requirements review sessions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need to delivered solutions.
- Collaborate with Product Managers, developers, architects, and QA to ensure requirements are understood and delivered as intended.
- Support User Acceptance Testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating testing cycles, and managing defect triage.
- Analyze data and system configurations to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
- Evaluate the impact of proposed changes across dependent systems and business processes.
- Provide input into integration requirements when solutions involve third-party platforms, APIs, or cross-system data flows.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives, within an iterative delivery model.
- Produce and maintain documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), process maps, decision logs, and knowledge transfer materials.
- Support change management and stakeholder communication around new feature rollouts.
- Deliver clear, complete, and well-organized documentation within established timelines.
- Adhere to established standards for requirements management and business analysis best practices.
- Proactively communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and open decisions.
- Work efficiently within a defined project scope and contract duration.
- Support testing, deployment, and stabilization efforts by ensuring business readiness and stakeholder alignment.

- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in technology-driven environments.

- Strong proficiency in business process modeling and analysis.
- Strong proficiency in stakeholder management across both business and technical teams.

- Background in contact center operations, customer service, or support technology platforms.

title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen uuteen Keisarinnaan!
description:
Hei sinä hyvä lähihoitaja. Meillä olisi ehkä juuri sinulle paikka Keisarinnassa.

Keisarinna on uusi. Sinä voit olla mukana tekemässä siitä meidän näköisemme.

Lokakuussa Piikkiöön avautuu uusi Keisarinna – koti ikääntyneille ja samalla kokonaan uusi työyhteisö.

Siksi emme etsi vain lähihoitajaa täyttämään työvuoroja.

Etsimme työkaveria. Ihmistä. Persoonaa.

Sellaista, joka osaa hoitaa, mutta ennen kaikkea osaa kohdata.

Millainen tyyppi viihtyy meillä?

Ehkä sinä olet se työkaveri, joka huomaa, kun joku tarvitsee apua ennen kuin sitä ehditään pyytää.

Ehkä sinulle on tärkeää, että aamulla ei vain jaeta lääkkeitä ja tarkisteta vointeja, vaan pysähdytään hetkeksi juttelemaan.

Ehkä olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka – tai ehkä vahvuutesi on siinä, että saat ihmiset nauramaan myös kiireisen päivän keskellä.

Me tarvitsemme kaikkia näitä puolia.

Keisarinnassa haluamme tehdä hoitotyötä, jossa asukkaat saavat olla omia itsejään. Jos joku haluaa kuunnella musiikkia, jutella päivän uutisista, lähteä ulos tai vain istua kaikessa rauhassa kahvikupin kanssa, sille pitää olla aikaa ja tilaa.

Koska elämä ei lopu siihen, kun ihminen muuttaa hoivakotiin.

Sen pitää jatkua.

Ja tässä kohtaa sinä tulet mukaan.

Uudessa Keisarinnassa pääset rakentamaan asioita alusta alkaen.

Ei tarvitse kuulla lausetta:

"Näin meillä on aina tehty."

Sen sijaan haluamme kuulla:

"Mitä jos kokeiltaisiin tätä?"

Meillä saat ehdottaa, kysyä, haastaa ja kehittää. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa työkaveria autetaan, huumorille on tilaa ja jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään.

Mitä lähihoitajan työ Keisarinnassa tarkoittaa?

Tavallista hyvää hoitotyötä – mutta ihmisen kokoista.

Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

  • asukkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoiva ja huolenpito

  • lääkehoito ja voinnin seuranta

  • toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja kuntouttava työote

  • päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen

  • yhdessäolo, ulkoilu ja viriketoiminta

  • yhteistyö läheisten ja muun henkilöstön kanssa

  • ennen kaikkea asukkaan kohtaaminen ja kuunteleminen.

Meillä hoitaja ei ole vain se, joka tekee asiat asukkaan puolesta.

Hyvä hoitaja auttaa ihmistä tekemään itse sen, minkä hän vielä pystyy tekemään.

Mitä me toivomme sinulta?

Sinulla on lähihoitajan tutkinto ja halu tehdä työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.

Arvostamme ammattitaitoa, mutta emme etsi täydellistä ihmistä.

Etsimme ihmistä, joka:

  • pitää ihmisistä

  • ottaa vastuuta

  • uskaltaa kysyä

  • haluaa oppia

  • osaa tehdä yhteistyötä

  • kohtelee asukkaita ja työkavereita arvostavasti

  • pystyy heittäytymään mukaan uuden rakentamiseen.

Ja jos sinulla on joku erityinen taito tai intohimo – kerro siitä meille.

Osaatko soittaa kitaraa? Oletko intohimoinen ulkoilija? Rakastatko leipomista, musiikkia, liikuntaa, askartelua tai vanhojen tarinoiden kuuntelemista? Loistavaa!

Miksi kannattaa tulla juuri nyt?

Koska myöhemmin voit sanoa:

"Minä olin mukana, kun Keisarinna syntyi."

Saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa uutta yksikköä ja uutta työyhteisöä yhdessä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Ja ehkä kaikkein tärkeintä:

Saat tehdä työtä, jossa yksi hymy, yksi hyvä kohtaaminen ja yksi pieni teko voivat tehdä jonkun päivästä paremman.

Jos tämä kuulostaa enemmän sinulta kuin perinteinen työpaikkailmoitus, lähetä meille hakemuksesi.

Kerro meille kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

Miksi juuri sinä olisit hyvä tyyppi Keisarinnaan?

Me haluamme tavata sinut.

Tehdään tästä yhdessä paikka, jossa on hyvä asua – ja vielä parempi tehdä töitä.

Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti: sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua.

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Sandy, Utah.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Sandy area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Sandy requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Junior Flight Simulation Technician
location: Acron Aviation Training Centre Ltd Thailand, Bangchalong, Samut Prakan, TH
description:
Location: Bangkok Training Centre (BTC)

Bang Chalong, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan, Thailand (Greater Bangkok Area)


About Acron Aviation

Acron Aviation is an agile commercial aviation partner with a long heritage of delivering industry-certified aviation solutions alongside future-focused, data-driven innovations. Serving customers worldwide, we are committed to our mission of innovating to create safer skies.

For more information, visit www.acronaviation.com.

About the Role

As a Junior Flight Simulation Technician, you will support the maintenance, operation, and readiness of Flight Simulation Training Devices (FSTDs) to ensure a high-quality training experience for our customers. You will work closely with senior technicians and engineers to maintain simulator performance, carry out preventative maintenance, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure facilities and equipment are operational and customer-ready.

The role requires a strong customer-focused mindset, attention to detail, commitment to safety, and a willingness to continuously develop technical skills.

Key Responsibilities

Simulator Operations & Maintenance

  • Perform preventative maintenance (PM) on flight simulators and associated systems.
  • Conduct pre-flight and post-flight checks on simulators.
  • Configure simulators to meet customer training requirements.
  • Perform simulator walk-around inspections and readiness checks.
  • Carry out visual alignments and assist with visual system adjustments.
  • Run and evaluate Qualification Test Guide (QTG) results.
  • Assist with simulator refurbishment projects and hardware modifications.
  • Diagnose and resolve routine technical issues affecting simulator operations.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to the Supervisor or Shift Leader when required.

Customer Support

  • Prepare simulators for scheduled customer training sessions.
  • Meet and support customers at the start and end of training sessions.
  • Respond promptly to customer concerns and simulator interruptions.
  • Deliver a professional and positive customer experience at all times.

Facilities & Safety

  • Conduct routine checks of facility services, including lighting, air conditioning, fire protection systems, and related infrastructure.
  • Maintain a safe working environment and comply with all Health & Safety requirements.
  • Follow and support the AATC Quality Management System.

Administration & Documentation

  • Complete engineering and maintenance records accurately and in accordance with company procedures.
  • Use the Maintenance Management System to record, monitor, and track maintenance activities.
  • Perform logistics-related tasks including receiving, processing, and validating spare parts and repairs.
  • Carry out housekeeping duties to maintain simulator and work area standards.
  • Complete administrative tasks and reports as required.

Training & Development

  • Complete all assigned training activities.
  • Continuously develop technical knowledge and professional skills.
  • Support the development of junior team members by sharing knowledge and best practices when appropriate.
  • Follow instructions and work assignments provided by Supervisors and Shift Leaders.


Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Electronics, Aviation, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or computer-based systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Good command of spoken and written English.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and technical documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.

Desirable

  • Previous experience working with simulators, training devices, or technical equipment.
  • Experience using diagnostic and test equipment.
  • Understanding of preventative maintenance processes.
  • Experience supporting refurbishment or hardware modification projects.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems.


Physical Requirements

The successful candidate should be able to:

  • Lift and carry items weighing up to 50 lbs (23 kg).
  • Climb stairs regularly.
  • Bend, kneel, and stand for extended periods.
  • Work in confined spaces when required.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking a motivated and technically minded individual who is eager to learn and develop a career within flight simulation technology. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a proactive approach, excellent teamwork skills, and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service while maintaining the highest standards of safety and operational excellence.

Please note: All applicants who wish to be considered for this role must have right to work in Thailand.

title: Direct Service Advocate_HYPP_3rd_FT
description:
Department: Holyoke Youth Parent Program

Reports To: Site Director


FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

The YWCA of Western MA is dedicated to eliminating racism and empowering women. The YW provides a safe place for survivors of domestic violence and/or sexual assault. Our programs and services include crisis shelter and transitional housing for survivors and their families, counseling, SAFEPLAN court advocacy, community education, supervised visitation, and vocational training for youth ages of 17-24. The YWCA provides services at several sites, including Holyoke, Northampton, Westfield, and our primary Springfield campus.


Summary:

The Direct Service Advocate (DSA) is responsible for providing support, advocacy and role modeling to adult, teen and child program participants living in the YWCA’s residential programs. DSA’s are part of a team model working with peers, supervisors, clinicians and outside connections to best serve program participants. DSA’s support the agency mission and trauma informed service model in order to provide safe, consistent and quality services to vulnerable populations.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Nurture and support a milieu approach that is participant-guided, family-driven, strengths-based, and trauma-informed; and embraces a framework of empowerment and encouragement, engaging with 100% of individuals and families that are on-site each shift.
  • Encourage and support the development of life skills, positive parenting and improved parent-child interaction
  • Follow and encourage the programs daily schedule and facilitate resident participation and community responsibilities, taking into account individualized plans for each participant.
  • Ensure program procedures, rules, regulations and policies are followed to ensure a safe and supportive living environment including completion of 100% of all required safety sweeps (minimum of four times) each shift to ensure premises including alarms, doors, windows, appliances and bedrooms are all safe.

This must be done during your assigned shift.

Qualifications:

  • A.A. or equivalent education or experience in a human service field (Required)
  • One year of counseling and direct service experience (Preferred)
  • Experience with victims of domestic violence (Preferred)
  • Reliable transportation, safe driving record, and valid driver’s license required. Must be able to be covered by the agency's insurance policy.
  • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs.

description:

Join the Team at The Biltmore Los Angeles

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: Grand Island, New York, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Grand Island, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Grand Island area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Grand Island requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Print Production / Prepress — Architectural & Environmental Graphics (ZR-722)
description:
Horizon Tech is looking for a print production and prepress seat inside a large-format graphics operation — not an agency or marketing design role. You will take approved concepts, brand assets, and site measurements and build production-ready files that run on wide- and grand-format digital presses: full-wall murals, decorative and security glass films, and full-building wraps.Your files go straight to the RIP, onto the press, and then onto a wall. If a seam lands in the wrong place, a panel comes up short, or color drifts from the approved proof, it shows up twenty feet tall in a client lobby. Precision, print knowledge, and clean file discipline matter more here than styling.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build 1:1 and scaled production files for wall coverings (murals, writable/dry-erase surfaces), glass films (decorative, frosted, gradient, security, distraction bands), and building and window wraps
  • Tile and panel artwork to roll width and press capability — sequencing drops, setting overlap allowances, and placing seams away from focal points, sightlines, and architectural features
  • Set correct effective resolution for viewing distance — a close-viewed interior mural and a building wrap read from 100+ feet are not built the same way — and manage file weight so large files stay printable
  • Build mirrored/reverse artwork and white-ink layers for second-surface glass applications; set spot channels, underbase, and overprint correctly
  • Work from architectural drawings, elevations, field measurements, and site photos — accounting for mullions, door swings, outlets, corners, returns, and wrapped edges
  • Retouch and composite high-resolution imagery that holds up at full scale, not just on screen
  • Run jobs through the RIP (ONYX Thrive / ProductionHouse or equivalent) — preflight, nesting, tiling, media profile selection, cut-path and registration mark setup, and quick sets
  • Apply and troubleshoot ICC profiles and media linearizations; hit Pantone and brand-critical colors within tolerance and match to approved printed proofs
  • Preflight and correct incoming client art — resolution, transparency flattening, overprint, spot vs. process, fonts, embedded profiles, bleeds, and PDF/X output
  • Produce printed proofs and draw-downs on the final substrate, and flag anything that will not hold at scale before it reaches the press
  • Write detailed installer instructions — panel maps, drop order, overlap direction, orientation keys, and finished-size callouts
  • Calculate square footage, material yield, and waste to support estimating
  • Report scope discrepancies — measurements, substrate, coverage, or missing assets — to project management and estimating before production starts
  • Maintain running communication with the Production Manager throughout the job cycle
  • Build installed mockups and renders for client approval where required
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects against hard install dates

Required skills:

  • 5+ years in a print production or prepress environment producing large- or grand-format output — in-house print shop, sign shop, wide-format printer, or environmental graphics producer.
  • Agency, marketing, or studio design experience alone is not a substitute. Hands-on RIP software experience — ONYX strongly preferred (Caldera, ErgoSoft, Wasatch, ColorGate, or Flexi also considered).
  • You should be able to walk through your own tiling, nesting, and media-profile workflow inside the RIP, not simply say that files were "sent to production."
  • Demonstrated full-wall and architectural-scale output — wall murals, building wraps, and applied glass graphics. Posters, trade-show booths, and vehicle wraps on their own do not cover this requirement.
  • Strong color management — ICC profile application, media linearization, spot-color matching, proofing workflows, and the judgment to know when a color simply will not reproduce on a given substrate.
  • Wide/grand-format file prep — scaling, tiling, panel and seam logic, overlaps, bleeds, oversize allowances, and resolution-at-final-size decisions.
  • Expert Adobe Creative Suite — Photoshop (high-resolution retouching and compositing at 1:1), Illustrator (production vector, cut paths, panel layouts), InDesign.
  • Precision working from dimensions, drawings, and site specs; clean and predictable file naming and organization; clear written communication with production and install teams.

Preferred:

  • Substrate fluency by name — 3M, Avery, Drytac, LINTEC, ORAFOL/ORACAL; perforated window film, mesh, textured and coated wall vinyls, and how each affects color, detail, and finishing
  • Press and finishing familiarity — HP Latex, EFI VUTEk, Durst, swissQprint, Canon Colorado, Roland, Mimaki; Zünd, Kongsberg, or Summa cutting and i-cut workflows
  • Enfocus PitStop or comparable preflight automation
  • Environmental, architectural, or experiential graphics background (EGD); signage and building-wrap experience
  • Space visualization — 3D rendering or Photoshop compositing into site photography
  • Working knowledge of install constraints — surface prep and adhesion, substrate width limits, wind load on exterior wraps, and code/ADA considerations for glass manifestation and distraction band
  • CorelDRAW

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Allendale, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Allendale area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Allendale requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

HIto Solutions is looking for an experienced Senior Automotive Project Leader to join a long-term automotive engineering programme based in Crewe, UK.

The successful candidate will take overall responsibility for coordinating the engineering team and managing Current Model Production activities across the complete body and trim perimeter.

  • Define and coordinate prototype builds, physical validation and vehicle line trials.
  • Monitor technical risks, priorities, issue status, timing and costs.

  • Support engineering releases, change approvals and homologation activities.

Technical Scope

The role covers:

  • Body-in-White, including platform and upper-body structures
  • Fenders, bonnet, doors and tailgate
  • Closures and add-on body components
  • Paint, sealing, sealing management and damping
  • Exterior systems and body hardware
  • Interior systems and trim
  • Seating systems

  • Fluent English at C1 level or higher.

Desirable

Previous experience working on Bentley projects or within the Bentley organisation would be considered a significant advantage.

Working Conditions

The position is fully on-site in Crewe. Remote or hybrid working is not currently foreseen. Candidates must already reside in the UK and preferably be based in Crewe or within a reasonable daily commuting distance.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Backyard, Pennsylvania.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Backyard area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Backyard requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

  • Practice radiation protection techniques to limit exposure to patient and medical staff.

  • Efficient time management skills with ability to anticipate workflow and perform synchronous tasks
  • Basic typing and computer proficiency, preferably experienced with Windows

  • Maintain proper inventory of consumables, office supplies, and paperwork necessary to continue daily operations.
  • Assist in Labs’ operations as directed by Nurse Manager or other delegated authority. Such duties may include but are not limited to inventory management, accounting, and marketing.

Lead Specific Duties:

  • Responsible for covering any unfilled shifts on the schedule.
  • Ensure workload is evenly distributed among staff
  • Help to coordinate coverage for call-ins & absences
  • Clearly communicate and introduce new processes into the department/unit
  • Keep Nurse Manager and Rad/Lab Regional Manager apprised of patient complaints, staff issues
  • Ensure communications are clear and concise
  • Serve as an expert resource to staff for clinical or technical questions, patient or customer concerns, and process questions
  • Complete Lead Lab Review daily; submit to Regional Manager at the end of every month
  • Ensure lab & radiology inventory meets facilities needs
  • Ensure RSO binder is kept up to date
  • Ensure Monthly Radiology QC is performed before the 10th of each month
  • In conjunction with your Regional Manager, ensure CT QCs are performed/sent to PACS daily (Siemen’s) or weekly (GE)

  • Has the ability to travel to all Surepoint locations in your area including the corporate office.

  • Required to attend occasional/quarterly in-person meetings at the corporate office.

  • Coordinate cleaning/stocking/organizing/labeling of Rad/Lab areas.
  • Maintain state of readiness for Rad/Lab inspections.

and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met

by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable

accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job

functions.

and/or carrying of objects weighing up to 20 pounds; walking, standing, feeling,

reaching, seeing stooping, smelling, depth perception, color vision, pushing. Handles

multiple priorities; manages stress appropriately, independent discretion/decision

making; works alone effectively; makes decisions under pressure; works in close

title: Design Lead / Senior Design Lead (Transformation Lab), PST, PSD
description:

To prepare the Public Service for these changes, we seek to continually transform the Public Service to better serve Singaporeans by championing Public Sector innovation, transforming citizen and business service delivery, building a future workplace, and supporting transformation efforts in the Ministries and Statutory Boards.

As a Design Lead / Senior Design Lead, you will lead multi-stakeholder teams to design public policies or services from the users’ perspectives in order to deliver a more seamless experience for citizens and relevant users.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
description:
About Emblasoft

Emblasoft is a global provider of Service Assurance, Test & Verification, and Service Enablement solutions for telecom operators and network vendors, covering everything from legacy 2G/3G through VoLTE, 4G, 5G, and IMS infrastructure. Under the motto “Innovate. Validate. Operate.”, our product portfolio spans active monitoring and functional testing (Evolver), performance and load testing (PureLoad), a turnkey IMS core for rapid VoLTE/VoWiFi launches (Odin), and passive network monitoring (nScan). Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, we work with mobile operators and equipment vendors around the world who rely on us to validate, monitor, and assure their networks.

About NetQPro

NetQPro recently joined the Emblasoft group as its passive-monitoring specialist, bringing deep telecom-protocol engineering expertise and the nScan platform into a wider service-assurance offering. Where Emblasoft's other products validate networks through active, synthetic testing, nScan gives operators real-time visibility into what's actually happening in live traffic — across everything from legacy SS7 signaling to 5G SA — with call tracing, KPI dashboards, and root-cause analysis at scale. Together, active and passive monitoring close the loop on service assurance for our customers.

Our nScan monitoring system is used by key mobile operators in Poland, and we have deployments for mobile and satellite operators in other countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

About the role

You'll join the engineering team behind nScan — a C++ platform that captures, decodes, and analyzes live telecom traffic in real time, feeding the results into storage, analytics, and dashboards used by network operators and engineers worldwide.

We're looking for a senior C++ engineer who enjoys working close to the wire: parsing binary protocols, squeezing throughput out of packet-processing pipelines, and building reliable, long-running server software that runs 24/7 against live network traffic.

Who you are

  • You like understanding systems from the wire up — you're as comfortable reading a bit-level protocol diagram as you are optimizing a hot loop.
  • You write code you'd be happy to maintain two years from now, and you're pragmatic about legacy code you didn't write.
  • You can work independently, communicate clearly in a small, senior team, and take ownership of a component end to end.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work.
  • A deep, specialized engineering domain — real telecom networks, not another CRUD backend.
  • The reach of an established, global company (Emblasoft) combined with the focus and ownership of a specialist product team (NetQPro).
  • A small, experienced team and direct influence over architecture and technical decisions.
  • flexible hours

Must-have

  • 5+ years of professional C++ development (C++11/14/17), including solid command of the STL, RAII, and multi-threaded programming.
  • Strong Linux systems programming background — sockets, processes/threads, performance profiling and debugging (gdb, perf, valgrind or similar).
  • Experience building or maintaining server-side / long-running daemon software.
  • Comfortable with CMake-based build systems and Git-based workflows.
  • Ability to read RFCs / protocol specifications and translate them into correct, efficient parsing code.
  • Experience with ClickHouse and MySQL databases.
  • Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.

Nice-to-have

  • Exposure to telecom or networking protocols (any of GTP, Diameter, SS7, SIP/RTP, S1AP/NGAP, RANAP, SCTP) — or strong motivation to learn this domain.
  • Experience with high-performance packet capture (PF_RING, DPDK, libpcap) or kernel-bypass networking.
  • Familiarity with Boost / ASIO, Protocol Buffers, and additional SQL databases such as MariaDB.
  • Knowledge of specialized network interface cards (NICs) — e.g. Napatech, Intel DPDK-capable NICs, or similar high-performance capture hardware.
  • Background in network monitoring, lawful interception, QoE/QoS analytics, or OSS/BSS systems.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to speed up day-to-day coding, refactoring, or code review.

title: ReBath - Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator

Build the customer experience behind every successful project.

EMPLOYMENT Full-Time

SCHEDULE Monday-Friday

WORK LOCATION In Person

Re-Bath of Southeast Michigan is seeking a highly organized, proactive Project Coordinator to help manage the customer journey from signed contract through installation and project completion. This is a visible, high-impact role for someone who thrives on communication, accountability, and keeping multiple moving parts aligned.

This is not simply an administrative position. The Project Coordinator serves as a central point of coordination between our customers and our internal teams, helping ensure that projects remain organized, communication stays consistent, and important details are addressed before they become problems.

You will work closely with Sales, Operations, Production, Installation, Customer Service, and leadership to maintain visibility into active projects and help move each one toward successful completion.

What You'll Own

At the heart of this position is project visibility and follow-through. You will maintain and review customer project files, track key milestones, confirm that required documentation and information are complete, and provide accurate status updates throughout the life of the project.

When information is missing, you will help obtain it. When a project is approaching an important milestone, you will help ensure the team is prepared. When a customer has a status question, you will help provide a clear and professional response.

You will also play an important role internally by keeping departments aligned. That means communicating project changes, outstanding items, customer concerns, scheduling considerations, and potential delays to the appropriate team members so issues can be addressed early.

Our customers should know what is happening with their project, and our team should know what needs to happen next.

The Role

A typical day may include reviewing active customer files, following up on missing documentation, updating project statuses in our systems, communicating with customers regarding next steps, and coordinating with internal teams regarding upcoming installations or outstanding project requirements.

You may be working with a customer awaiting an installation update in one moment and coordinating with Operations or Production on a project requirement the next. Success requires someone who can manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and a professional customer experience.

Just as importantly, we are looking for someone who recognizes when something does not look right and takes the initiative to investigate it. We do not want someone who simply records that a project is delayed; we want someone who asks what is holding it up, who needs to be involved, and what can be done to move it forward.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is highly organized, naturally curious, and comfortable communicating with both customers and coworkers. You enjoy creating order, tracking details, solving problems, and closing open loops. You are comfortable following up when information is needed and understand that strong communication is one of the most important parts of delivering an excellent customer experience.

Previous experience in project coordination, customer service, operations, construction, remodeling, or another project-based environment is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as is the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

You should also be comfortable working within CRM, project management, and business software systems and have solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Outlook, and Excel. Experience in residential remodeling, construction, home improvement, or another installation-based business is a strong advantage, but we are equally interested in individuals who demonstrate exceptional organization, professionalism, ownership, and judgment.

What Success Looks Like

Success means having command of your projects. Customer files are complete and current. Important milestones are being tracked. Customers receive timely communication. Internal teams understand project status and outstanding requirements. Potential issues are identified early rather than after they become emergencies.

Most importantly, customers feel that someone is paying attention to their project. The strongest Project Coordinators develop a reputation internally as the person who knows where things stand, closes communication gaps, and helps determine what needs to happen next.

Who Will Excel Here

You will likely thrive in this position if you take pride in being organized and dependable. You notice details other people miss, follow through when you say you will do something, and are comfortable communicating with customers professionally even when the answer requires research or coordination.

You do not assume someone else is handling an issue. You enjoy working across departments and understand how strong teamwork contributes to the customer experience. And when priorities change - as they sometimes do in a fast-moving remodeling business - you can adjust, communicate, and keep moving forward.

Why Re-Bath of Southeast Michigan

Re-Bath of Southeast Michigan is a growing residential remodeling organization focused on delivering an exceptional experience from the first customer interaction through the final installation. As we continue to scale, we are building stronger systems, clearer processes, and greater accountability throughout the organization.

The Project Coordinator will be an important part of that growth. This position provides exposure to multiple areas of the business and offers an opportunity to develop a strong understanding of project operations, customer experience, and residential remodeling.

We are looking for someone who wants more than a task list. We want someone who wants to take ownership, become a trusted resource for the organization, and help us continually improve the way we serve our customers.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you are organized, proactive, customer-focused, and take pride in keeping projects and people moving in the right direction, we would like to meet you.

Apply today and help us deliver an exceptional remodeling experience to every Re-Bath customer.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Hilliard, Ohio.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Hilliard area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Hilliard requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Hotel Engineer
description:
Hotel Name: Millennium Hotel Durham

Location: Onsite – Durham, NC

Join the Team at Millennium Durham

At Millennium Durham, we believe great hospitality is more than a service—it’s how we make people feel. Every interaction is an opportunity to create comfort, connection, and a lasting impression.
