title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Kensington, Maryland.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Kensington area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Kensington requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Perioperative Technician/PCA - OR (11a-7p)
description:
Overview

Provides compassionate personal care and support services under the supervision of a registered nurse that assists the patient in the achievement of physical and emotional comfort and healing. Under the supervision of the RN assist in planning, organizing, implementing, and evaluating the activities occurring in the nursing station by performing clerical and receptionist duties and maintaining the physical environment of the area.

Responsibilities

  • Provides all personal care services in accordance with the plan of treatment assigned by the registerednurse to include but not limited to:
  • measure and record intake and output
  • measure and record vital signs, O2 Saturation, weight, height
  • positioning patients; lifting and turning patients;
  • applying/utilizing special equipment;
  • assisting in use of bedpan, urinal or commode;
  • ambulating the patient;
  • pre-operative and post-operative care;
  • application/removal of anti-embolism stocking and SCD devices;
  • removal of foley catheters;
  • perineal care; vaginal irrigations (non-sterile); sitz baths
  • non-medicated enemas;
  • application of heat and cold;
  • care of the incontinent patient;
  • skin care to the immobilized patient;
  • removal of saline lock,
  • emptying of colostomy bags;
  • application of appliances for heat and cold;
  • performing blood sugars.
  • placing patients on cardiac monitors
  • set up of oxygen equipment
  • feeding patients
  • collecting, labeling, and transporting of lab specimens
  • Accurately documents care provided according to policies and procedures..
  • Consistently performs basic care requirements such as rounding, use of AIDET, applying the “4 Ps” (Pain, Position, Potty, Proximity of items); prompt response to patient needs; performance of hand hygiene; use of two patient identifiers, etc.
  • Coordinates unit functions to provide safe and smooth operations by:

Adhering to cardiac monitor responsibilities:

  • Observation of cardiac monitoring status on all patients. For breaks and lunch, makes sure that the monitor station is attended by qualified staff.
  • Validates cardiac alarms have been assigned to caregivers at the beginning of each shift.
  • Notifies staff of alarms, changes in cardiac rhythm, and when there is a leads off alarm.
  • Validates the monitoring status (rhythm present on sector, status of stand-by, etc.) of each patient at least every 2 hours, at change of shift and during hand-off communication for breaks and lunch. Documents validation on the appropriate form.
  • Performs monitor count each shift to assure all monitors are present, as appropriate for area.
  • Accurately transcribing of orders, assembling, maintaining and disassembling of medical record, answering phones, intercoms and communicating messages.
  • Participates in economical utilization of supplies and ensures that equipment and nursing units are maintained in a clean, safe manner.
  • Applies safety principles when performing care, such as ambulation of patients, transferring patients, assisting with normal range of motion and positioning.
  • Assists in performance improvement (PI) activities by serving on PI teams as warranted, assisting with PI measures and supporting and implementing changes necessary for improvement.
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of order entry process and transcription of physician orders.
  • Maintains well organized, well-supplied, clean nursing unit.
  • Maintains statistics/logs as required by the unit Manager/Director.

DCH Standards:

  • Maintains performance, patient and employee satisfaction and financial standards as outlined in the performance evaluation.
  • Performs compliance requirements as outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • Must adhere to the DCH Behavioral Standards including creating positive relationships with patients/families, coworkers, colleagues and with self.
  • Performs essential job functions in a manner that ensures the safety of patients, visitors and employees.
  • Identifies and reduces unsafe practices that may result in harm to patients, visitors and employees.
  • Recognizes and takes appropriate action to reduce risks and hazards to promote safety for patients, visitors and employees.
  • Requires use of electronic mail, time and attendance software, learning management software and intranet.
  • Must adhere to all DCH Health System policies and procedures.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Approved previous experience in giving patient care or completion of in-service education classes required. Approved previous experience in clerical functions or completion of in-service education required. High school education or equivalent required. Candidates with patient care experience, those currently enrolled in a nursing program or those with prior customer service experience are preferred. Requires computer and/or computer software knowledge or experience. Current American Heart Association (AHA) Basic Life Support (BLS) Provider training required. Must be able to read, write legibly, speak, and comprehend English.

WORK CONTEXT

Communicate with different personalities and engage in face to face discussion

Dealing with unpleasant or physically aggressive personalities

Must be able to deal with conflict

Must be able to communicate clearly and accurately

Must be able to receive delegation

Must be able to work in groups

Must be able to perform structured and unstructured work

Must be meet time pressure and time lines

Must be able to perform in exact and accurate manner

Must be able to use electronic mail, telephone and texting

Includes possible exposure to human body fluids, disease, infection, lab chemicals and hazardous materials and/or cleaning solutions

Requires wearing of common protective and safety equipment such as gloves, safety glasses, mask, gowns, etc.

PHYSICAL FACTORS

Very heavy work.

Exerting in excess of 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or in excess of 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or in excess of 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Must be able to tolerate prolonged periods of standing and walking

Must be able to reach reasonable distances in any direction

Must be able to stand, walk, kneel, bend, sit, stoop and lift

Must be able to run in an emergency

Must be able to move fingers in a coordinated manner and must be able to feel and perceive temperature, texture, shape and size with fingertips

Must be able to perform the duties with or without reasonable accommodation

Hearing and vision must be normal or corrected to within normal range

Must possess stamina to work 12-hour shift

Physical presence onsite is essential

title: Engineering Supervisor
description:
Hotel Name: M Social Sunnyvale
Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA
Salary Range: $36.00 Hourly

Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale

At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.

About M Social Sunnyvale

As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.

As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."

At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:

  • Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
  • Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
  • Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
  • Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results

These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.

About the Role:

As our Engineering Supervisor, you will help lead the day-to-day operations of the hotel's Engineering Department, ensuring the property, guest rooms, public areas, equipment, and building systems are safe, functional, and well maintained.

You will supervise engineering team members, coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance, respond to guest and operational needs, and help ensure the hotel operates efficiently and safely.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineering professional with strong technical knowledge, leadership skills, and a hands-on approach to hotel maintenance.

Your Impact – Property & Guest Experience

You will play an important role in maintaining the physical condition, safety, and functionality of M Social Sunnyvale. By responding quickly to maintenance needs and proactively identifying potential issues, you will help create a comfortable, safe, and seamless experience for both guests and employees.

What You'll Be Doing

Engineering Operations

  • Supervise daily engineering and maintenance activities throughout the hotel
  • Assign and prioritize work orders based on operational and guest needs
  • Monitor the condition of guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house spaces, and building systems
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests and emergencies
  • Perform inspections and identify maintenance, repair, and safety concerns
  • Ensure completed work meets hotel standards
  • Assist with troubleshooting and repairs as needed
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities and work orders

Team Leadership

  • Supervise, support, and provide direction to Engineering team members
  • Assign daily tasks and monitor completion
  • Train team members on maintenance procedures, equipment, and safety practices
  • Provide coaching and feedback to support employee performance
  • Promote a positive, professional, and team-oriented work environment
  • Assist with scheduling and staffing needs as directed by management
  • Communicate department priorities and operational expectations to the team

Preventive Maintenance

  • Support the hotel's preventive maintenance program
  • Conduct routine inspections of equipment and building systems
  • Schedule and complete preventive maintenance tasks according to established procedures
  • Monitor equipment performance and identify potential issues before they become major problems
  • Maintain records of inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance activities
  • Coordinate with outside contractors and service providers when necessary

Building Systems & Equipment

  • Assist with the maintenance and operation of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mechanical, and life-safety systems
  • Monitor boilers, pumps, water systems, elevators, generators, and other building equipment as applicable
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues and coordinate repairs
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and engineering work areas
  • Ensure equipment is operated safely and according to manufacturer and hotel procedures

Guest & Employee Experience

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest maintenance requests
  • Communicate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and other departments regarding maintenance needs
  • Follow up on guest-related maintenance issues to ensure timely resolution
  • Minimize disruption to guests and hotel operations when completing repairs
  • Maintain a professional appearance and courteous attitude when interacting with guests
  • Support a safe and comfortable working environment for all employees

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies and procedures
  • Conduct regular inspections for potential safety hazards
  • Respond appropriately to maintenance emergencies and building-related incidents
  • Maintain required safety documentation and inspection records
  • Ensure engineering staff use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Follow applicable fire, life-safety, environmental, and building regulations
  • Report accidents, hazards, equipment failures, and other safety concerns promptly
  • Support emergency preparedness and response procedures

Vendor & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with contractors and outside service providers as needed
  • Monitor contractor work to ensure it meets hotel standards
  • Assist with property improvement and maintenance projects
  • Communicate project updates and operational concerns to Engineering management
  • Help coordinate work to minimize disruption to guests and hotel operations

Energy & Sustainability

  • Monitor energy and utility usage and report unusual consumption
  • Support hotel energy conservation initiatives
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency
  • Ensure equipment is operated efficiently and appropriately
  • Support environmentally responsible maintenance practices

Requirements

  • Previous experience in hotel engineering, facilities maintenance, or a related field
  • Strong leadership and team-management skills
  • Strong mechanical and troubleshooting abilities
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple maintenance requests
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions
  • Professional and service-oriented attitude
  • Ability to respond effectively to emergencies
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and varying shifts

Technical / Role-Specific Requirements

  • Minimum 2–3 years of engineering, facilities, or maintenance experience, preferably in a hotel or commercial property
  • Previous supervisory or lead experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mechanical, and building systems
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices
  • Ability to troubleshoot and perform basic repairs
  • Experience using work-order or maintenance management systems preferred
  • Ability to read and interpret equipment manuals, maintenance instructions, and basic technical documentation
  • Knowledge of OSHA and workplace safety practices
  • Basic computer skills, including email and maintenance tracking systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous hotel Engineering or Facilities experience preferred
  • Experience working with hotel property management or maintenance systems
  • Technical certifications or trade experience in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or mechanical systems is a plus
  • Experience with building automation systems is beneficial
  • Experience with energy management systems is a plus
  • Previous experience supervising engineering or maintenance staff
  • Bilingual abilities are a plus

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, and climb stairs throughout the shift
  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to push and pull equipment and maintenance materials
  • Ability to work from ladders and elevated areas when required
  • Ability to work in mechanical rooms, guest rooms, outdoor areas, and other hotel environments
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely
  • Ability to respond quickly to maintenance emergencies
  • Ability to work in varying temperatures and environmental conditions

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Technical school, trade certification, or relevant engineering education preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered

Benefits

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, we support our employees with a competitive benefits package designed to promote wellbeing and long-term success:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match (where applicable)
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Hotel Room Discounts across our global portfolio
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to plan terms and company policy.

Why Join Us

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, you’re not just taking on a role—you’re joining a global organization committed to people, performance, and growth.

Whether you’re supporting operations behind the scenes or delivering service on the front line, your work contributes to a culture focused on hospitality, collaboration, and results.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow, contribute, and make an impact, we invite you to join our team.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: North Chili, New York, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in North Chili, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the North Chili area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near North Chili requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Tikkurilan alueelle Vantaalle
description:
Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Tikkurilan alueelle.

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

  • Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

  • Joustavan työajan

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

  • Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

  • Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

  • Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

  • Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin

Toivomme sinulta

  • Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

  • Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

  • Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

  • Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

Edellytämme sinulta

  • Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

  • Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

Qualifications
  • 1. A minimum of 7 years of experience in a Data Engineer role.
  • 2. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field. Advanced degree is a plus.

  • 8. Must have experience leading projects and teams.
  • 9. Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.

title: Documentation Specialist
description:
Overview

Starting Rate: $23.50/hr

Schedule: Monday-Friday 9am-5pm

The Documentation Specialist is responsible for overseeing the development and implementation of the clinical record to ensure compliance with paperwork timelines, guidelines, and federal and state agency documentation standards.

Who We Are

At Advocates, we provide comprehensive services for people facing developmental, mental health, or other life challenges.

We’re a nonprofit, mission-driven organization with a person-centered approach, empowering the individuals we support to make choices, build independence, and live full, meaningful lives. Our work is rooted in respect, compassion, and inclusion, and we envision a world where individual differences are appreciated and celebrated.

At Advocates, we value the ideas, experiences, and contributions of employees and are committed to fostering a supportive, welcoming culture where everyone can grow and thrive.

Minimum Education Required

High School Diploma/GED

Shift

First Shift

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the people we serve have treatment plans that meet DMH and/or DDS standards and timelines.
  • Review all paperwork, recordkeeping, and electronic health records. Ensure documentation standards are met, timelines are followed, and clinical work is reflected accurately. Provide oversight to ensure all charts have necessary annual documents and relevant updates.
  • Meet regularly with the Clinical Supervisors, Program Managers, and Mobile Outreach Specialists to review all paperwork.
  • Provide initial and ongoing support and training to all program staff in documentation standards, daily notes, treatment plans, electronic health care records, and record keeping requirements.
  • Provide supervision to all staff responsible for writing the Adult Comprehensive Assessment (ACA) and Community Service Plan (CSP).
  • Maintain tracking and notification system to facilitate timely documentation completion.
  • Conduct ongoing training with staff to promote high quality paperwork standards.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Management Consultants to ensure charts pass licensing reviews from Department of Mental Health and ensure charts are compliant with Department of Developmental Services Survey and Certification.
  • Attend and actively participate in all supervision, treatment team, and staff meetings.
  • Attend trainings as assigned; maintain necessary certifications as required.
  • Ensure that individuals we support are treated with dignity and respect in accordance with Advocates’ Human Rights policy.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent and minimum of two years of clinical experience. 1 year experience with DMH MSDP and Rehab Options.
  • Must hold a valid driver's license and access to an operational and insured vehicle to travel between sites.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to read and write English and communicate effectively in the primary language of the program to which they are assigned.
  • Excellent computer skills. Ability to use an Electronic Health Record.
  • Ability to thrive in an independent role while offering and receiving team support.
  • Intuitive, client-centered, supportive approach.

Advocates is committed to cultivating a diverse and welcoming community where everyone feels respected and valued. Advocates fosters a culture of inclusion that celebrates and promotes diversity along multiple dimensions, including race, ethnicity, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, partnered status, age, national origin, socioeconomic status, religion, ability, culture, and experience.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application, interview or hiring process, please contact Human Resources.

title: House Attendant
description:
Hotel Name: M Social Sunnyvale
Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA
Salary Range: $25.00 Hourly

Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale

At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.

About M Social Sunnyvale

As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.

As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."

At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:

  • Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
  • Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
  • Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
  • Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results

These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.

About the Role:

As our House Attendant, you will help maintain the cleanliness, presentation, and overall appearance of M Social Sunnyvale. You will support the Housekeeping team by maintaining public areas, assisting with guest room and housekeeping needs, transporting supplies and linens, and ensuring the hotel consistently meets our high standards of cleanliness and presentation.

Working throughout the hotel, you will be an important part of creating an environment that feels welcoming, vibrant, and cared for. Your attention to detail, responsiveness, and willingness to help will directly contribute to the guest experience.

This role is ideal for a dependable, energetic, and service-minded team member who takes pride in their surroundings and enjoys being part of a team that keeps the hotel moving.

Your Impact – Keeping M Social Looking Its Best

You will help ensure every area of the hotel is clean, organized, polished, and ready for our guests. From maintaining high-traffic public spaces to supporting Housekeeping with linens, supplies, and guest requests, your work helps create the environment guests see, experience, and remember.

What You'll Be Doing

Public Area Cleaning & Maintenance

  • Clean and maintain hotel public areas, including lobbies, corridors, elevators, restrooms, stairways, meeting spaces, and other assigned areas
  • Vacuum, sweep, mop, dust, polish, and sanitize surfaces according to hotel standards
  • Clean glass, mirrors, fixtures, furniture, and other public area surfaces
  • Maintain cleanliness of high-traffic areas throughout the day
  • Empty trash and replace liners in designated areas
  • Keep public spaces neat, organized, and free of debris
  • Monitor public areas for cleanliness, appearance, and safety
  • Report maintenance issues, damaged furniture, lighting concerns, spills, or other conditions requiring attention
  • Assist with deep cleaning projects and special cleaning assignments as needed
  • Ensure cleaning equipment and supplies are properly stored after use

Housekeeping Support

  • Support Room Attendants and Housekeeping leadership with daily operational needs
  • Deliver linens, towels, amenities, supplies, and other items to guest rooms and housekeeping areas
  • Collect and transport soiled linens and towels to designated areas
  • Assist with stocking housekeeping closets and service areas
  • Help maintain organized and properly stocked housekeeping supply areas
  • Assist with moving furniture, rollaway beds, cribs, luggage, and other items as needed
  • Respond to housekeeping-related guest requests in a timely and professional manner
  • Assist Room Attendants with additional tasks as directed
  • Support room readiness and turnover efforts during high-occupancy periods
  • Assist with special projects, seasonal cleaning, and hotel events as needed

Guest Service

title: Program Manager
description:
We call ourselves Algos — and we hold ourselves to a clear standard: professional, respectful and honest in every interaction, with real accountability for the quality of our work. We look out for each other, and if something's off, we don't let it slide — the same instinct this role needs when it comes to surfacing scope creep or risk early rather than absorbing it quietly.

We're also built around the idea of the evolved worker: every role is layered with AI enablement over time, not to replace judgment, but so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on what actually needs a human. Delivery and innovation carry equal weight here — as our founder puts it, it's not just about innovation, the delivery side matters just as much.

We hire and promote on merit, and we invest in growing our own. Internal mobility is a real part of how this team scales, and new Algos are paired with those who came before them from day one, not left to find their footing alone.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to bring together content, platform and email delivery within Google's regional marketing communications program into one coherent, consistently run operation. This is an internal-facing role: it doesn't own a client relationship, but it is accountable for making sure the team's different fronts work as one, that quality and reporting are consistent, and that the team has the coaching and capacity support it needs to keep scaling. It's a strong fit for someone who enjoys connecting the dots across a team more than owning a single function — someone who wants to build the operating rhythm a growing team runs on, not just follow one.

Scope and Deliverables

Cross-Functional Program Leadership

  • Act as the single point of integration connecting content, platform ops and email development, ensuring specialist teams operate as one coordinated workflow rather than in parallel.

  • Own day-to-day consistency across delivery fronts; receive regular status reporting from the team and escalate only exceptions to Delivery Lead.

  • Coordinate the handoff between specialist functions (e.g. content and production) so cross-functional work happens as a partnership, not in isolation.

Content & Channel Consistency

  • Maintain narrative and visual consistency across communications channels, reviewing live output directly.

  • Support and help coordinate recurring content strategy conversations, bringing a cross-channel perspective into planning.

  • Manage light administrative coordination with external vendors or freelance support (e.g. translators) once a request has already been scoped.

Team Operations & Capacity

  • Manage workload and capacity balancing across supporting creative and production resources.

  • Extend and standardize tracking and reporting tools across the team for shared visibility.

People Development

  • Coach team members as they grow more senior, helping them scope and negotiate priorities rather than defaulting to yes on every request.

  • Build a working understanding of where the team spends time and effort, using that insight to guide coaching and process improvements that increase efficiency.

Process & Risk Management

  • Flag scope creep or emerging risk early, before ad hoc requests become unplanned, unscoped ongoing work.

  • Support standardized reporting using existing dashboards and tools, rather than introducing new reporting overhead.



Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in program/project management, account management, or operations delivery, ideally in a marketing, content, or digital production environment.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams (content, design, development).

  • Comfortable working across Google Workspace tools in a fast-moving, ticket-driven environment.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with sound judgment on when to escalate versus resolve.

  • People management experience, with the ability to coach and support a small team.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Ignite IT Hub is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to improve the U.S. Census Bureau's LLM Autocoder and assess its use across household surveys and demographic projects. You will lead analytical methods and experimental design for coding survey write-in responses, working with engineers, the Model Evaluation Analyst, and Government subject matter experts (SMEs) to turn evidence into practical recommendations.

Responsibilities

• Establish performance baselines and evaluation methods for the American Community Survey (ACS) Autocoder and proposed expansion efforts.

• Analyze accuracy, industry and occupation joint coding rates, coverage, error patterns, and category-level results to identify improvement opportunities and regressions.

• Design reproducible experiments with representative samples, appropriate comparison groups, and controls against data leakage; explain uncertainty and limitations.

• Compare LLMs, fuzzy matching, direct-match dictionaries, rules, and hybrid approaches based on coding quality, explainability, feasibility, and operational cost.

• Assess data readiness and coding taxonomies for additional surveys and ACS fields, such as race and ancestry, field of degree, and language.

• Work with Government SMEs to resolve ambiguous cases and refine evaluation criteria; guide engineers on changes to prompts, preprocessing, model configuration, and coding methods.

title: Traffic Control Technician
description:
**Job Title:** Traffic Control Technician


**Location:** Colorado (various sites statewide; may include Front Range, mountain, or rural work zones)


**Job Summary**

The Traffic Control Technician is responsible for the safe and effective setup, maintenance, and removal of temporary traffic control devices and work zones on Colorado roadways. This position supports construction, maintenance, utility, and emergency operations by implementing traffic control plans in accordance with the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) standards, and applicable state and local regulations. The role prioritizes the safety of workers, the traveling public, pedestrians, and cyclists while ensuring efficient traffic flow through and around work areas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

- Set up, maintain, monitor, and dismantle temporary traffic control devices, including signs, cones, barricades, drums, channelizing devices, arrow boards, variable message boards, and Truck-Mounted Attenuators (TMAs).

- Implement approved Traffic Control Plans (TCPs) for lane closures, detours, flagging operations, and other work-zone configurations.

- Perform flagging duties as needed, directing vehicular and pedestrian traffic using proper signals, paddles, and techniques in compliance with CDOT and MUTCD standards.

- Transport, load, unload, and stage traffic control materials and equipment to and from job sites using company vehicles.

- Conduct regular inspections of work zones to ensure devices remain in proper condition, alignment, and reflectivity; make adjustments as conditions change.

- Maintain accurate daily records, including device inventories, setup/tear-down logs, incident reports, and any traffic control violations observed.

- Communicate effectively with supervisors, crew members, contractors, law enforcement, and the public regarding work-zone status and safety.

- Follow all safety protocols, wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), and promote a strong safety culture.

- Assist with inventory management, equipment maintenance, and basic repairs of traffic control devices.

- Respond to emergency or after-hours call-outs for traffic control support as required.

- Perform other related duties as assigned.


**Minimum Qualifications**

- High school diploma or GED.

- Minimum age of 18 years (required for Colorado Flagger certification).

- Valid Colorado driver’s license with a clean driving record (Commercial Driver’s License Class A or B preferred or required by some employers).

- Ability to obtain and maintain a current Colorado Flagger Certification (CDOT-approved training entity) within a specified period after hire (typically required before performing flagging duties).

- Knowledge of, or ability to quickly learn, the MUTCD (especially Part 6 – Temporary Traffic Control) and Colorado-specific standards.

- Physical ability to lift, carry, and place traffic control devices weighing up to 50 lbs repeatedly; stand, walk, and work outdoors for extended periods in varying weather conditions.

- Ability to pass pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check, and drug screening (DOT-compliant where applicable).


**Preferred Qualifications**

- Current ATSSA (American Traffic Safety Services Association) or equivalent Traffic Control Technician (TCT) certification.

- Prior experience (6 months to 2+ years) in traffic control, construction, road maintenance, or related field work.

- Experience operating or working around TMAs, arrow boards, and variable message signs.

- Familiarity with Colorado mountain or high-altitude work zones and related safety considerations.

- Bilingual skills (English/Spanish) are a plus in many Colorado locations.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

- Strong commitment to safety and situational awareness in high-traffic environments.

- Ability to read and interpret traffic control plans, maps, and basic construction documents.

- Clear verbal communication skills for directing traffic and coordinating with crews.

- Reliability, punctuality, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

- Basic mechanical aptitude for equipment checks and minor maintenance.

- Willingness to work irregular hours, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and in adverse weather (heat, cold, snow, rain, wind).


**Working Conditions**

Work is primarily performed outdoors in active roadway environments with exposure to moving traffic, construction equipment, noise, dust, fumes, and variable weather conditions common to Colorado (including high-altitude and mountain settings). The position requires standing or walking for long periods, frequent lifting, and the ability to respond quickly to changing site conditions. Travel to multiple job sites within a region or statewide may be required.


**Certifications & Compliance Notes (Colorado-Specific)**

- Colorado law (C.R.S. 43-5-308) requires flaggers to be at least 18 years old and certified through a CDOT-authorized training entity. Certifications are typically valid for two years.

- For supervisory-level roles or certain CDOT contracts, progression to Traffic Control Supervisor (TCS) certification (via ATSSA, Colorado Contractors Association, or equivalent) is often expected or required.

- Employers frequently require or prefer ATSSA Traffic Control Technician (TCT) credentials in addition to the state Flagger card.


This job description is intended as a general template and can be customized by employers to reflect specific company policies, exact certification timelines, pay ranges, benefits, or additional duties. Always verify current CDOT training and certification requirements, as they are subject to periodic updates.

title: Title & Registration Administrator
description:
Title and Registration Administrator

If you're detail-oriented, organized, and enjoy administrative work that makes a real impact, we'd love to meet you. Join Clicklease and help ensure our title and registration processes are accurate, efficient, and compliant while supporting the financing experience for small businesses across the country.


Role Details

Location: On-site – Draper, Utah

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Compensation: $18–$20 per hour, depending on experience.


About Clicklease

Clicklease is transforming how small businesses access the equipment they need to grow.


About the Role

The Title and Registration Administrator supports Clicklease's title operations by processing vehicle title documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring title-related activities are completed accurately and on time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organized, detail-oriented work, takes pride in accuracy, and thrives in a collaborative office environment.


The Team

You'll join our Title & Registration team, which plays an important role in ensuring vehicle title documentation is processed accurately and efficiently. The team partners closely with internal departments to maintain compliance, resolve documentation issues, and deliver an exceptional operational experience.


What You'll Do

· Process incoming title documents and Manufacturer's Certificates of Origin (MCOs).

· Scan, organize, and maintain electronic and physical title records.

· Prepare title releases and assemble title packets for shipment.

· Review documentation for accuracy and identify missing or incomplete information.

· Collaborate with internal teams to resolve title-related documentation issues.

· Maintain compliance with company procedures while meeting quality and turnaround expectations.


What You Have

· High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.

· 1+ year of administrative, clerical, or document processing experience.

· Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

· Strong attention to detail with the ability to perform accurate data entry.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

· Ability to learn new software systems and internal processes.

No prior title or registration experience is required—we'll train the right candidate.


What Will Make You Stand Out

· Experience processing vehicle titles or registrations.

· Experience working in automotive, lending, financial services, or document processing environments.

· Experience working with document management systems.


What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

· Become proficient in Clicklease title processing procedures and internal systems.

· Independently manage assigned title processing responsibilities while maintaining quality standards.

· Consistently meet productivity and accuracy expectations.

· Build strong working relationships with internal partners and contribute to timely resolution of title documentation issues.


Why Join Clicklease

Clicklease is transforming how small businesses access the equipment they need to grow. Our technology platform uses data and automation to make equipment financing faster, simpler, and more accessible for business owners across the United States.

At Clicklease, you'll work on meaningful problems that directly impact small businesses while collaborating with a team that values ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We look for people who take initiative, work collaboratively, and care deeply about delivering great outcomes for customers and partners.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute to a rapidly scaling fintech platform, and work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about building great products and services.


What We Offer

Clicklease offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support employees and their families.

Benefits may include:

· Competitive salary

· Medical, dental, and vision insurance

· Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

· 401(k) with company match

· Employer-paid short-term disability (STD), long-term disability (LTD), and life insurance

· Paid time off and company holidays

· Paid maternity leave

· Professional development and learning opportunities

Benefits eligibility and details may vary based on role and employment status.

**Clicklease only accepts resumes submitted in English**

title: iOS Developer
description:
Dla zespołu rozwijającego jedną z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych aplikacji mobilnych w europejskim sektorze logistycznym, z której korzysta ponad 10 milionów użytkowników, poszukujemy Senior iOS Developera, który wesprze rozwój platformy mobilnej oraz skalowanie aplikacji na kolejne rynki europejskie.

Szukamy osoby z dużym doświadczeniem w tworzeniu natywnych aplikacji iOS, która chce mieć realny wpływ na architekturę, jakość kodu oraz rozwój rozwiązań wykorzystywanych przez miliony użytkowników każdego dnia. Projekt jest realizowany dla firmy InPost.

Technologie: Swift, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, MVVM, Clean Architecture, SOLID, TCA, Swift Package Manager, XCTest, Fastlane, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Confluence.

Zadania:

  • Tworzenie i rozwój funkcjonalności w natywnej aplikacji iOS.
  • Dbanie o wydajność, jakość i responsywność aplikacji.

  • Projektowanie i implementacja wielokrotnego użytku komponentów Design System zgodnych z wymaganiami dostępności.
  • Udział w code review oraz dbanie o standardy jakości kodu.
  • Współtworzenie procesów CI/CD, release orchestration oraz automatyzacji testów.
  • Przygotowywanie dokumentacji technicznej, konfiguracji oraz decyzji architektonicznych.
Euvic - ponad 5000 pracowników i 20 lat doświadczenia niewątpliwie czynią nas dużą firmą. A jednak, mimo upływu czasu i stale powiększającego się grona klientów wciąż jesteśmy firmą stworzoną przez inżynierów IT dla inżynierów IT. Tworzymy prężnie rozwijającą się firmę „z ludzką twarzą”, składającą się z dobrych ludzi, tworzących dobre oprogramowanie. Czyni nas to solidnym partnerem IT skupiających się na własnych osiągnięciach, sukcesach klientów i satysfakcji zawodowej pracowników.

Co oferujemy?

    • sprawny, szybki i przyjazny proces rekrutacyjny (nie tylko umiejętności są dla nas ważne, wspólnie sprawdźmy, czy pasujesz do the Good People),
    • pracę i rozwój w renomowanej firmie IT, z ugruntowaną pozycją na rynku,
    • projekty dla klientów międzynarodowych z wielu branż,
    • płaską strukturę, politykę „otwartych drzwi” i dbałości o dobre relacje w zespołach,
    • małe zespoły w dużej firmie i koleżeńską wspólnotę w tych zespołach,

    • rozwój wewnątrz organizacji – szkolenia wewnętrzne, „Euvic Talks”, możliwość prowadzenia wewnętrznych szkoleń,
    • udział w inicjatywach społecznych – wspieramy potrzebujących z udziałem Fundacji The Good People.


W Euvic tworzymy środowisko pracy oparte na równości, szacunku i otwartości. Wierzymy, że różnorodność talentów i perspektyw napędza innowacje oraz wspiera zrównoważony rozwój. Dlatego nasze procesy rekrutacyjne są projektowane w sposób, który zapewnia każdemu kandydatowi równe szanse, niezależnie od pochodzenia, płci, wieku, orientacji seksualnej, stanu zdrowia czy innych indywidualnych cech.

Zastanawiasz się czy warto?

    W naszym wewnętrznym badaniu #theGoodPeople wskazali 4 kluczowe aspekty, które cenią najbardziej:

    1. Sam/a decyduję o tym, jak najlepiej wykonać swoją pracę.

    3. Jestem traktowany/a z należytym szacunkiem.

Wybierz swoje benefity:

    2. Opieka medyczna,
    3. Ubezpieczenie na życie z możliwością wykupienia dodatkowych pakietów np. opieki onkologicznej,
    4. Inicjatywy rozwojowe.


Zapraszamy do #theGoodPeople - profesjonaliści, pasjonaci, dobrzy ludzie 🙂

  • Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu i utrzymaniu produkcyjnych aplikacji iOS.

title: Restaurant Supervisor
description:

Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA

Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale

At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.

About M Social Sunnyvale

As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.

As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."

  • Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
  • Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
  • Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
  • Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results

These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.

About the Role:

As our Restaurant Supervisor, you will help lead the day-to-day operations of the hotel's restaurant, ensuring an energetic, welcoming, and memorable dining experience for every guest. You will supervise the Food & Beverage team, support service execution, maintain quality standards, and help drive restaurant revenue and guest satisfaction.

At M Social, dining is more than a meal—it is part of the social experience. You will help create an environment where guests feel comfortable connecting, celebrating, and enjoying themselves while ensuring the team delivers thoughtful and attentive service.

This role is ideal for a hospitality professional who leads by example, enjoys connecting with people, and thrives in a fast-paced, social environment.

Your Impact – Creating a Social Dining Experience

You will help set the tone for every dining experience at M Social Sunnyvale. Through hands-on leadership, thoughtful service, and strong operational execution, you will help ensure our restaurant feels vibrant, welcoming, and uniquely M Social.

What You'll Be Doing

Restaurant Operations

  • Supervise daily restaurant operations to ensure smooth, efficient, and high-quality service
  • Support the Restaurant Manager and Food & Beverage leadership with daily operational needs
  • Coordinate opening, operating, and closing procedures
  • Monitor table assignments, reservations, seating flow, and guest wait times
  • Ensure dining areas, service stations, and restaurant spaces are clean, organized, and guest-ready

Guest Experience

  • Anticipate guest needs and look for opportunities to personalize the experience
  • Promote restaurant offerings, specialty items, events, and hotel amenities
  • Encourage the team to create genuine connections with guests

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead by example and consistently demonstrate M Social service standards
  • Supervise, coach, and support restaurant team members during each shift
  • Conduct pre-shift meetings and communicate daily priorities, specials, promotions, and operational updates
  • Train team members on service standards, menu knowledge, POS procedures, and guest engagement
  • Provide real-time coaching and constructive feedback
  • Monitor employee performance, appearance, attendance, and adherence to company policies
  • Recognize team members for exceptional service and contributions
  • Foster a positive, inclusive, collaborative, and social team environment
  • Assist with scheduling and staffing needs based on business levels

Food & Beverage Service

  • Ensure food and beverages are served according to established quality and presentation standards
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the restaurant menu, ingredients, beverages, and daily offerings
  • Ensure servers and team members are knowledgeable about menu items and able to make recommendations
  • Monitor ticket times and coordinate with the culinary team to ensure efficient service
  • Communicate guest dietary restrictions and allergies appropriately
  • Ensure proper service sequences and table maintenance are followed
  • Support special events, group dining, and VIP experiences as needed

Revenue & Financial Controls

  • Support the restaurant's revenue and profitability goals
  • Encourage appropriate upselling of food, beverages, and specialty offerings
  • Monitor checks, discounts, voids, comps, and payment transactions for accuracy
  • Ensure cash and credit card procedures are followed
  • Review daily reports and identify discrepancies requiring follow-up
  • Assist management with controlling labor and operational costs
  • Monitor waste and assist with implementing cost-control procedures

Safety, Sanitation & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and food handling standards
  • Monitor cleanliness of dining and service areas throughout each shift
  • Ensure proper food handling and sanitation procedures are followed
  • Maintain awareness of food allergies and communicate them appropriately
  • Follow hotel procedures for emergencies, accidents, and guest incidents
  • Report safety hazards and maintenance concerns immediately
  • Ensure employees follow established uniform, grooming, and personal hygiene standards

Communication & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the culinary team to ensure smooth service
  • Communicate with Front Office regarding VIP guests, groups, special occasions, and guest requests
  • Collaborate with Sales and Events teams on group functions and special events
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping and Engineering regarding restaurant operational needs
  • Communicate important information during shift changes
  • Participate in daily operational meetings as needed
  • Maintain clear, professional, and positive communication with hotel leadership and team members

Requirements

    • Passion for hospitality and creating memorable dining experiences
    • Strong leadership and team-building skills
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    • Strong organizational and time management abilities
    • Ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment
    • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
    • Ability to motivate and develop team members
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to service excellence
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality
    • High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability
    • Genuine interest in creating a fun, social, and welcoming environment

Technical / Role-Specific Requirements

    • Minimum 2 years of Food & Beverage or restaurant experience, with supervisory experience preferred
    • Previous experience in a full-service hotel, restaurant, or hospitality environment
    • Strong knowledge of restaurant service standards and operations
    • Knowledge of food safety and sanitation standards
    • Experience with POS systems and cash handling
    • Knowledge of food and beverage products, service techniques, and menu presentation
    • Ability to understand and monitor restaurant financial and operational reports
    • Experience with banquet, group dining, or special events is a plus
    • Food Handler certification required or ability to obtain as required
    • Responsible Beverage Service certification preferred or required based on position responsibilities and applicable regulations

Preferred Qualifications

    • Previous experience as a Restaurant Supervisor, Lead Server, or Assistant Restaurant Manager
    • Experience supervising and developing Food & Beverage employees
    • Previous hotel restaurant or resort experience
    • Experience with high-volume restaurant operations
    • Experience with guest recovery and service excellence
    • Strong knowledge of food and beverage trends
    • Experience with opening a new restaurant or hotel is a plus
    • Bilingual abilities are a plus

Physical Requirements

    • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
    • Ability to move throughout the restaurant, kitchen, and hotel
    • Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds
    • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, and move throughout the shift
    • Ability to operate POS systems and standard restaurant equipment
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment for extended periods
    • Ability to work varied shifts, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events

Education

    • High school diploma or equivalent required
    • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
    • Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant hospitality experience may be considered where appropriate

Benefits

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, we support our employees with a competitive benefits package designed to promote wellbeing and long-term success:

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to plan terms and company policy.

Why Join Us

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, you’re not just taking on a role—you’re joining a global organization committed to people, performance, and growth.

Whether you’re supporting operations behind the scenes or delivering service on the front line, your work contributes to a culture focused on hospitality, collaboration, and results.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow, contribute, and make an impact, we invite you to join our team.

Fox-IT

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Lake Forest, Illinois.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Lake Forest area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Lake Forest requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

  • Inspect plumbing fixtures and identify potential issues
  • Assist with preventive maintenance of water and plumbing systems

  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and preventive maintenance
  • Communicate recurring equipment problems to Engineering leadership

title: Identity and Access Management Engineer
description:
Identity and Access Management Engineer


Open Dealer Exchange (ODE), is seeking an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support its workforce in Southfield, MI. The ideal candidate will have deep experience with Entra ID, Active Directory, identity lifecycle automation, and governing access in regulated enterprise environments. Open Dealer Exchange is a dynamic, exciting place to work. Open Dealer Exchange offers a hybrid work model as well as an excellent compensation/benefit package.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise RBAC: Build a cohesive role-based access control model across Entra ID, Active Directory, and Entra External ID, replacing ad hoc access grants with governed, role-aligned entitlements.
  • Lead identity lifecycle automation: Integrate the HR system with Entra ID to automate provisioning and deprovisioning, ensuring access changes are event-driven and auditable at the point of hire, transfer, and termination.
  • Govern directory structure and access hygiene: Define and enforce naming conventions, group structures, and access review cadences across all directory platforms.
  • Manage non-human identities: Govern service accounts, including managed identities, service principals, and app registrations, enforcing least privilege and credential hygiene across all environments.
  • Advise development teams on identity security: Provide architectural guidance on token handling, session management, and federation patterns for teams building or maintaining identity adjacent systems.
  • Drive Conditional Access and PIM: Lead Conditional Access policy design and own Privileged Identity Management configuration and the privileged access model for admin roles across Azure and M365.
  • Support Entra External ID governance: Advise teams on External ID tenant configuration, custom policy, user flows, and external identity federation.
  • Produce compliance-ready documentation: Maintain IAM documentation including access control matrices, provisioning runbooks, and audit-ready entitlement inventories supporting FCRA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations.
  • Collaborate across the security program: Align IAM initiatives with the broader security roadmap and participate in change management and architecture review processes alongside security engineers and the Cybersecurity Manager.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Amherst, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Amherst area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Amherst requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
