title: Mobile Crisis Clinician Part Time
description:
(THIS IS A PART-TIME POSITION)

Under the general supervision of the Mobile Crisis Director, the Mobile Crisis Clinician performs direct clinical services, including crisis intervention and de-escalation for individuals of all ages.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs direct clinical services, including crisis intervention and de-escalation for individuals of all ages.
  • Performs indirect clinical services, including, timely and complete case documentation following DWIHN policies and procedures.
  • Documents all crisis intervention activities in the electronic medical record to ensure accuracy of records and regulatory compliance.
  • Provides coordination and follow-up for clients and assists in obtaining necessary additional services, coordinating with the Access Center or the patient’s current outpatient therapy plan.
  • Maintains clinical documentation that is accurate and up to date, including assessments, progress notes, crisis/safety plans, and other required documentation.
  • Participates in agency and system staff meetings.
  • Participates in community meetings.
  • Collaborates with schools, law enforcement and other organizations.
  • Assists individuals/families in developing natural supports to increase success in the community.
  • Provides counseling, guidance, support, resources, and encouragement to individuals served so that they can learn to take responsibility for and actively participate in their own recovery.
  • Provides on call duties as needed which include but are not limited to responding to calls from mobile crisis clinicians and peers.
  • Provides mobile crisis services in the community.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSA’S)

  • Knowledge of DWIHN policies, procedures, and practices.

  • Knowledge of Federal policies, rules, regulations, and procedures as it relates to DWIHN.
  • Knowledge of Mobile Crisis principles and practices.
  • Knowledge of Crisis Services principles and practices.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health and mental health principles and practices.
  • Knowledge of the Michigan Medicaid Provider Manual.
  • Knowledge of MHWIN.
  • Knowledge of the LOCUS model.
  • Knowledge of the clinical care process (screening, assessment, treatment planning, case management and continuing care).
  • Knowledge of and ability to use screening and assessment tools for behavioral health services.
  • Knowledge of the Adult continuum of care for all disability designations (I/DD, SMI, Co-Occurring Disorder).
  • Knowledge of adult’s services; Outpatient, Co- occurring services, CM, ACT, Supported Employment and Med Drop.
  • Knowledge of Integrated Care services for behavioral health patients.
  • Knowledge of medical and behavioral health practices and terminology.
  • Knowledge of compliance standards.
  • Knowledge of Medical Necessity Criteria for Behavioral Health Services.
  • Knowledge of SUD guidelines and licensing certifications.
  • Knowledge of crisis training and experience in de-escalation, i.e., suicide prevention, development of crisis plans, trauma informed care, etc.
  • Assessment and evaluation skills.
  • Conflict Resolution skills
  • Computer skills.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Report writing skills.
  • Negotiation skills.
  • Problem Solving skills.
  • Decision Making skills.
  • Interpersonal Skills.
  • Communication skills.
  • Collaboration skills.
  • Multitasking skills.

  • Ability to communicate orally.

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

A Master’s Degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counseling, Human Services, the Social Services, or a related field.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

One (1) year of full-time paid professional clinical experience working in crisis services or a closely related area.

REQUIRED LICENSE(S).

A Valid State of Michigan clinical licensure: RN, LMSW, LMHC, LPC, LLP or PhD.

(A limited license will be accepted).

A Valid State of Michigan Driver’s License with a safe and acceptable driving record.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Employees in this classification must travel throughout Wayne County. Candidates will be required to travel to homes, community-based settings, hospitals, schools, courts, etc.

Mobile Crisis Operations is a 24/7 unit. These are part-time positions that will work 12 hour shifts on Saturday and Sunday. The shifts will be (7:00 AM – 7:00 PM) and (7:00 PM – 7:00 AM). Candidates may be required to work other days, hours, or shifts as necessary.

title: Change Management & Training Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Change Management & Training Specialist to support organizational transformation, business improvement, and operational change initiatives within a large-scale industrial environment.

The role will be responsible for developing and executing change management strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, communication activities, and training programs to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, technologies, policies, and organizational initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with leadership, project teams, subject matter experts, and employees to assess change impacts, manage resistance, build organizational readiness, and ensure employees have the knowledge and capabilities required to successfully transition to new ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Change Management Plans for organizational, operational, digital, and business transformation initiatives.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify how changes will affect employees, processes, roles, systems, and business operations.
  • Develop stakeholder engagement strategies and communication plans aligned with project and organizational objectives.
  • Identify potential resistance to change and develop appropriate mitigation and engagement strategies.
  • Assess organizational readiness and develop action plans to improve change adoption.
  • Work closely with project managers, business leaders, subject matter experts, and functional teams throughout the change lifecycle.
  • Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, awareness sessions, and briefing sessions to support organizational change.
  • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) based on business requirements, competency gaps, and upcoming organizational changes.
  • Develop training materials, presentations, user guides, manuals, procedures, FAQs, and other learning resources.
  • Coordinate with subject matter experts to ensure training content accurately reflects new processes, systems, procedures, and operational requirements.
  • Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for employees and stakeholders.
  • Support the development and implementation of train-the-trainer programs where required.
  • Monitor training participation, knowledge transfer, competency development, and employee adoption.
  • Collect feedback from employees and stakeholders and incorporate findings into continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish and track change adoption, readiness, training completion, and effectiveness KPIs.
  • Prepare regular progress reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
  • Support post-implementation activities to ensure sustained adoption of new processes, systems, and organizational practices.
  • Develop communication materials including announcements, newsletters, presentations, awareness campaigns, and change updates.
  • Ensure change and training activities are aligned with organizational policies, procedures, standards, and business objectives.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation, training records, attendance records, assessments, and change management deliverables.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Management, Education, Psychology, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Change Management, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, Training, or transformation-related roles.
  • Experience working within large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, engineering, or other complex operational environments is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience supporting organizational transformation, business process improvement, digital transformation, system implementation, or operational change initiatives.
  • Strong experience in developing and delivering professional training programs.
  • Experience conducting Training Needs Analysis and developing competency-based training programs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills across different organizational levels.
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

Preferred Certifications

  • Prosci Change Management Certification
  • CCMP – Certified Change Management Professional
  • APMG Change Management Certification
  • PMP / Project Management Certification
  • CIPD
  • ATD / CPTD
  • Relevant Learning & Development or Organizational Development certifications

title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
description:
📋 DESCRIPTION (About Norbloc + Why This Role Matters + What You'll Own)

Norbloc builds the trust infrastructure behind modern financial compliance. Our RegTech and blockchain platform powers Know Your Customer (KYC) and secure data-sharing for banks, financial institutions and government bodies, replacing slow, fragmented, manual onboarding with a shared, distributed-ledger-backed ecosystem that regulators, banks and customers can all rely on.

Our clients are not forgiving of shortcuts: systemic banks, regulators and government bodies across Europe and the Middle East operate under some of the strictest security, resilience and compliance standards in the industry. Building for them means every architectural choice has to hold up under real scrutiny.

We're now looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take that foundation and scale it, leading technology through Norbloc's next phase of growth.

Why This Role Matters Now

Norbloc sits where two worlds meet: the pace and ambition of blockchain and data innovation versus the risk tolerance of enterprise banking. Few technology leaders are fluent in both. This role exists to be that bridge, someone who can architect for scale and security, lead engineering teams through rapid growth and sit across the table from a bank's CIO or a regulator's compliance officer and speak their language fluently.

This is a board-level seat with real ownership: over architecture, over the technology organization and over how Norbloc is perceived by the institutions that matter most to our growth.

What You'll Own

Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Set Norbloc's end-to-end technology strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, in step with company vision and enterprise client needs
  • Architect secure, cloud-native systems that bridge banking-grade infrastructure with blockchain/DLT, cryptography and modern data and AI capabilities
  • Own the platform's operating model, including SLAs, observability, incident response and on-call practices, to a standard that satisfies regulated financial clients, not just internal targets
  • Make build-vs-buy and vendor/platform calls backed by clear-eyed cost, scalability and governance analysis. Be willing to defend the "boring" choice when it's the right one

Data, Governance & Compliance

  • Build the data governance, lineage, metadata and quality foundations that make the platform auditable and trustworthy at scale
  • Own technology risk management and IT governance, including compliance with KYC/AML, data residency and audit requirements across our operating jurisdictions
  • Work with Compliance and external legal counsel so that technical decisions are made with regulatory consequences already priced in, not discovered afterward

Team & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead, mentor and scale Engineering, Data, DevOps and QA, building strong managers under you, not just individual contributors
  • Instill the delivery discipline that enterprise clients expect: code quality, CI/CD, testing rigor, predictable roadmaps
  • Take ownership of any externally delivered components and bring them fully in-house where it makes sense to do so

Executive & Client Engagement

  • Be Norbloc's senior technical voice to C-level executives, IT leadership and compliance officers at bank and government clients
  • Represent Norbloc's technology vision to investors, partners and prospective enterprise clients
  • Translate technical trade-offs (cost, risk, scalability) into terms a systemic bank's leadership can act on with confidence

Requirements

✅ REQUIREMENTS (What You Bring)

Must-haves

  • 10+ years in enterprise-level technology, with substantial experience in Fintech, banking, or regulated financial infrastructure
  • A track record of bridging traditional enterprise/banking architecture with modern technology. Blockchain/DLT and cryptography experience is strongly preferred; deep data platform and AI/ML delivery experience is equally valued
  • Experience leading and scaling engineering, data, DevOps and QA teams, ideally across distributed or international locations, in a fast-growing environment
  • Solid command of IT governance, information security and regulatory compliance in financial services
  • Direct experience engaging C-level stakeholders at large or systemic banks, whether through architecture, platform modernization, or technology cost/value advisory
  • Executive presence: equally credible in a boardroom and in an architecture review

Nice-to-haves

  • Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • Experience shipping AI/LLM-powered products on top of enterprise or regulated data
  • Prior exposure to platform strategy decisions with a documented rationale, not just a gut call
  • Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions, given Norbloc's footprint across Europe and the Middle East

Benefits

🎁 BENEFITS (What We Offer)

  • A senior, high-ownership leadership role shaping the technology direction of a category-defining RegTech company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Hybrid working model. Presence at our Athens office is required at least 2 days per week
  • Direct, regular exposure to systemic banks, regulators and global institutional clients, not filtered through layers of process
  • A collaborative, ambitious team culture with real autonomy
  • A front-row seat to the future of digital identity, KYC and secure data-sharing infrastructure

title: Project Controls Specialist
description:
About Us

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

The Project Controls Specialist is an experienced individual contributor responsible for leading the day-to-day execution, analysis, and integrity of Project Controls on assigned projects. Working under the direction of the Project Controls Director, the role integrates cost, schedule, forecasting, risk, change management, energy performance, progress measurement, and reporting information to support informed decision-making and successful project outcomes.

This is a hands-on role embedded within the project team. The Project Controls Specialist independently leads Project Controls execution on assigned small-to-medium projects or defined scopes within larger, more complex projects. The position owns established Project Controls processes, identifies emerging issues, evaluates project performance, develops recommendations, and drives follow-through on corrective actions. The role collaborates with the Project Controls Director when project complexity, risk, or business impact requires additional technical leadership.

The Project Controls Specialist is expected to serve as the primary Project Controls resource for assigned projects and demonstrate ownership, commercial awareness, sound judgment, effective communication, and the ability to influence project outcomes while consistently applying enterprise Project Controls standards and methodologies.

Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

Project Leadership, Team Integration, and Project Setup

  • Serves as the primary Project Controls resource and an active member of assigned project teams, providing timely, objective information that supports financial, schedule, and execution decisions.

  • Leads Project Controls setup and mobilization for assigned projects, including work breakdown structures, coding structures, baseline controls, responsibility assignments, reporting cadence, and execution requirements.

  • Builds effective working relationships with subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders while representing the Company professionally.

Cost Management, Financial Performance, and Forecasting

  • Leads cost management for assigned projects, including budget maintenance, commitment tracking, accruals, productivity analysis, cash flow, cost trending, variance analysis, and Estimate-at-Completion development.
  • Leads preparation and analysis of assigned project forecasts and reforecasts, validating assumptions and communicating risks, opportunities, variances, and performance drivers.
  • Analyzes actual and forecast results to identify variances and trends and communicates findings to project controls and project leadership.
  • Works with Project Management, Finance, and Operations to reconcile source data and support alignment between project controls and financial reporting.
  • Maintains accurate, timely, and traceable cost and forecast information in accordance with enterprise standards.

Schedule Management

  • Develops, maintains, updates, and analyzes assigned project schedules, including logic, critical path, milestones, progress, resource requirements, and forecast completion dates.
  • Leads schedule status collection and validation and performs critical path, variance, milestone, and trend analysis to identify threats to project delivery.
  • Develops look-ahead schedules, schedule views, and narratives to support project execution.
  • Maintains schedule issue logs and follows up with responsible stakeholders on open items and key dates.

Risk Management

  • Facilitates identification, assessment, documentation, and monitoring of project cost, schedule, resource, and execution risks and opportunities.
  • Maintains risk and opportunity register information, including exposure, ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and potential impacts.
  • Performs appropriate risk analysis, monitors mitigation and contingency actions, and communicates material changes in project exposure.

Change Management

  • Administers the change management process for assigned projects, ensuring trends, scope changes, claims, and potential impacts are identified, evaluated, documented, tracked, and reflected in cost, schedule, and forecast information.
  • Develops or coordinates change estimates, pricing support, schedule impact analyses, back charges, and related documentation.
  • Maintains accurate change logs and provides visibility into the status of pending, approved, rejected, and realized changes.

Energy Management

  • Incorporates energy production, savings, performance commitments, and related economics into applicable Project Controls processes for assigned projects.
  • Collects and analyzes performance information and assists project and technical leaders in identifying variances and corrective actions.

Planning & Project Setup

  • Leads or coordinates Project Controls elements of execution planning and project startup with Pre-Construction, Estimating, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Project Management.
  • Develops the baseline schedule, work breakdown structure, preliminary time-phased spend, controls procedures, and Project Controls content within the Project Execution Plan.
  • Supports proposals, constructability planning, feasibility studies, and project close-out data collection as assigned.

Interface with Operational Finance

  • Coordinates with Operations Finance and Project Accounting on revenue recognition, margin, billing, cash, reforecasting, accruals, and month-end alignment between Project Controls information and the financial ledger.
  • Investigates discrepancies and drives timely resolution of differences among project forecasts, operational expectations, and financial reporting.
  • Provides project leadership and the Project Controls Director with clear information and recommendations regarding material financial trends, risks, and opportunities.

Reporting & Performance Analytics

  • Develops, analyzes, and presents accurate and timely Project Controls reports, dashboards, KPIs, cost curves, progress information, and management analyses for assigned projects.
  • Performs trend, variance, productivity, and performance analysis and recommends actions to address unfavorable performance or protect emerging opportunities.
  • Prepares project controls information for weekly, monthly, quarterly, client, and internal project reviews.
  • Ensures reporting is traceable to source data and aligned with established definitions, standards, and cadence.

Team Leadership, Culture and Talent Development

  • Provides technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to project controls associates, schedulers, cost engineers, and analysts as assigned.
  • May coordinate day-to-day work and quality reviews for project controls personnel on assigned projects without assuming formal manager accountability.

Standards, Tools, and Continuous Improvement

  • Applies enterprise Project Controls standards, procedures, tools, systems, and methodologies on assigned projects.
  • Maintains data quality and process compliance, addresses gaps within assigned responsibilities, and recommends broader improvements to the Project Controls Director.
  • Supports continuous improvement through technology, automation, analytics, lessons learned, and proven Project Controls practices.
  • Performs other project controls duties and supports special initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • 4-year degree in engineering, construction management, business, finance, or related fields or
  • 2 - 5 years of relevant experience in project controls or project management, preferably in building construction, or EPC.
  • Demonstrates experience using Primavera.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented and willing to tackle various ongoing projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Problem-solving Attitude and high level of coordination skills.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness in working with others in a multifunctional team.
  • Accepts change and works well under pressure.
  • An understanding of JDE Edwards is not required but would be a plus.
  • Knowledge of common business tools such as Microsoft Office applications.
  • Awareness of contract and construction terminology.

Preferred Education, Experience, and Qualifications

Travel Requirements

Physical/Work Environment Requirements

description:

At CNS, we are a community of "PATHfinders" who work together to find every path possible for our patients to reach their maximum independence and quality of life. Responsibilities

The Staff Counselor provides therapy and guidance to patients and family members as a part of total patient care. Work is full-time during the weekdays, Monday-Friday from 7:30am-4:30pm with occasional weekend and/or night work. Reviews and revises programs as deemed necessary. Requires ability to make decisions based on patients' needs. Must be able to evaluate situations as they occur and act upon the best solution for the good of staff, patients and self.

Experience and Education

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Bernardsville, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Bernardsville area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Bernardsville requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

title: Principal Software Engineer, Geospatial Mission Systems
description:
Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Geospatial Mission Systems to design, build, integrate, and sustain mission-critical situational-awareness software. This person will serve as a technical lead and subject-matter expert for applications that ingest radar and sensor data, manage geospatial information, and present air and surface tracks through intuitive map-based interfaces.

The role remains close to implementation. The engineer will contribute production code, guide architecture, troubleshoot complex integration issues, and translate operational needs into reliable, fielded capability. Success requires equal strength in software engineering, geospatial systems, technical leadership, and customer partnership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, development, integration, and sustainment of **geospatial and situational-awareness applications** supporting defense and mission operations.
  • Design and maintain client, server, database, and service components within distributed software architectures.
  • Develop map-based user interfaces and data-visualization capabilities for manned and unmanned air, surface, ground, subsurface, and related operational tracks.
  • Integrate software with radars, sensors, external data feeds, and mission-system interfaces.
  • Build and refine geospatial components using vector, terrain, imagery, and open-source mapping data.
  • Design solutions for geospatial data storage, querying, transformation, dissemination, and display.
  • Evaluate and incorporate new mapping technologies, open standards, data formats, and open-source components.
  • Translate customer and operator needs into software requirements, technical designs, prototypes, and production releases.
  • Provide technical leadership across the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, coding, testing, documentation, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Diagnose complex software, data, network, and systems-integration issues in development and operational environments.
  • Mentor engineers and establish sound development, integration, and documentation practices.
  • Build trusted relationships with government customers, end users, systems engineers, and partner development teams.
  • Deliver technical demonstrations, training, documentation, and user support as needed.
  • Contribute to technical planning, solution development, and customer discussions for follow-on capabilities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive software-development experience**, including technical leadership or ownership of complex applications.
  • Demonstrated experience developing **mapping, GIS, geospatial visualization, or situational-awareness software**.
  • Strong hands-on programming experience in **Java** and at least one additional language such as JavaScript, C++, or Python.
  • Experience with distributed or client-server architectures, databases, APIs, and networked services.
  • Experience integrating real-time or near-real-time data from sensors, radars, tracking systems, or other external sources.
  • Working knowledge of geospatial data types and services, such as vector data, terrain/elevation data, imagery, OpenStreetMap, spatial databases, or web map services.
  • Ability to lead work across requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, test, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to customers and end users.
  • Ability to work effectively in a defense-contracting environment with geographically distributed teams and mission stakeholders.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, geographic information science, or a related technical field.

Clearance

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master's degree in computer science, geographic information science, or a related field.
  • Experience with maritime domain awareness, command and control, C2/C4ISR/C5ISR, mission planning, or battlespace visualization.
  • Experience with radar tracks, sensor fusion, track management, tactical data, or operational common-picture applications.
  • Experience with mapping frameworks such as Leaflet, OpenMap, ArcGIS, or comparable geospatial SDKs.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle Spatial, MySQL, or another spatially enabled database.
  • Familiarity with NGA data products and formats such as RPF, DTED, or VPF.
  • Familiarity with Open Geospatial Consortium standards and services, including WMS or comparable interfaces.
  • Experience maintaining or contributing to open-source software and supporting a technical user community.
  • Experience developing simulation, training, after-action review, or spatial-analysis applications.
  • Prior experience delivering software directly to U.S. Government or Department of Defense customers.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.

Special Note

Principal Software Engineer, Geospatial Mission Systems

This role is designed for a senior, hands-on software engineer who can lead the development of geospatial command-and-control applications from architecture through fielded operation. The strongest candidate combines deep mapping and GIS expertise with distributed software development, real-time sensor integration, and the ability to work directly with defense customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Success in the first year

  • Establish technical ownership of the assigned geospatial mission-software components and their integration points.
  • Deliver reliable enhancements to mapping, sensor-ingestion, track-display, or data-management capabilities.
  • Reduce integration and sustainment risk through improved architecture, testing, documentation, and technical practices.
  • Become a trusted technical partner to customers, operators, and adjacent engineering teams.
  • Create a practical roadmap for evolving the system while protecting mission continuity and interoperability.

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: https://www.magaero.com/benefits/. Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $180,000 to $240000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

title: Resident Testing Engineer – Lighting & Comfort Electronics
description:
Resident Testing Engineer – Lighting & Comfort Electronics

Location: Crewe, United Kingdom

Language: Fluent English mandatory; Italian is an advantage

About the Role

HIto Solutions is looking for a Resident Testing Engineer – Lighting & Comfort Electronics to support a long-term automotive engineering activity based in Crewe, UK.

The successful candidate will support the development, integration, testing and validation of automotive Lighting and Comfort Electronics systems, working directly within the customer’s engineering environment.

This role requires a hands-on and autonomous engineer who can execute testing activities, investigate electrical and electronic issues, support root-cause analysis and communicate technical findings effectively to multiple engineering teams.

The candidate will work independently on-site while maintaining regular technical alignment with the wider project team.

Requirements

Department of Defense TS/SCI security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Candidates must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance within a reasonable amount of time from date of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Role & Responsibilities:

GDMS Advanced Systems Engineers analyze, design, develop and test GDMS systems to ensure the integration of software, hardware, reliability, maintainability, safety and other requirements in the total engineering effort.

Responsibilities include requirements analysis, requirements definition, requirements management, functional analysis, performance analysis, system design, trade studies, systems integration and test (verification), validation and interface definition studies of system elements. Tasks may include formulating operational concepts; performing mission, functional, cost-benefit and risk analysis; developing signal processing architecture and overall system architecture.

Our systems typically include digital signal processing algorithms that are implemented in hardware and software for space-based systems. In addition to the general systems engineering qualification stated above, highly qualified candidates have work experience with digital signal processing algorithm development for the statistical analysis of signal parameter measurements utilizing techniques from Detection & Estimation Theory, Random Processes Analysis, and Communications and Information Theory. Working knowledge of MATLAB for DSP using related toolboxes, background with Radar Processing, DSP for mitigating/processing RF effects, Monte Carlo analysis or Phased Array/Beam Forming is a plus.

  • Experience in Python

  • Hardware Prototype Development, “FlatSat”, “Hardware Integration”, “Hardware in-the-loop” Systems Integrations and Test Experience
  • Electrical Engineering and/or Systems Engineering, particularly with communications or digital signal processing focus
  • Experience with Agile hardware, software, or firmware development, DevOps, CI/CD
  • Experience with Digital Engineering/Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)/SySML/MagicDraw/Cameo

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS.   • Strong working knowledge of global KYC regulation, with the ability to quickly learn firm specific policies and requirements
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to problem solve complex regulatory challenges efficiently

  • Comfortable working independently, with confident communication skills and the ability to engage stakeholders across global time zones
  • Familiarity with KYC platforms and case management systems

Benefits

Length: initial 6-month contract

Salary: up to £35k depending on experience

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Our Opportunity:

At Chewy, the Finance and Accounting Business Intelligence team builds trusted reporting and analytics solutions that help our partners make faster, data-backed decisions. We are seeking an experienced Analytics Engineer to design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data products, and analytical workflows that support financial reporting, planning, and operational decision-making.

This team serves a broad audience across Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and other business functions. In this role, you will partner directly with users to understand requirements, translate complex questions into scalable solutions, and deliver clear, reliable reporting. Your work will span report development, data modeling, pipeline support, automation, and analysis using tools such as Tableau, Sigma, SQL, Python, and cloud data platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with curiosity, ownership, and clear communication. This opportunity is well suited for someone who is passionate about data, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and motivated to improve how Chewy turns financial and operational data into trusted insights.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the design, development, testing, and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and analytical content that support critical Finance and Accounting decisions.
  • Partner with business and technical teams to gather requirements, define metrics, and translate user needs into scalable, high-quality BI solutions.
  • Design and maintain semantic views that provide trusted business context, standardized metrics, and governed data for AI agent consumption.
  • Develop self-service reporting and visualizations in Tableau, Sigma, or similar tools, with a focus on usability, performance, and trusted data.
  • Build and support SQL transformations, data models, pipelines, and API-driven integrations that deliver accurate and timely analytical datasets.
  • Champion reporting and analysis best practices, including data integrity, test design, validation, documentation, and change management.
  • Provide leadership and business partners with recurring and ad hoc analyses that clearly communicate findings, trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Identify automation opportunities using Python, AWS, AI, or other technologies to simplify workflows and reduce manual effort.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and reporting issues, coordinate resolution across teams, and communicate impacts and next steps to stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve reporting, data products, and development processes to increase the quality, accessibility, and value of Chewy's data.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, report development, or a related data discipline.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations and experience working with columnar or cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Tableau or a similar BI and visualization tool.
  • Working knowledge of Python and experience supporting data pipelines, APIs, automation scripts, or analytical workflows.
  • Ability to acquire data from multiple sources, maintain reusable data structures, and validate datasets for analytical use.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to subject matter experts and executive leadership.
  • Comfort with self-directed learning, changing priorities, and taking ownership in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience with AWS, Snowflake, and/or Sigma.
  • Experience supporting Finance and Accounting analytics or reporting.
  • Familiarity with dbt, dimensional data modeling, or automated testing.
  • A strong ownership mentality and continuous-improvement mindset.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

title: M&A Associate
description:
Partner One is a long-term investment group specializing in the acquisition and growth of successful software companies. With over 30 years in business, we own and operate some of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies globally. More than 2,000 of the world’s largest corporations and governments rely on our software for their most critical operations and to safeguard their most valuable data.

We are seeking an M&A Associate to join our team in a full-time, remote capacity.

The M&A Associate will be part of the Mergers & Acquisitions team and will play a key role in supporting the research, evaluation, due diligence, and execution of acquisitions, with exposure to a high volume of live opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and source software businesses that meet our acquisition criteria and key performance metrics
  • Develop and execute targeted prospecting campaigns via email and outbound calls, while continuously testing new business development strategies, with exposure to a high volume of deal opportunities
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospective acquisition targets and sell-side M&A investment banking firms
  • Lead preliminary evaluations of potential acquisitions, including initial business and financial due diligence, as well as opportunity and risk assessments
  • Own and manage a robust deal pipeline, ensuring it is consistently updated as new targets and information emerge, while working alongside a team of entrepreneurial, high-performing, and motivated individuals
  • Conduct industry and market research to identify trends and uncover new acquisition opportunities
  • Review and analyze investment materials, synthesizing large volumes of data into clear, concise, and actionable insights and presentations
  • Independently drive acquisition opportunities forward by understanding deal scope and maintaining momentum throughout the process, with exposure to the full deal lifecycle from sourcing to execution
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks effectively based on deal timelines and strategic importance
  • Provide ad hoc analytical and operational support to the broader team as needed
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support data requests, due diligence, internal alignment, and successful deal execution

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of experience in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Corporate Development is required
  • Prior experience with software M&A transactions is a must
  • Strong academic performance from a top-tier institution
  • Undergraduate degree in business or a related field is preferred
  • Professional maturity and confidence in interacting with C-level executives
  • Highly proactive, self-directed, and driven, with strong sales and communication skills

  • Solid foundation in accounting principles and financial modeling
  • Understanding of software business models and the M&A transaction lifecycle
  • Strong analytical ability, pattern recognition skills, and advanced Excel proficience

title: Domestic Operations Supervisor
description:
Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT. Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us!

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Domestic Operations Supervisor is responsible performance management and professional development of the Operations team. The Operations Supervisor will be responsible for training and developing employees, assigning work to others and acting as a resource to the employees. Additionally, this role involves managing relationships with service providers and partners throughout the globe, being the liaison for vendors to manage shipment bookings, ensuring timely transfers from logistics providers’ warehouses and onward to final destinations, as appropriate. This role will also assist as needed to complete the work of the department in addition to daily shipment processing.

Responsibilities

  • Manage functions in the warehouse such as inbound receipts, outbound shipment, storage, stocking and inventory control
  • Responsible for process improvement, standardization and documentation procedures for all operations shifts
  • Responsible for the Operations and Service level of the logistics operations
  • Inventory control and reconciliation of in-house customers
  • Manage daily routes/schedules of shipments and deliveries, track progress of shipments and manager cartage set up of operations over the weekend

title: Bioinformatics Applied AI Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Bioinformatics Applied AI Engineer to build AI-powered workflows that drive insight in bioinformatics and metabolomic chemistry.

Company

Bactobio is a London biotech startup. We work to solve the antimicrobial resistance crisis across healthcare and agriculture by producing the next generation of market-leading antimicrobials. Since inception in 2020, Bactobio has built a deep-tech platform that combines AI, synthetic biology, and multiomics to routinely discover new antimicrobial classes from nature. Our antimicrobial platform is fully operational. We use it to build portfolios of new, safe, and effective antimicrobial classes that bypass resistance, aimed at the most serious diseases, and move them towards commercialisation.

Our culture is built around impact, empowerment, and collaboration. We attract incredible scientists from world-leading institutions, mix them with operational experts, and provide guidance through industry leaders acting as mentors. We strongly believe that diversity combined with open and inclusive conversations leads to better solutions. As a result, we have created a collaborative work environment, where ambitious people enjoy working together to make the world greener and safer.

Role

This role lies at the heart of our discovery engine. You’ll design and build LLM workflows that support decision-making in bioinformatics and metabolomic chemistry at Bactobio, using the latest capabilities in modern AI.

You'll turn messy scientific questions and trade-offs into recommendations scientists can use and trust, working in Python with frontier models and our proprietary biological data.

This is an applied role that ships code. We love to explore, but our goal is always something that runs, gets used, and moves the platform forward.

You'll thrive here if you care about AI and biology in equal measure and want your work tied to real experiments, real decisions, and real outcomes. Gaps are yours to fill, ideas are yours to try, and being wrong now and then is part of the work. You won't be a cog in the machine; you'll be a creative voice with room to use it.

Team

You’ll be joining a vibrant, tight-knit, and highly collaborative company of about fifty people. We sit together and take genuine interest in one another's work. Your home will be the Bioinformatics & Machine Learning team, but day to day you’ll work with microbiologists, chemists, automation and software engineers, and the business development team, with a front-row seat to the strategic and commercial decisions that shape the company.

Everyone who writes code at Bactobio contributes to a single shared codebase. We care about well-designed data models, best practices with sensible implementations, and building a tech stack that’s productive, maintainable, and genuinely enjoyable to work in.
  • Collaborate daily with wet-lab scientists to turn ambiguous scientific decisions into well-specified tasks with clear success criteria.
  • Design and build multi-step LLM workflows that query biological data and knowledge graphs and produce recommendations with traceable reasoning.
  • Build benchmarking infrastructure and curate evaluation datasets.
  • Keep up with frontier model capabilities, and iterate on models, prompts, tool design, and orchestration.
  • Contribute to our software platform, especially data architecture, pipelines, and model/workflow deployment.
What you’ll need
  • A Master's or PhD in a quantitative field with a significant ML/AI component, or at least two years of ML/AI-focused industry experience.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs (including tool use and evaluation), knowledge graphs, and multimodal data.
  • Comfort working with biological data (omics and experimental metadata) and collaborating with domain experts.
  • Proficiency in Python, with substantial experience in modern ML and data science tooling.
What will make you stand out
  • A research or industry track record applying ML in biotech or adjacent scientific settings.
  • Experience shipping production code in a shared codebase.
The starting salary range for this role is £45–65K.

We aim to pay competitively and fairly, guided by market data and internal consistency. Offers will vary based on experience, skills, seniority, and role scope. We’ll discuss general compensation ranges early in the process to keep things transparent.

Other benefits include:
  • The chance to be part of a fun, multicultural, kind, ambitious and impact-driven crowd
  • Daily access to leaders and mentors in the business
  • Brand new, modern labs in Central London with dedicated office space, large balconies, and 360’ views of the London skyline, where we all spend 4 days per week (1 day working from home)

  • Up to 2 months of fully paid sick leave
  • Flexible start and finish times within the company’s core hours to fit your preferences
  • 4 weeks of paid sabbatical leave after 5 years of service

title: Suunnittelupäällikkö
description:
Haluatko päästä vaikuttamaan Turun seudun vaativimpiin toimitila- ja kiinteistöhankkeisiin roolissa, jossa saat yhdistää vahvan teknisen asiantuntijuuden, projektien johtamisen ja halutessasi myös tiimin kehittämisen? Granlundin Turun toimisto hakee kokenutta LVI-suunnittelun ammattilaista vahvistamaan kasvavaa asiantuntijatiimiään.

Granlund on voimakkaasti kasvava kiinteistö- ja rakennusalan asiantuntijayhtiö. Rakennamme kestävää ja älykästä tulevaisuutta yhdessä asiakkaiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa. Yli 1800 ammattilaistamme palvelevat 30 toimipisteessä kautta Suomen.

Olisitko sinä etsimämme LVI-suunnittelupäällikkö?

Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet vaativien ja monipuolisten toimitila- ja kiinteistöhankkeiden parissa vastuullisena suunnittelijana, projektipäällikkönä tai johtavana asiantuntijana. Rooli rakentuu osaamisesi ja omien uratavoitteidesi mukaan: voit painottaa työssäsi teknistä suunnittelua, projektien johtamista tai ottaa myös enemmän vastuuta tiimin kehittämisestä ja esihenkilötehtävistä.

Projektikantamme tarjoaa monipuolisen työympäristön, sillä työskentelemme muun muassa sairaaloiden ja terveydenhuollon rakennusten, koulujen, päiväkotien, toimistojen, teollisuuskiinteistöjen sekä peruskorjaushankkeiden parissa. Turun alueella korostuvat erityisesti vaativat peruskorjaus- ja toimitilahankkeet, joissa kokeneen suunnittelijan osaamisella on merkittävä vaikutus projektien onnistumiseen.

Arkesi on yhdistelmä teknistä asiantuntijatyötä, projektien koordinointia ja yhteistyötä asiakkaiden kanssa. Työskentelet tiiviisti niin rakennusliikkeiden, kiinteistönomistajien, hyvinvointialueiden kuin muiden suunnittelualojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Samalla pääset osaksi moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa saman katon alta löytyvät myös sähkö-, rakenne- ja automaatiosuunnittelun asiantuntijat.

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työsuhde solmitan suoran Granlundin kanssa. Modernit toimitilamme sijaitsevat Kupittaalla, kehittyvän Itäharjun alueen vieressä hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä. Hyödynnämme joustavaa hybridimallia, mutta uskomme vahvasti yhdessä tekemisen voimaan ja viihdymme paljon myös toimistolla. Toivomme, että olet valmis työskentelemään perehdytyksen aikana pääosin toimistolta käsin, jotta yhteistyö tiimin kanssa pääsee parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla käyntiin.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Etsimme kokenutta LVI-suunnittelun ammattilaista, jolla on vahva näyttö vaativien hankkeiden onnistuneesta läpiviennistä sekä halu ottaa vastuuta merkittävistä kokonaisuuksista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää soveltuvaa LVI-insinöörin (AMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkintoa sekä vähintään noin 5–6 vuoden kokemusta vaativan tai erittäin vaativan luokan toimitilarakennusten LVI-suunnittelusta. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta vastuullisen suunnittelijan tehtävistä sekä näyttöjä projektien viemisestä onnistuneesti suunnittelun alkuvaiheista aina käyttöönottoon saakka. Toivomme, että sinulla on erittäin vaativan luokan (EV) pätevyys tai vähintään sellainen kokemus, jonka pohjalta voit sitä hakea. FISE- tai vastaava pätevyys katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi.

Sinulla on sujuvat it-taidot ja työkaluista hallitset MagiCAD-suunnittelun joko AutoCAD- tai Revit-ympäristössä. Kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englannin kielellä tulee pystyä työskentelemään käytännön tasolla, mutta täydellistä kielitaitoa ei edellytetä. Ruotsin kielen osaaminen on plussaa.

Persoonana olet oma-aloitteinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja ratkaisukeskeinen asiantuntija. Viihdyt asiakasrajapinnassa, rakennat luontevasti luottamuksellisia yhteistyösuhteita ja uskallat ottaa aktiivisesti yhteyttä asiakkaisiin. Lisäksi pystyt pitämään kokonaisuudet hallinnassa myös silloin, kun useat projektit etenevät samanaikaisesti ja tilanteet muuttuvat nopeasti.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Granlundilla pääset työskentelemään yrityksessä, joka on ollut suomalaisen talotekniikkasuunnittelun edelläkävijä jo vuosikymmenten ajan. Tänä päivänä olemme myös yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista datakeskusten suunnittelu- ja konsultointiyrityksistä. Kasvava liiketoiminta, vaativat hankkeet ja markkinan jatkuva kehitys tarjoavat kokeneelle asiantuntijalle erinomaiset mahdollisuudet rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa sekä kehittyä oman alansa huippuosaajaksi.

Turun toimistolla pääset osaksi asiantuntijayhteisöä, jossa yhdistyvät monipuoliset projektit, korkea tekninen osaaminen ja hyvä yhdessä tekemisen kulttuuri. Tarjoamme aidosti mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi, olipa tavoitteesi syventää asiantuntijuuttasi, ottaa vastuuta projektien johtamisesta tai edetä esihenkilörooleihin.

Panostamme aidosti henkilöstön hyvinvointiin, jatkuvaan oppimiseen sekä kannustavaan ja ammattimaiseen työympäristöön. Pääset osaksi yhteistyöhön ja kunnianhimoon perustuvaa tiimiä, jossa ihmiset ottavat vastuuta, jakavat osaamistaan ja työskentelevät yhdessä yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 6.10. mennessä.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Hannamari Ukkonen, hannamari.ukkonen@biisoni.fi tai puhelimitse +358 40 847 8146

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Novato, California.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Novato area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Novato requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Therapist
description:

  • Voluntary Benefits for Part-Time Employees – Dental, vision, life, accident insurance, and telehealth options for those working 20 hours or more per week.

At Bradford Health Services, we don’t just invest in our patients—we invest in our people.


About the Role:

As a Therapist, you will play a critical role in supporting individuals, families, and groups to improve their mental health and overall well-being. You will provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions tailored to the unique needs of each client, helping them navigate life transitions, manage emotional challenges, and develop coping strategies. Your work will involve assessing clients' mental health status, creating treatment plans, and facilitating individual or group therapy sessions. You will also collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive care and crisis intervention when necessary. Ultimately, your efforts will contribute to enhancing clients' quality of life and fostering resilience in the face of behavioral health challenges.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree in Counseling Psychology, Social Work, or a related mental health field.
  • Valid state licensure as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in mental health counseling and psychotherapy.
  • Strong knowledge of crisis intervention techniques and behavioral health principles.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with diverse client populations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Specialized training or certification in group therapy, family therapy, or anger management.
  • Experience working with clients undergoing significant life transitions or trauma recovery.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based therapeutic approaches such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) or Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT).
  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and contribute to integrated care models.
  • Experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems and teletherapy platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough psychological assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.
  • Provide individual, family, and group therapy sessions using various therapeutic modalities.
  • Implement crisis intervention strategies to support clients experiencing acute mental health episodes.
  • Facilitate anger management and life transition counseling to assist clients in coping with stressors.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential client records in compliance with legal and ethical standards.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including psychiatrists, social workers, and medical professionals.
  • Stay current with developments in counseling psychology and behavioral health to apply best practices.

Skills:

The required skills such as counseling psychology, group therapy, and mental health counseling are essential for conducting effective therapeutic sessions and developing treatment plans tailored to client needs. Family therapy and psychotherapy skills enable the therapist to address complex relational dynamics and emotional issues within family systems. Crisis intervention and anger management skills are critical for providing immediate support during acute episodes and helping clients develop healthier coping mechanisms. Life transitions and behavioral health expertise allow the therapist to guide clients through significant changes and behavioral challenges with empathy and evidence-based strategies. Preferred skills like familiarity with CBT or DBT and experience with teletherapy enhance the therapist’s ability to deliver versatile and accessible care, ensuring comprehensive support across diverse client situations.

title: Operation Coordinator - Business Setup (Mainland)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator – Mainland Business Setup to join our Business Setup team.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating and managing the end-to-end Mainland company formation process in the UAE, from understanding the client's requirements and selecting the appropriate business activity through to trade name reservation, initial approval, documentation, licence issuance and post-licensing support.

This position requires hands-on experience with UAE Mainland business setup, particularly DED/DET procedures, and the ability to independently coordinate multiple company formation cases while ensuring applications are processed accurately and within the required timelines.

The ideal candidate should be familiar with the practical requirements of setting up different types of Mainland businesses and should be confident in dealing with government authorities, clients, internal teams and external service providers.

Requirements

  • Coordinate trade name reservation, initial approval, activity selection and licence issuance.
